zh: 圣路易斯雷大桥
text: The Bridge of San Luis Rey

zh: 五个人的一生，一座桥的两端
text: Five lives, two sides of a bridge

zh: 改编自桑顿·怀尔德普利策奖小说
text: Adapted from Thornton Wilder’s Pulitzer Prize–winning novel

zh: 当命运没有给出解释，我们还能怎样去爱？
text: When fate offers no explanation, how can we go on loving?

zh: 第一卷 · 不肯寄出的信
text: Book I · The Unsent Letter

zh: 胡尼佩尔
text: Brother Juniper

zh: 那天中午，我正要走向桥头。脚下的路热得发白，五个人已经走上木板；随即，桥像一根绷得太久的弦，断进河谷。我站在这里，距离他们那么近，却仍在活着。他们只是比我早到了片刻吗？
text: At noon that day, I was approaching the bridge. The road beneath my feet was white with heat, and five people had already stepped onto the planks. Then the bridge, like a string held taut too long, snapped into the gorge. I stood so close to them, and yet I was still alive. Had they merely arrived a few moments before me?

zh: 胡尼佩尔
text: Brother Juniper

zh: 我相信世间有一种安排。可相信是一回事，面对五个人的死，又是一回事。我想知道他们此前怎样生活，认识谁，爱过谁；倘若能把这些事弄清楚，是否也能明白，为什么偏偏是他们？
text: I believe there is an order to the world. But believing is one thing; facing five deaths is another. I wanted to know how they had lived, whom they had known, whom they had loved. If I could discover all this, might I also understand why it had been these five?

zh: 胡尼佩尔
text: Brother Juniper

zh: 有人先告诉我，遇难的老妇人十分古怪。有人记得她的酒，有人记得她的学问，还有人记得，她常常为一封从西班牙来的信，变得不像自己。关于同一个人，我听到了许多彼此不相像的话。
text: First, someone told me that the old woman who died was very strange. Some remembered her drinking, others her learning. Others still remembered how a letter from Spain could make her seem a different person. I heard many accounts of the same woman that scarcely resembled one another.

zh: 胡尼佩尔
text: Brother Juniper

zh: 她的女儿隔着海，身边却住着一个没有父母的女孩。两个人都有信想写，有话说不出来。我想从这所宅邸开始，听一听那些没有传到街上的声音：一个人那么需要爱，是否也会使爱她的人感到疲倦？
text: Her daughter lived across the sea; beside her lived a girl without parents. Both had letters they wished to write, things they could not say. I would begin with that house, and listen for voices that had never reached the street. Can someone’s hunger for love exhaust the very people who love them?

zh: 第二卷 · 一个人的名字
text: Book II · One Person’s Name

zh: 埃斯特班
text: Esteban

zh: 城里的人总把我们认错。他们笑一阵，重新叫一个名字，我们便继续做手里的活。解释起来很费事，有时候还不如由他们去说。只要兄弟站在旁边，我就知道那些错误没有真的把谁弄丢。
text: People in the city were always mistaking us for one another. They would laugh, try the other name, and we would go on with our work. Explaining was tiring; sometimes it was easier to let them talk. As long as my brother stood beside me, I knew their mistakes had not really made either of us disappear.

zh: 埃斯特班
text: Esteban

zh: 我们替教堂擦过墙，替剧院抄过本子，也到海边搬过货。一天结束时，不必把每一件事重新讲一遍，另一个人便知道为什么累。要走同一条路，有时反而分开走，免得街上的人又停下来打趣。
text: We scrubbed church walls, copied plays for the theatre, and carried cargo at the shore. At the end of a day, neither had to tell the whole story for the other to know why he was tired. Sometimes we walked the same road separately, so that people would not stop to make jokes again.

zh: 埃斯特班
text: Esteban

zh: 后来，他常常经过剧院，回来的时候比从前晚。我坐在桌边等，蜡烛慢慢短下去。以前觉得已经很完整的生活，原来也能给别的人留出位置。我不明白这变化，也不知道怎样问他才不会像在责备。
text: Later, he kept going past the theatre and came home later than before. I waited at the table while the candle grew shorter. The life I had thought complete could evidently make room for someone else. I did not understand the change, or know how to ask him about it without sounding accusing.

zh: 埃斯特班
text: Esteban

zh: 再后来，有人问我是哪一个。我明明听懂了，却说出了另一个名字。那句回答离开嘴以后，周围的人仍在等我往前走。一个人站在原来两个人生活过的地方，究竟要怎样知道，接下来该去哪儿？
text: Later still, someone asked which one I was. I understood perfectly, but gave the other name. Once the answer left my mouth, people were still waiting for me to move on. Standing alone where two people used to live, how can a person know where to go next?

zh: 第三卷 · 掌声散去以后
text: Book III · After the Applause

zh: 卡米拉
text: Camila

zh: 我第一次睡到那张小床上时，没有想过成名。能喝热汤，不再被锁起来，还有人教我怎样唱，我就已经觉得生活变了。后来大家记得我在舞台上是什么样子，很少有人再问那个从咖啡馆出来的小女孩。
text: The first time I slept in that little bed, I was not thinking of fame. There was hot soup. I was no longer locked up. Someone was teaching me to sing. That alone meant my life had changed. Later, everyone remembered me on the stage; hardly anyone asked about the little girl who had come out of the café.

zh: 卡米拉
text: Camila

zh: 他教我读懂一句台词，教我怎样转身，怎样把声音停在恰好的地方。观众越热烈，我越怕回到化妆室，看见他站在角落里吹口哨。好像所有人的满意合在一起，也不能替我换来他一句放心。
text: He taught me to understand a line, to turn, to let my voice pause in just the right place. The warmer the audience became, the more I dreaded returning to my dressing room and finding him whistling in a corner. It was as though everyone else’s approval together could not buy one reassuring word from him.

zh: 卡米拉
text: Camila

zh: 我想过离开舞台，做一个体面的女人，做孩子的母亲。可每走进一种新的生活，总有人带着旧的称呼追来。即使他的确帮过我，即使我曾经十分感激，也不表示以后每一扇门，都可以不敲就推开。
text: I thought of leaving the stage, becoming a respectable woman, being a mother to my children. But each new life I entered was followed by someone calling me by an old name. Even if he had helped me, even if I had once been deeply grateful, that did not mean every door could forever be opened without knocking.

zh: 卡米拉
text: Camila

zh: 如今他又来，请求把孩子带去城里一年。他说自己能教会许多事，我知道他能够；我也知道孩子的身体有多弱。一个人想给出照料的时候，是否也应当停下来，听一听被照料的人怎样回答？
text: Now he has come again, asking to take my child into the city for a year. He says he can teach him many things. I know he can. I also know how frail my boy is. When someone wishes to offer care, should they not pause to hear the answer of the person they would care for?

zh: 仍在人间
text: Still Among the Living

zh: 五个人走上那座桥，都有来处，也都有尚未做完的事。海的另一边还有一封信，远航还没有开始，城里的屋子还等着收拾。桥断以后，这些未完成的事没有自动成为灾难的解释。
text: All five who stepped onto the bridge came from somewhere, and all had things left undone. A letter remained across the sea. A voyage had not begun. Rooms in the city were waiting to be put in order. When the bridge broke, these unfinished things did not become an explanation for the disaster.

zh: 胡尼佩尔调查了六年。他把听到的细节都记下来，唯恐漏掉一件，便漏掉了答案。厨子记得玛丽亚吃什么，书商说她学问很好，另一些人却记得她古怪而讨嫌。那些最亲近死者的人，也有难以说出口的部分。
text: Brother Juniper investigated for six years. He recorded every detail he heard, afraid that one omitted fact might mean a lost answer. The cook remembered what María ate; the bookseller spoke of her learning; others remembered an eccentric, tiresome woman. Even those closest to the dead had things they could not put into words.

zh: 更早以前，一次瘟疫曾使他给十五名死者和十五名幸存者列过表，比较善良、虔诚以及对家庭的用处。算出来的结果并不支持他预期的解释。他把纸撕碎扔进海里，又从海天的美丽中重新找回信心。那张表从未属于桥上的五个人。
text: Earlier, during a plague, he had made a table of fifteen people who died and fifteen who survived, comparing their goodness, piety, and usefulness to their families. The results did not support the explanation he expected. He tore up the paper and cast it into the sea, then recovered his faith from the beauty of sea and sky. That table had never concerned the five people on the bridge.

zh: 关于桥难的书终于写完，却被判为异端，要同作者一并焚毁。修士最后一夜仍想知道，自己人生的安排在哪里；至少有一个愿望十分清楚：希望有人相信，他当初是为了信仰才开始追问。广场上，确实有人相信他。
text: At last his book about the bridge was finished. It was condemned as heresy, to be burned together with its author. On his last night, the friar still wondered where the plan for his own life lay. At least one wish was clear: he hoped someone would believe that he had begun his inquiry for the sake of faith. In the square, some people did believe him.

zh: 把目光再移回六年前、桥难后的追思仪式。黑纱、蜡烛、银器与歌声挤满教堂。船长只停留片刻，便走到海边。院长坐在女孩们中间，想起佩皮塔，承认自己太忙，也把太多事业的盼望交给了那个孩子。
text: Now look back six years, to the memorial service after the collapse. Black veils, candles, silver, and singing filled the church. The captain stayed only a little while, then went down to the sea. Sitting among the girls, the abbess thought of Pepita. She admitted that she had been too busy, and had placed too many hopes for her work upon that child.

zh: 卡米拉原本也要来。半路上，她想到人群、仪式和逐渐模糊的面容，停进一座小教堂，以为自己竟然什么也感受不到。痛苦却随后涌来：她再也不能亲口对皮奥说爱，也不能在海梅受苦时，重新把勇气交给他。她返回了山庄。
text: Camila had meant to attend as well. On the way, thinking of the crowd, the ceremony, and the faces already growing indistinct, she stopped in a little church. She thought she could feel nothing. Then anguish came: she could never tell Pio that she loved him, never give Jaime fresh courage when he was suffering. She returned to her villa.

zh: 一年以后，她听说院长也在同一次事故中失去了两个亲近的人。她先躲在修院附近观察那张朴素的脸，终于走进去，承认自己就是从前的演员。话没有说完，她便在悲痛里弯下身。
text: A year later, she heard that the abbess had lost two people close to her in the same accident. At first she hid near the convent, watching that plain face. At last she went inside and confessed that she was the former actress. Before she could finish speaking, she bent beneath her grief.

zh: 卡米拉
text: Camila

zh: 母亲，我该怎么办？我孤零零的，什么也没有了。我爱他们。我该怎么办？
text: Mother, what shall I do? I am all alone. I have nothing. I loved them. What shall I do?

zh: 院长没有立即给出解释。她把卡米拉带到花园，叫人送水，谈起种花的修女，随后问起她失去的孩子与朋友。卡米拉积压了许多年的悲伤，终于有一个不必辩解、也不必表演的地方可以停下来。
text: The abbess did not immediately offer an explanation. She led Camila into the garden, sent for water, spoke of the nun who tended the flowers, and then asked about the child and friend she had lost. The grief Camila had carried for years had finally found somewhere to rest, without a defense or a performance.

zh: 后来，克拉拉从西班牙来到修院，带着母亲最后一封信。她竭力替母亲辩护，也责备自己。院长读着信，惊讶那些宽厚的句子竟来自自己曾经轻视的人。她请女儿留下，看一看这里每天的工作。
text: Later, Clara came from Spain, bringing her mother’s last letter to the convent. She struggled to defend her mother, and blamed herself. Reading the letter, the abbess was astonished that such generous sentences had come from someone she had once dismissed. She asked the daughter to stay and see their daily work.

zh: 太阳落下，灯照着一条又一条走廊。老人、孩子、病人与盲人都在这里。院长还想知道，是否有人能为聋人研究一种语言，是否有更温柔的方法照顾精神失常的人。她已经老了，仍在询问，下一件能做的事在哪里。
text: The sun went down, and lamps lit corridor after corridor. Old people, children, the sick, and the blind were here. The abbess still wanted to know whether someone could devise a language for the deaf, whether there were gentler ways of caring for people whose minds were troubled. She was old, yet still asking what could be done next.

zh: 卡米拉如今也是帮手之一，正要去城的另一边办事。院长还得进病房说几句话，然后去同等得不耐烦的面粉商谈价。灯被放到地上，病人们望着她；屋外仍黑，屋里有人留下，给他们一点光和暖。
text: Camila was now among her helpers, about to go on an errand across the city. The abbess must still say a few words in the sickroom, then bargain with the flour merchant who was growing impatient. The lamp was set on the floor. The patients looked at her. Outside it was dark; inside, someone stayed to offer a little light and warmth.

zh: 院长想到，再过一些日子，也许连记得这五个人的人都会死去。爱过他们的人会再被爱一阵，随后同样被遗忘。可是爱已经存在过，那些向他人伸出的心意，并不以永远被人记住为条件。
text: The abbess thought that, in time, even those who remembered the five would die. Those who had loved them would be loved a little longer, and would also be forgotten. Yet the love had existed. The heart’s reaching toward another did not depend upon being remembered forever.

zh: 皮拉尔院长的心声
text: Mother Pilar’s thoughts

zh: 有生者的世界，也有死者的世界；桥是爱，是唯一留下来的，也是唯一的意义。
text: There is a land of the living and a land of the dead and the bridge is love, the only survival, the only meaning.

zh: 挑选接班人
text: Choosing a successor

zh: 盼望的事业
text: The work she hopes for

zh: 希望女人能够彼此保护，照顾孤儿、病人及没有依靠的妇女
text: Women protecting one another and caring for orphans, the sick and women without support

zh: 看中的孩子
text: The child she chooses

zh: 女孩被送往
text: Where she sends the girl

zh: 发现才华的地方
text: Where she noticed her talent

zh: 洗衣池边，她看见孩子一边组织劳动，一边生动讲述圣女的故事
text: Beside the laundry trough, she saw the child organize the work while vividly telling a saint’s story

zh: 没有察觉的压力
text: Pressure she did not see

zh: 以成人相待的信任使女孩自豪，也让她害怕暴露自己无法胜任
text: Being trusted as an adult made the girl proud, but afraid to reveal that she might not be capable

zh: 学会向别人求助
text: Learning to ask for help

zh: 街角的请求
text: Her request at the corner

zh: 她请生还的青年进屋帮忙，提起他曾为自己做过的事
text: She asks the surviving young man to come inside and help, recalling things he once did for her

zh: 走散的青年
text: The young man who slips away

zh: 后来求助的人
text: Whom she later asks for help

zh: 失败的一步
text: An unsuccessful step

zh: 两声朋友和一次靠近，仍使青年转身逃跑，她没有因此放弃寻找办法
text: Twice calling him her friend and moving nearer still makes him flee; she does not stop seeking another way

zh: 留给另一人的记忆
text: A memory left with someone

zh: 她承认自己也失去过人，青年后来一直记得这句话
text: She admits she too has lost someone; the young man remembers those words

zh: 被想起的照料者
text: A caregiver remembered

zh: 皮奥提出的安排
text: Pio’s proposed arrangements

zh: 他承诺收拾住处，并请院长帮忙找一位管理家务的人
text: He promises to put his house in order and ask the abbess to find someone to manage it

zh: 拟被带去教养的孩子
text: The child he hopes to educate

zh: 安排发生之前的住所
text: The child’s home before the proposed move

zh: 意愿的边界
text: The limit of a promise

zh: 这仍是皮奥为了取得同意所作的承诺，不能写成已经实际落实的照护
text: These are still promises Pio makes to obtain consent, not care arrangements already carried out

zh: 日常本领
text: Practical skills

zh: 她管理的房屋、病人和食物，使照料不只是一句善意的话
text: The rooms, patients and food she manages make care more than a kindly word

zh: 卡米拉
text: Camila

zh: 从咖啡馆歌女成长为名演员，艺名佩里科尔；在舞台、情爱、体面身份与母亲的责任之间寻找生活。
text: A café singer who becomes the celebrated actress La Perichole, seeking a life among art, love, respectability and motherhood.

zh: 一次伤人的演出
text: A performance that wounds

zh: 舞台的力量
text: The stage’s power

zh: 她能临时把贵族的私事编进歌曲，迅速引导整场观众的情绪
text: She can put an aristocrat’s private affairs into an improvised song and swiftly sway the whole audience

zh: 公开表演之地
text: Where she performs

zh: 要求她登门的人
text: Who orders her visit

zh: 误认的宽恕
text: Forgiveness misunderstood

zh: 她以为侯爵夫人故意宽恕侮辱，实际对方并未认真听见那些歌
text: She thinks the Marquesa deliberately forgives the insult; in fact, her listener hardly heard the songs

zh: 离开以后
text: After leaving

zh: 她长时间面对镜子，不能再像来访之前那样轻松嘲笑对方
text: She spends a long time before the mirror, unable to mock the woman as easily as before

zh: 不能让旁人知道的信
text: Letters others must not know about

zh: 临时雇用的代笔人
text: The copyist she hires

zh: 交付的文字
text: The writing she entrusts to him

zh: 平常的助手
text: Her usual helper

zh: 通常由皮奥替她读写，但这些私人往来特意不让他知道
text: Pio normally reads and writes for her, but she deliberately keeps these private exchanges from him

zh: 钱的分量
text: The weight of payment

zh: 每次写完便付酬，提醒抄写者这段靠近仍然是一桩受雇的工作
text: She pays after each letter, reminding the copyist that this closeness is still hired work

zh: 深夜的打扰
text: A late-night interruption

zh: 她为一次约会失望来到兄弟房中，不知道旁观者怎样理解耳语
text: Disappointed over an appointment, she comes to the brothers’ room, unaware how a witness understands their whispers

zh: 母亲与旧伙伴
text: A mother and an old companion

zh: 试图争取的东西
text: What she strives to gain

zh: 出发前送给孩子的小物件
text: The little object she gives her son before departure

zh: 离开舞台的原因
text: Why she leaves the stage

zh: 既有对社会身份的渴望，也有对角色、侮辱与劳累的厌倦
text: A desire for social standing, but also weariness with the roles, insults and exhausting work

zh: 拒绝的权利
text: The right to refuse

zh: 病后不愿见人，曾明确禁止皮奥进入田庄；他的照料并不取消这道边界
text: After her illness she refuses visitors and expressly forbids Pio the estate; his care does not erase that boundary

zh: 最后的条件
text: Her final condition

zh: 同意教养一年之前，要求先问孩子是否愿意同行
text: Before agreeing to a year’s education, she insists that the child be asked whether he wishes to go

zh: 皮奥
text: Pio

zh: 人们叫他叔叔，实际并无亲缘；见多识广的漂泊者和戏剧导师，对才华的热爱夹杂着掌控他人的愿望。
text: Called Uncle without being a relative, this worldly wanderer and theatre mentor mixes love of talent with a wish to control others.

zh: 台前的身后人
text: The man behind the performer

zh: 长期指导的演员
text: The actress he teaches

zh: 共同依靠的文本
text: The texts they work from

zh: 工作范围
text: His range of work

zh: 教戏、读写、理发、跑腿、管钱，常做那些没有出现在掌声里的工作
text: Teaching, reading, writing, hairdressing, errands and accounts: much of the work unheard in the applause

zh: 叔叔的称呼
text: The name Uncle

zh: 来自亲近的社会称谓，不能据此认定他与演员存在血缘关系
text: An affectionate social title, not evidence of a blood relationship with the actress

zh: 被母亲看见的样子
text: As the mother sees him

zh: 侯爵夫人提起演员时，也提到这个常在她身边的人
text: In writing about the actress, the Marquesa also mentions the man so often beside her

zh: 扶持与支配
text: Support and control

zh: 共同巡游的行装
text: Their luggage on tour

zh: 越界时被看见的物件
text: The object present at his intrusion

zh: 对于完美
text: His idea of perfection

zh: 真心热爱文学与技艺，却常用嘲讽、沉默和吝惜赞美使学生感到痛苦
text: He sincerely loves literature and craft, yet often hurts his pupil through mockery, silence and withheld praise

zh: 索债的一句话
text: The demand for repayment

zh: 请求教养受拒后以欠款施压，后来收回要钱，却不能取消它造成的伤害
text: Refused permission to educate the child, he pressures her with a debt; withdrawing the demand cannot undo its hurt

zh: 最后的照看
text: His last act of care

zh: 察觉车轮颠簸使孩子不适，便改用肩膀扛着他前行
text: Noticing that the jolting cart makes the child ill, he carries him on his shoulder instead

zh: 埃斯特班
text: Esteban

zh: 在修院长大的双胞胎之一，与兄弟共同劳动，习惯把两人的生活看作整体。
text: One of the twins raised at the convent. He works alongside his brother and is used to thinking of their lives as one.

zh: 只剩一个人
text: Only one remains

zh: 曾借用的名字
text: The name he borrows

zh: 远行前的心愿
text: His wish before sailing

zh: 预支工资送院长礼物，希望也代表已经死去的兄弟
text: To buy the abbess a gift with an advance on his wages, representing his dead brother as well

zh: 被留下的时刻
text: The moment he is kept alive

zh: 出发前陷入危机，船长进入房间干预并留下陪伴
text: He falls into crisis before departure; the Captain enters, intervenes and stays with him

zh: 桥边的路线
text: The route at the bridge

zh: 船长下到河边监督货运，他从人行桥上通过，随后随桥坠落
text: The Captain descends to supervise the cargo. Esteban takes the footbridge and falls when it breaks

zh: 曼努埃尔
text: Manuel

zh: 埃斯特班的双生兄弟，做过抄写员与苦力，对女演员产生难以言说的倾慕。
text: Esteban’s twin, a copyist and laborer, who develops an attachment to an actress he can scarcely put into words.

zh: 不能分给兄弟的心事
text: A feeling he cannot share

zh: 与谁相依长大
text: Who grew up beside him

zh: 喜欢的人
text: The person he loves

zh: 卡米拉使他第一次在共同生活之外形成强烈的想象与依恋
text: Camila first gives him a powerful attachment and imagined life outside the brothers’ shared existence

zh: 不再代笔
text: No longer writing for her

zh: 察觉兄弟痛苦后拒绝继续写信，但未能把所有内心矛盾同时抹去
text: Seeing his brother’s pain, he stops taking dictation, without thereby erasing every conflict within himself

zh: 死亡的先后
text: The order of the deaths

zh: 膝部伤口恶化后先于桥难去世，不在五名坠桥者之中
text: He dies of his worsening knee wound before the bridge collapses; he is not one of its five victims

zh: 阿尔瓦拉多船长
text: Captain Alvarado

zh: 走过许多海域的航海者，寡言、可靠，女儿的去世长久地留在他的生活中。
text: A quiet, dependable seaman who has travelled many seas. His daughter’s death remains a lasting presence in his life.

zh: 陪伴与邀请
text: Company and an invitation

zh: 前去寻找青年的城镇
text: The city where he seeks the young man

zh: 两人共同知道的事
text: What they already share

zh: 从前曾一起卸船，彼此尊重不爱夸耀和辩解的沉默
text: They once unloaded ships together and respect a silence that neither boasts nor offers excuses

zh: 自己的失去
text: His own loss

zh: 女儿早已去世，有时他仍觉得她只是在某个远方旅行
text: His daughter died long ago; sometimes he still feels that she is only travelling somewhere far away

zh: 说话的方式
text: His way of speaking

zh: 先提供工作、晚饭和共同出发的约定，没有保证悲伤立即消失
text: He offers work, supper and a journey together, without promising that grief will vanish at once

zh: 赴宴的航海者
text: A seaman at supper

zh: 被带去的地方
text: Where he is taken

zh: 加入聚谈
text: Joining the conversation

zh: 由皮奥带入夜宴，同总督、大主教和演员说起远方与旧事
text: Pio brings him to the night suppers to talk of faraway places and old events with the Viceroy, Archbishop and actress

zh: 桥前的再见
text: Meeting before the bridge

zh: 皮奥带着孩子赶路时再次遇见他，那仍是一次普通的朋友碰面
text: Pio meets him again while travelling with the child; it is still an ordinary encounter between friends

zh: 避免误解
text: A distinction to keep

zh: 他因监督货运而走河谷，不是因为知道索桥将断而先行避险
text: He takes the river route to supervise cargo, not because he knows the bridge will break

zh: 海梅
text: Jaime

zh: 卡米拉与总督的儿子，体弱而严肃，珍惜阳光，不愿让别人看见自己的发作。
text: The son of Camila and the Viceroy, frail and serious. He delights in sunshine and hates others to see his attacks.

zh: 自己的小行李
text: His own small bundle

zh: 母亲
text: His mother

zh: 身体的处境
text: His health

zh: 体弱，发作时尤其怕别人看见，常常努力掩饰自己的难受
text: Frail and especially afraid of being watched during an attack, he often tries to hide his distress

zh: 幼年一景
text: A glimpse of childhood

zh: 原著较早描写他七岁时的形象，不能直接等同断桥时的确切年龄
text: An earlier passage describes him at seven; this does not establish his precise age at the bridge’s collapse

zh: 选择与照看
text: Choice and care

zh: 在母亲提出须征得同意后出现于客店，颠簸难耐时由皮奥背负
text: He appears at the inn after his mother insists on his consent; when the jolting becomes unbearable, Pio carries him

zh: 安德烈斯总督
text: Viceroy Andrés

zh: 秘鲁总督，卡米拉的恋人，精于宫廷礼仪，也受病痛、权势与厌倦困扰。
text: The Viceroy of Peru and Camila’s lover, accomplished in courtly manners and troubled by illness, power and weariness.

zh: 维护自己的宫廷
text: Protecting his court

zh: 维护身份的场所
text: The setting of his rank

zh: 道歉的命令
text: The order to apologize

zh: 要求演员就公开羞辱侯爵夫人登门道歉，允许她保留一双鞋
text: He orders the actress to visit the Marquesa over her public insult, allowing her to keep one pair of shoes

zh: 不止一种动机
text: More than one motive

zh: 既顾及贵族秩序及夫人女婿的权势，也乐于压低女演员的气焰
text: He considers aristocratic order and the son-in-law’s influence, while also enjoying humbling the actress

zh: 私人的猜疑
text: Private suspicion

zh: 怀疑情人同别的男人来往，使威严和感情上的不安混在一起
text: Suspecting his lover of seeing other men mixes his authority with emotional insecurity

zh: 夜宴与父亲的身份
text: Night suppers and fatherhood

zh: 幼子的名字
text: His young son

zh: 带来的教养
text: What he teaches

zh: 教演员宫廷语言和日常礼仪，使她的舞台表现增加新的细节
text: Courtly language and everyday manners give the actress new details for her performances

zh: 身体的代价
text: The cost to his body

zh: 饮食、享乐与长久的流寓带来病痛和难以消除的厌倦
text: Food, pleasure and long residence abroad bring illness and an enduring weariness

zh: 礼仪之外
text: Beyond etiquette

zh: 与亲近者谈到天亮，借故事和文学暂时抚慰对西班牙的乡愁
text: He talks with his intimates until dawn, using stories and literature to soothe his homesickness for Spain

zh: 利马大主教
text: Archbishop of Lima

zh: 爱好语言、音乐与美食，也常为行动寻找推辞的教会高位者。
text: A high churchman who enjoys language, music and good food, and often finds reasons to postpone action.

zh: 胡尼佩尔
text: Brother Juniper

zh: 目睹桥难的方济各会修士，用多年调查追问五个人的死亡是否具有天意。
text: A Franciscan who witnesses the bridge disaster and spends years asking whether the five deaths reveal providence.

zh: 寻找解释的人
text: Seeking an explanation

zh: 调查所问
text: What his inquiry asks

zh: 开始的缘由
text: How it begins

zh: 目睹五人遇难以后，试图从他们的生平寻找事件背后的安排
text: After seeing five people perish, he searches their lives for a design behind the event

zh: 更早的一次尝试
text: An earlier attempt

zh: 瘟疫时比较十五名死者与十五名幸存者，所得结果并不符合预期
text: During a plague he compared fifteen victims with fifteen survivors; the results failed to support his expectations

zh: 不能成为判决
text: No basis for a verdict

zh: 调查记录保留了许多矛盾说法，无法把五个人化成道德高低的答案
text: His record preserves conflicting accounts; it cannot reduce the five people to a ranking of moral worth

zh: 利马
text: Lima

zh: 小说中人们交错生活的城市，教堂、剧院、宅邸与码头各有自己的声音。
text: The city where these lives intersect. Church, theatre, mansion and harbor each have their own voices.

zh: 一座城的目光
text: The city’s gaze

zh: 追逐掌声的场所
text: Where applause is sought

zh: 街头的老妇人
text: The old woman in the street

zh: 居民谈她的衣服、酒醉与怪异，难以看见她写信时的用心
text: Residents discuss her clothes, drunkenness and eccentricities, scarcely seeing the care with which she writes

zh: 许多种生活
text: Many kinds of life

zh: 贵族客厅、海边、修院和舞台之间，消息与人情不断流动
text: News and favors pass continually among aristocratic parlors, the shore, the convent and the stage

zh: 名声的反转
text: A change in reputation

zh: 众人的嘲笑与后来对文字的赞赏，并不一定认识同一个人的生活
text: The crowd’s mockery and its later admiration for her letters need not mean that either understands her life

zh: 熟悉却回不去
text: Familiar, yet hard to return to

zh: 兄弟的谋生地点之一
text: One place the brothers work

zh: 共同的劳动
text: Their shared labor

zh: 抄剧本与乐谱、搬货和跑腿，让两个沉默青年被城里许多人认识
text: Copying plays and music, carrying cargo and running errands make the two quiet men familiar to many in the city

zh: 看见失去的人
text: Those who witness loss

zh: 街坊对兄弟的分离十分关心，却不能因此替生还者走完悲伤
text: Neighbors care deeply about the brothers’ separation, but cannot thereby carry the survivor through his grief

zh: 一次次返回
text: Repeated returns

zh: 青年不断离开、又重新回城，熟悉的街道并未马上恢复熟悉的意义
text: He keeps leaving and coming back; familiar streets do not immediately recover their former meaning

zh: 侯爵府
text: The Marquesa’s house

zh: 玛丽亚在利马的宅邸，华贵、宽敞，却容纳着母女间长久的疏离。
text: María’s spacious, splendid house in Lima, which holds the long estrangement between mother and daughter.

zh: 宽敞与孤单
text: Space and loneliness

zh: 初到这里的少女
text: The girl who comes to live here

zh: 绿色阳台
text: The green balcony

zh: 主人独坐读信，也在这里察觉自己的爱含有支配欲
text: The owner reads letters alone here and recognizes a wish for control within her love

zh: 仆人的便利
text: An opportunity for the servants

zh: 主人长久沉浸于自己的生活，使仆人借住房间、取走物品更容易
text: Her long absorption in her private concerns makes it easier for servants to borrow rooms and take belongings

zh: 不稳定的亲切
text: Uncertain warmth

zh: 夫人偶尔待少女十分温暖，随后又退回自己的心事，使依恋无处安放
text: At times she is deeply kind to the girl, then retreats into her own troubles, leaving the girl’s attachment nowhere to rest

zh: 西班牙
text: Spain

zh: 克拉拉婚后的居所，也是秘鲁许多人不断回望的远方。
text: Clara’s home after marriage, and the distant country to which many in Peru keep looking back.

zh: 利马海港
text: Lima’s harbor

zh: 远行者和海运货物往返的海岸，母女的告别与兄弟的劳动都发生在这里。
text: The shore where travellers and cargo come and go, where mother and daughter part and the brothers work.

zh: 靠近远方的劳动
text: Labor beside the wider world

zh: 从前雇用过兄弟的人
text: Who once employed the brothers

zh: 可以找到的工作
text: Work to be found

zh: 兄弟抄写疲倦后到海边装卸船货，不以同普通苦力劳动为耻
text: Tired of copying, the brothers unload ships at the coast, unashamed to work alongside ordinary laborers

zh: 新的邀请
text: A new invitation

zh: 远航意味着繁重工作与工资，也意味着暂时离开熟悉的痛苦
text: A voyage means wages and hard work, but also a temporary departure from familiar pain

zh: 未完成的抵达
text: An arrival never reached

zh: 青年答应同行，却在返城途中遭遇桥难，没有登上预定的船
text: The young man agrees to go, but dies on the return to Lima before boarding the intended ship

zh: 圣罗莎修院
text: Convent of Santa Rosa

zh: 院长照料孤儿与病人的地方，有洗衣池、病房和每日需要筹措的开销。
text: Where the abbess cares for orphans and the sick, with laundry troughs, wards and daily expenses to meet.

zh: 孩子与事务
text: Children and responsibilities

zh: 日常的准则之一
text: One rule of daily life

zh: 院长看重的事情
text: What the abbess values

zh: 照顾孤儿和病人，也让女孩学习筹款、管理与对抗社会中的不公
text: Care for orphans and the sick, while teaching girls to raise funds, manage affairs and resist injustice

zh: 教育的重量
text: The weight of education

zh: 接班人的期待使一个孩子过早面对成人需要承担的责任
text: Being expected to succeed her makes a child face adult responsibilities too early

zh: 被想念的声音
text: The voices remembered

zh: 佩皮塔在山中回忆的，是晚餐后的话语、病房祷告与独自受教的时刻
text: In the mountains Pepita remembers after-supper talk, prayers in the wards and moments of private instruction

zh: 院门再次打开
text: The door opens again

zh: 兄弟之间保留的东西
text: What the brothers keep between them

zh: 成长的起点
text: Where growing up begins

zh: 两名弃婴在门前被发现，随后获得名字、食物和故事
text: Two abandoned babies are found at the door, then given names, food and stories

zh: 失去以后的尝试
text: Attempts after the loss

zh: 院长既安排后事，也试着让徘徊的青年重新靠近众人
text: The abbess arranges the burial and tries to draw the wandering young man back among other people

zh: 没有立即成功
text: No immediate success

zh: 她的经验与善意也有无能为力之处，最后需要另找一个适合帮助的人
text: Experience and kindness also have limits; at last she must find someone better placed to help

zh: 利马剧院
text: Lima’s theatre

zh: 演员与抄写员谋生的场所，舞台上的喝彩与后台的苛求往往同时存在。
text: Where actors and copyists earn their living. Applause onstage often coexists with exacting demands backstage.

zh: 一场误听
text: A misunderstanding

zh: 驱动观众的回应
text: The audience’s response

zh: 演出的切换
text: A change in the performance

zh: 正剧两幕之间，演员脱开角色，唱临时编排的时事歌曲
text: Between two acts of the serious play, the actress leaves her role to sing improvised topical songs

zh: 三种听见
text: Three ways of hearing

zh: 演员得到欢呼，少女感到羞辱，侯爵夫人却沉浸在对远方女儿的思念
text: The actress hears cheers, the girl feels humiliation, and the Marquesa remains absorbed in thoughts of her distant daughter

zh: 舞台后的后果
text: Consequences beyond the stage

zh: 公开的嘲弄引来总督干预，也使演员在登门时受到自己的良心追问
text: Public mockery brings the Viceroy’s intervention and confronts the actress with her conscience during her visit

zh: 没有散场的要求
text: Demands that outlast the curtain

zh: 劳动的依据
text: The basis of their work

zh: 高频的演出
text: Frequent performances

zh: 剧团常需不断更换剧目，记词、背诵和排练是长久而紧张的劳动
text: An ever-changing repertoire makes learning lines, memorizing and rehearsing prolonged, demanding work

zh: 更高的尺度
text: A higher measure

zh: 老师与演员都知道观众已经满意，却仍试图接近自己想象中的完美
text: Teacher and actress know the audience is satisfied, yet still seek the perfection they imagine

zh: 离开的理由
text: Reasons to leave

zh: 女性角色有限，劳作与侮辱消耗意愿，舞台成就不必是一个人唯一的归处
text: Limited female roles, toil and humiliation wear down her desire; theatrical success need not be her only place to belong

zh: 克卢克桑布夸圣所
text: Shrine of Cluxambuqua

zh: 安第斯山中的朝圣地，白墙、钟声、喷泉与清澈的空气环绕着它。
text: An Andean place of pilgrimage, surrounded by white walls, bells, a fountain and clear mountain air.

zh: 山中客栈
text: Mountain inn

zh: 朝圣途中暂住的房间，两封命运不同的信在这里被写下、读到或撕毁。
text: A room on the pilgrimage where two letters with different fates are written, read or torn up.

zh: 一晚的生活
text: One evening’s life

zh: 需要备好的燃料
text: Fuel to be prepared

zh: 主人的主要食物
text: Her mistress’s main food

zh: 女孩特意去厨房交代粥的做法，之后又下楼检查味道
text: The girl gives the kitchen particular instructions for porridge, then goes downstairs to check its taste

zh: 两封信的区别
text: The difference between two letters

zh: 佩皮塔写求助，母亲重新学习写得宽厚；前者被撕去，后者保存下来
text: Pepita appeals for help; the mother learns to write more generously. One letter is torn up, the other preserved

zh: 真实的日期关系
text: The actual timing

zh: 天亮写完信以后，两人隔了两天才启程返城，并非当晨马上遇难
text: After finishing the letter at dawn, they wait two days before setting out for Lima; they do not die that same morning

zh: 双胞胎的房间
text: The twins’ room

zh: 兄弟共住的出租房，两张床与一张抄写桌见证了默契、隔阂和照料。
text: The brothers’ rented room. Two beds and a copying table witness understanding, estrangement and care.

zh: 共同生活的改变
text: A shared life changes

zh: 病中不断更换的物件
text: What is repeatedly replaced during illness

zh: 桌边的深夜
text: Late at the table

zh: 一人伏案代笔，另一人卧床旁观，亲近的空间里第一次出现无法共享的心事
text: One takes dictation while the other watches from bed; for the first time the close room holds a feeling they cannot share

zh: 邻居的反应
text: The neighbors’ response

zh: 夜间哭喊与诅咒引来投诉，照料者必须同时承受屋内与屋外的压力
text: Cries and curses at night bring complaints, placing the caregiver under pressure from within and outside the room

zh: 之后的空缺
text: The emptiness afterward

zh: 死亡发生后，生还者不肯再进这栋楼，却仍一次次走回附近
text: After the death, the survivor refuses to enter the building but keeps returning to its neighborhood

zh: 库斯科
text: Cuzco

zh: 埃斯特班漂泊后做抄写工作的城镇，船长到这里邀请他远航。
text: Where Esteban works as a copyist after his wanderings, and where the Captain comes to invite him to sea.

zh: 总督府
text: Viceroy’s palace

zh: 礼仪繁复的权力中心，也有聚谈到天明、暂时排遣乡愁的夜宴。
text: A center of elaborate etiquette and power, but also of suppers that last until dawn and briefly ease homesickness.

zh: 向天亮延长的谈话
text: Talking until daylight

zh: 钟情文学与语言的宾客
text: The guest who loves literature and language

zh: 夜宴的组成
text: The supper company

zh: 总督、皮奥与船长也在桌边，演员常在演完以后才匆忙赶来
text: The Viceroy, Pio and the Captain are at the table; the actress often hurries in after her performance

zh: 谈论的范围
text: What they discuss

zh: 战争、国王、灵魂、星辰和远方国家，都成为排遣厌倦与乡愁的话题
text: Wars, kings, souls, stars and distant countries offer relief from weariness and homesickness

zh: 晨光到来时
text: When morning comes

zh: 众人不愿先离去，女演员却已疲惫地靠着主人睡着
text: No one wants to leave first, while the exhausted actress has already fallen asleep against her host

zh: 法式花园
text: French garden

zh: 山中仿照欧洲营建的花园，皮奥与卡米拉曾在黄昏的长椅旁交谈。
text: A European-style garden in the mountains, where Pio and Camila once spoke beside a bench at dusk.

zh: 黄昏的距离
text: Distance at dusk

zh: 约见双方中的长者
text: The elder of the two visitors

zh: 谈话的分歧
text: Their disagreement

zh: 他盼望重返舞台或共同远行，她已无意再靠艺术赢得整个未来
text: He hopes for a return to the stage or a journey together; she no longer wants art to determine her whole future

zh: 迟来的道歉
text: A belated apology

zh: 皮奥承认过去出于骄傲，舍不得给出学生应得的赞美
text: Pio admits that pride kept him from giving his pupil the praise she deserved

zh: 没有答应的温柔
text: Tenderness without agreement

zh: 临走吻手指留下真实的亲近，却并未改变对重返剧院的拒绝
text: Her parting kiss on his fingers is real closeness, but does not reverse her refusal to return to the theatre

zh: 卡米拉的山庄
text: Camila’s villa

zh: 卡米拉离开城市后的住所，病后紧闭的门窗使照料与拒绝反复相遇。
text: Camila’s home outside the city. After her illness, its shut doors and windows become a meeting place for care and refusal.

zh: 房门内外
text: On either side of the door

zh: 闯入私人一刻的映照
text: What reflects an intrusion

zh: 病后的住所
text: Her home after illness

zh: 女主人离开利马，退还馈赠，把生活缩进山中房间与田庄
text: She leaves Lima, returns gifts and withdraws into the mountain rooms and estate

zh: 对外的禁令
text: The ban on visiting

zh: 镜前的秘密被看见以后，她明确要求皮奥不许再进院子
text: After her secret at the mirror is exposed, she expressly forbids Pio to enter even the courtyard

zh: 未获允许的再次来访
text: Another unauthorized visit

zh: 假扮少女的哭声使她亲自下楼，来访者借此绕过了先前的拒绝
text: Imitating a girl’s crying draws her downstairs and allows the visitor to circumvent her earlier refusal

zh: 圣路易斯雷大桥
text: Bridge of San Luis Rey

zh: 横跨河谷的植物纤维索桥，薄木板承载行人；五条不同的人生在一次寻常过河中相遇。
text: A plant-fiber suspension bridge over the gorge, its thin boards carrying pedestrians. Five different lives meet in an ordinary crossing.

zh: 朝圣的去程
text: The outward pilgrimage

zh: 母女故事中的山中目的地
text: The mountain destination in the mother’s story

zh: 旅途中住宿处
text: Where the travellers stay

zh: 桥的构造
text: The bridge’s construction

zh: 植物纤维编成绳索，薄木板供人行走，货物和车马另在下方渡运
text: Braided plant-fiber ropes and thin boards carry pedestrians; cargo and animals cross below

zh: 两次经过
text: Two crossings

zh: 玛丽亚与佩皮塔先越桥进山，隔了数日才在返城时再次经过
text: María and Pepita first cross toward the mountains, returning several days later on their way to Lima

zh: 不能补写的保证
text: No guarantee to add

zh: 重新写信是一种改变，并不能使任何人预知或免于随后到来的桥难
text: Writing anew marks a change, but gives no one foreknowledge of, or protection from, the coming disaster

zh: 两条过河的路
text: Two ways across

zh: 通过桥面的青年
text: The young man on the bridge

zh: 未到远航前想完成的事
text: What he hopes to do before sailing

zh: 下方的工作
text: The work below

zh: 船长去河边监督货物渡运，青年选择了常用的人行通道
text: The Captain supervises the cargo crossing at the river while the young man takes the customary footpath

zh: 事先并不知情
text: No advance knowledge

zh: 原著没有写船长早知危险，也没有把青年的过桥写成主动寻死
text: The novel does not give the Captain foreknowledge of danger or make the young man’s crossing a deliberate act of self-destruction

zh: 出发的意义
text: What setting out means

zh: 他们刚刚做过继续生活的尝试，这次事故并不取消那次陪伴本身
text: They have just tried to continue living. The accident does not cancel the companionship itself

zh: 五条来路的交会
text: Five paths converge

zh: 被背负的孩子
text: The child being carried

zh: 孩子带的夜间小物件
text: The child’s little object for the night

zh: 最后的安排
text: The last arrangement

zh: 皮奥说过桥后歇一歇，这个针对身体不适的小计划没有实现
text: Pio says they will rest on the other side; this small plan for the unwell child is never fulfilled

zh: 共有的事件
text: The shared event

zh: 玛丽亚、佩皮塔、埃斯特班、皮奥与海梅在同一次桥难中遇难
text: María, Pepita, Esteban, Pio and Jaime perish in the same bridge disaster

zh: 留下的疑问
text: The question that remains

zh: 各自的人生可以被更仔细认识，事故的终极原因却并未因此成为可证实的答案
text: Their lives can be known more closely without the ultimate cause of the accident becoming a provable answer

zh: 珠宝
text: Jewels

zh: 身份与爱意常借它们表达，也可能变成负担或必须退还的馈赠。
text: They can express rank or affection, but can also become burdens or gifts that must be returned.

zh: 金链
text: Gold chain

zh: 克拉拉希望母亲替国王另寻的首饰，在信中变成一次走入画作的想象。
text: A piece of jewelry Clara asks her mother to find for the King, transformed in a letter into an imagined visit inside a painting.

zh: 写进一幅画里
text: Written into a painting

zh: 发出请求的女儿
text: The daughter who asks

zh: 送礼的理由
text: The reason for the gift

zh: 西班牙国王赞赏女儿佩戴的链子，她请母亲再找相仿的一条
text: The King of Spain admires Clara’s chain, and she asks her mother to find another like it

zh: 信中的奇遇
text: The adventure in the letter

zh: 母亲把寻物写成半夜走入画作的幻想，使采购变成有趣的叙述
text: Her mother turns the search into a fantasy of entering a painting at midnight, making an errand into an entertaining story

zh: 应有的区别
text: The distinction to keep

zh: 走进画布是书信中的文学想象，不是她实际完成的一次奇异旅行
text: Entering the canvas is literary invention within a letter, not an extraordinary journey she actually makes

zh: 母女书信
text: Letters between mother and daughter

zh: 在秘鲁与西班牙之间往返的信件，既有机智的见闻，也有未能当面承受的索求与迟来的宽厚。
text: Letters between Peru and Spain: witty observations, demands too difficult to bear face to face, and a late generosity.

zh: 用文字靠近
text: Drawing closer through words

zh: 信中的首饰
text: The jewelry in the letter

zh: 寄出的海岸
text: The coast from which they are sent

zh: 为什么反复修改
text: Why she revises so often

zh: 母亲盼女儿读到机智的见闻时愿意微笑，多给自己一点亲近与欣赏
text: She hopes her wit and observations will make Clara smile and offer a little more closeness and appreciation

zh: 保存者
text: Who preserves them

zh: 女儿常只匆匆看过，欣赏文笔的女婿为保存这些文字起了关键作用
text: Her daughter often only glances through them. The son-in-law who admires the writing plays a crucial part in their preservation

zh: 最后一封的名称
text: The final letter’s name

zh: 第五十六封被作者自己称作第一封，指的是态度的重新开始
text: The writer calls Letter LVI her first, meaning a new beginning in her attitude

zh: 后来仍能传递的东西
text: What words can carry onward

zh: 这些文字的作者
text: Their author

zh: 信里记过的航海者
text: The seaman described in them

zh: 观察与理解
text: Observation and understanding

zh: 书信也记录别人的生活，船长失去女儿的故事让母亲联想到自己的眷恋
text: The letters record other lives too; the Captain’s loss of his daughter makes the mother think of her own attachment

zh: 抵达不了的现实
text: What writing cannot immediately achieve

zh: 写得再好也无法立即修复母女关系，但文字保存了当时真实的愿望与变化
text: However well written, the letters cannot instantly repair their relationship, but preserve the real wishes and changes of that time

zh: 另一封信的缺席
text: Another letter’s absence

zh: 少女在客栈写下的求助信已被撕去，不能假装修士后来找到完整原件
text: The girl’s appeal at the inn was torn up. It must not be treated as a complete document the friar later recovered

zh: 粥
text: Porridge

zh: 侯爵夫人常吃的食物，佩皮塔会特意向客栈厨子交代做法。
text: The Marquesa’s usual food. Pepita takes particular care to explain its preparation to the inn’s cook.

zh: 木炭
text: Charcoal

zh: 山中房间取暖所需的燃料，照看火盆也是佩皮塔的日常差事。
text: Fuel needed to warm the mountain room. Tending the brazier is one of Pepita’s daily tasks.

zh: 秘密情书
text: Secret love letters

zh: 卡米拉交给曼努埃尔代笔的私信，收信人另有其人，内容须保密。
text: Private letters Camila dictates to Manuel, addressed to other people and to be kept secret.

zh: 代写与保密
text: Dictation and secrecy

zh: 一位收信人
text: One recipient

zh: 另一类收信人
text: Other recipients

zh: 演员也向斗牛士写信，亲昵与责备都由受雇的抄写者记录
text: The actress also writes to a bullfighter; affection and reproaches alike are set down by a hired copyist

zh: 保密的范围
text: The reach of secrecy

zh: 她要求不能透露信的内容，连代笔人的双生兄弟也不得知道
text: She forbids him to reveal the contents, even to his twin brother

zh: 留下的误会
text: A misunderstanding left behind

zh: 耳旁口述看起来像亲密，实际并未使写信者成为信中爱情的对象
text: Dictation close to his ear looks intimate, but does not make the writer the object of the letters’ love

zh: 戏剧抄本
text: Copied plays

zh: 需要抄写、背诵与排练的西班牙剧作，连接着兄弟的劳动与演员的技艺。
text: Spanish plays to copy, memorize and rehearse, connecting the brothers’ labor to the actress’s craft.

zh: 抄写者的营生
text: The copyists’ livelihood

zh: 代写但不能公开的另一类文字
text: Other writing that must remain secret

zh: 文字的劳动
text: Working with words

zh: 兄弟替剧团抄分角台本，也替商人抄告示，为唱诗班抄乐谱
text: The brothers copy actors’ parts for companies, notices for merchants and music for choirs

zh: 一度离开
text: A temporary departure

zh: 抄写令他们疲倦后，曾转到海边搬货，又做过赶车和摆渡等工作
text: Weary of copying, they turn to loading cargo at the shore and also try cart-driving and ferry work

zh: 难以重回桌边
text: Unable to settle at the desk

zh: 兄弟去世后，生还者感到无法继续安坐抄写，希望海上工作填满每一天
text: After his brother dies, the survivor cannot face sitting quietly to copy and wants work at sea to fill every day

zh: 说出文字的人
text: Those who speak the words

zh: 给学生指出细节的老师
text: The teacher who points out details

zh: 记忆的压力
text: The pressure of memory

zh: 一周可能排出多部新戏，演员要记住长篇而华丽的台词
text: Several new plays may be staged in a week, requiring the actors to memorize long, ornate speeches

zh: 角色的不满
text: Dissatisfaction with the roles

zh: 许多作品把重点留给男性英雄，女演员逐渐感到女性角色过于贫乏
text: Many plays center on male heroes; the actress increasingly finds the women’s parts inadequate

zh: 共同的追求
text: A shared pursuit

zh: 老师和学生能为一句话的快慢讨论到天明，也能为诗人后人观演而同感敬畏
text: Teacher and pupil can debate the pace of one speech until dawn and share awe at performing for a poet’s descendant

zh: 药剂与膏药
text: Medicines and salves

zh: 理发师兼外科医师开出的治疗用品，未能使曼努埃尔的伤病好转。
text: Remedies prescribed by a barber-surgeon, which fail to improve Manuel’s wound and illness.

zh: 冷湿布
text: Cold wet cloth

zh: 医师吩咐每小时更换的敷布，成了照料者不敢停下、病人害怕到来的事。
text: The dressing the doctor orders changed hourly: something the caregiver dares not stop and the patient dreads.

zh: 整点将至
text: The hour approaches

zh: 同时得到的治疗用品
text: The other prescribed remedies

zh: 医嘱
text: The instruction

zh: 理发师兼外科医师要求每小时冷敷，照料者不敢轻易违反
text: The barber-surgeon orders cold applications every hour; the caregiver is reluctant to disobey

zh: 实际的痛苦
text: The pain in practice

zh: 每次敷上时病人反而最难忍，发热与痛楚使他喊出伤人的话
text: Each application is the patient’s worst moment, and fever and pain make him cry out hurtful words

zh: 两难的照料
text: The caregiver’s dilemma

zh: 清醒时的病人要求继续，兄弟却希望至少跳过一次，让他暂时不再受痛
text: When lucid, the patient asks him to continue; his brother longs to skip even one application and give him relief

zh: 十字架
text: Crucifix

zh: 病中的曼努埃尔曾借它起誓，收回疼痛中伤害兄弟的话。
text: Ill in bed, Manuel swears upon it as he retracts the words with which his pain has wounded his brother.

zh: 钱币
text: Coins

zh: 代笔的酬金与孩子的零用，显出不同关系里同一物件的不同分量。
text: A copyist’s fee or a child’s pocket money: the same object has a different weight in different relationships.

zh: 给院长的礼物
text: Gift for the abbess

zh: 埃斯特班离开前想购买的赠礼，他希望也代表亡兄；具体物品未被写明。
text: The present Esteban hopes to buy before leaving, on behalf of his dead brother too. The specific object is never named.

zh: 尚未挑选
text: Not yet chosen

zh: 拟赠与的对象
text: The intended recipient

zh: 请求的来源
text: What prompts the request

zh: 青年记得她也曾失去过人，想在远行以前为她做一点事
text: He remembers that she too has lost someone and wants to do something for her before his voyage

zh: 不止一个赠者
text: More than one giver

zh: 他想把礼物算作两兄弟共同的心意，却难以再次说出亡兄的名字
text: He wants the gift to come from both brothers, but struggles to speak the dead brother’s name again

zh: 仍未确定
text: Still undecided

zh: 船长答应早晨一起挑选，原著没有交代后来买到的具体物件
text: The Captain agrees to choose it together in the morning. The novel does not specify an object subsequently bought

zh: 披巾
text: Shawl

zh: 皮奥与卡米拉巡游时曾共用来包裹衣物，见证过旅途中的匮乏。
text: Pio and Camila once used it to bundle their clothes on tour, a witness to the poverty of those journeys.

zh: 化妆镜
text: Dressing mirror

zh: 演员整理面容的日常用具，也映出疲倦、病后希望和不期而来的注视。
text: An actress’s everyday tool, reflecting weariness, hope after illness and a gaze she did not expect.

zh: 被看见的一刻
text: The moment she is seen

zh: 使用者
text: Who uses it

zh: 舞台之后
text: After the stage

zh: 卸去表演的神情时，疲惫和不满足会在安静的脸上显出来
text: When the performing expression falls away, weariness and dissatisfaction emerge on the quiet face

zh: 病中的尝试
text: An attempt during illness

zh: 她用粉与乳脂试图遮掩病后面容，曾短暂盼望舞台经验还能帮助自己
text: She tries powder and cream to disguise her changed face, briefly hoping her stage experience can still help

zh: 隐私被打断
text: Privacy interrupted

zh: 镜里忽然出现门口的来客，使她连秘密的希望也来不及藏起
text: The unexpected visitor appears in the mirror before she can hide even her secret hope

zh: 发亮的小石头
text: Little shining stone

zh: 母亲给海梅的小物件，让他在失眠的黑夜里观看，材质未被原著说明。
text: The little object Jaime’s mother gives him to look at on sleepless nights. The novel does not identify its material.

zh: 失眠时可以看
text: Something to look at when sleepless

zh: 同放进行李的零用
text: Pocket money packed with it

zh: 交付的人
text: Who gives it

zh: 孩子出发时由母亲给予，用在夜里无法入睡的时刻
text: His mother gives it to him at departure, for the nights when he cannot sleep

zh: 没有说明的部分
text: What is not specified

zh: 原著没有确定石头的材质，也没有赋予它预言或保护生命的作用
text: The novel does not name the stone’s material or give it powers of prophecy or protection

zh: 具体的心意
text: A particular kindness

zh: 母亲不能消除孩子的病弱，却仍尝试给陌生夜晚留一个可以注视的小物件
text: His mother cannot remove his frailty, but tries to leave him something to look at through unfamiliar nights

zh: 孤独
text: Loneliness

zh: 在人群、家庭与华贵房间里，都可能找不到可以放心开口的人。
text: Even in crowds, families and splendid rooms, a person may find no one to whom it feels safe to speak.

zh: 服从
text: Obedience

zh: 习惯听从要求的女孩，有时难以判断自己何时可以离开原地。
text: A girl used to following instructions may find it hard to know when she is allowed to leave her post.

zh: 勇气
text: Courage

zh: 一个女孩用它评判求助信，一位母亲却由此开始重新审视自己怎样去爱。
text: A girl uses the word to judge her appeal for help; a mother hears it and begins to reconsider how she loves.

zh: 谁使用了这个词
text: Who uses this word?

zh: 第一次给出这个判断的人
text: Who first makes the judgment

zh: 被评判的东西
text: What she judges

zh: 她以不够勇敢否定自己的求助信，随后把信带回房间撕掉
text: She calls her appeal insufficiently brave, takes it back to her room and tears it up

zh: 母亲的回应
text: The mother’s response

zh: 听见这个词以后，侯爵夫人回顾自己怎样索取爱情，决定重新写信
text: Hearing the word, the Marquesa looks back at how she has demanded love and decides to write anew

zh: 不等于统一准则
text: No universal rule

zh: 少女的自我要求与母亲受到的触动可以同时存在，沉默求助并非必须赞美的行为
text: The girl’s self-demand and its effect on the mother can coexist; suppressing a plea for help need not be praised

zh: 双生私语
text: The twins’ private language

zh: 兄弟自幼创造的语言，只在彼此之间使用，外人的好奇使它难以开口。
text: The language the brothers invent as children and use between themselves, made difficult to speak by outsiders’ curiosity.

zh: 只属于两人
text: Belonging only to two

zh: 想把它记录下来的人
text: Who wants to record it

zh: 形成的时间
text: When it begins

zh: 兄弟从开始学说话时便创造私语，并不只是替西班牙语换几个词
text: They invent it as they learn to speak; it is more than substituting a few words for Spanish

zh: 使用的场合
text: When they use it

zh: 通常仅在独处时使用，紧迫时偶尔在人前低声说几句
text: Usually only in private, though urgency sometimes brings a whispered phrase before others

zh: 被询问的感受
text: How questioning feels

zh: 回答简单词语竟使他们极难堪，记录者最后察觉这不只是畏惧身份
text: Even answering simple vocabulary questions embarrasses them deeply; the recorder finally sees that rank alone is not the cause

zh: 掌声
text: Applause

zh: 它可以赞美技艺，也能纵容伤人；观众的热烈不保证台上人的满足。
text: It can honor skill or encourage cruelty. An audience’s enthusiasm does not guarantee a performer’s satisfaction.

zh: 体面身份
text: Respectability

zh: 卡米拉离开剧场后努力争取的社会位置，带来新的门槛，也未消除旧的不安。
text: The social position Camila seeks after leaving the theatre, bringing new thresholds without ending old unease.

zh: 新的位置
text: A new position

zh: 承载新生活的住所
text: The home of her new life

zh: 公开的努力
text: Public efforts

zh: 前往时髦的弥撒、大学仪式和慈善场合，为孩子争取被承认的身份
text: She attends fashionable Masses, university ceremonies and charitable occasions, seeking recognized status for her children

zh: 排斥的旧事
text: The past she rejects

zh: 她开始把演戏说作消遣，也逐渐限制旧日老师的公开与私下探访
text: She begins to call acting a diversion and gradually restricts her former teacher’s public and private visits

zh: 未兑现的幸福
text: Happiness not delivered

zh: 得到了更高的社会位置，仍没有因此学会怎样在自己的日子里安宁下来
text: Higher social standing does not teach her how to find peace within her own days

zh: 天意
text: Providence

zh: 胡尼佩尔试图用调查证明的安排；书中人物有不同理解，事实并未给出定论。
text: The design Juniper tries to prove by inquiry. Characters understand it differently; the facts do not settle the question.

zh: 相信与证明
text: Belief and proof

zh: 追索者
text: Who pursues the question

zh: 一次先前的失败
text: An earlier failure

zh: 瘟疫中的道德评分产生了与预想相反的结果，他最终撕去记录
text: His moral scoring during a plague produces the opposite of his expected result, and he eventually tears up the record

zh: 调查的困难
text: The difficulty of inquiry

zh: 不同关系带来不同说法，最亲近的人也未必能毫无保留地讲述死者
text: Different relationships bring different accounts; even those closest to the dead may not speak without reserve

zh: 保留的未知
text: The unknown that remains

zh: 五段人生的细节能被认识，却不能据此宣布灾难是惩罚或奖赏
text: Details of five lives can be discovered without declaring their deaths a punishment or a reward

zh: 照料
text: Care

zh: 在人不能替彼此解除痛苦时，留下、送水、准备食物，仍是可以做的事。
text: When people cannot take away one another’s pain, staying, bringing water and preparing food remain possible.

zh: 仍可以做的小事
text: Small things still possible

zh: 少女曾准备的食物
text: The food the girl prepares

zh: 孩子不舒服的时候
text: When the child feels ill

zh: 皮奥察觉乘车颠簸不利，改用肩膀扛着他继续走
text: Pio notices that the jolting ride hurts him and carries him on his shoulder instead

zh: 遭到拒绝的时候
text: When help is refused

zh: 对方的边界不会因为照料者心怀善意而自动取消
text: Another person’s boundaries do not automatically disappear because a caregiver means well

zh: 失去以后
text: After loss

zh: 送水、陪伴、准备食物和安排病房，继续把活着的人联系在一起
text: Water, company, food and arrangements in the wards continue to connect those who are alive

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 珠宝的重量
text: The Weight of Jewels

zh: [[NPC1]]的父亲做布匹生意，挣到了钱，也挣来了邻人的憎恶。他们家离大广场很近，可这并没有使女儿更容易走进城里的生活。她说话结巴，相貌不讨人喜欢。母亲一心要把她训练成善于交际的姑娘，越是看不见成效，讥刺的话便越尖。
text: [[NPC1]]'s father made his fortune in cloth, and earned his neighbours' dislike along with it. Their house stood near the great square, but that did not make it easier for his daughter to enter the life of the city. She stammered and was not considered pretty. Her mother was determined to make her sociable; the less progress she saw, the sharper her ridicule became.

zh: 出门以前，母亲把{{e_jewels|珠宝}}一件件挂在她身上。金银不曾替她开口，反倒像一副显眼的挽具，使每次畏缩都暴露在人前。她独自生活，也独自想事情。提亲的人陆续来了；他们看见的财富，比她自己更容易说得清楚。
text: Before they went out, her mother hung {{e_jewels|Jewels}} upon her, one piece after another. Gold and silver could not speak for her. They served instead as a conspicuous harness, exposing every shrinking movement to the room. She lived alone with her thoughts. Suitors began to call; what they saw in her fortune was easier to explain than what they saw in her.

zh: 她坚持不结婚。母女为此争吵，彼此责备，房门一次次摔上。她以为只要守住这件事，至少还有一部分生活可以由自己决定。但这场抵抗一直拖到二十六岁，结局仍是一桩婚姻。新郎是个家道中落、态度傲慢的贵族。
text: She insisted that she would never marry. Mother and daughter quarrelled, accused each other, slammed doors. She believed that if she held her ground on this one matter, some part of her life might remain her own. Her resistance lasted until she was twenty-six. It ended in marriage to an impoverished, haughty nobleman.

zh: 婚礼上，教堂里满是客人压低声音的讥笑。布商的钱换来了一个称号，称号却没替她挡住那些目光。后来她有了自己的宅邸，有了仆人，人们见面时也须郑重地叫她侯爵夫人。只有那种独自坐着、等别人愿意亲近自己的习惯，没有随着身份改变。
text: At the wedding the church was full of the guests' whispered mockery. The cloth merchant's money had purchased a title, but the title could not shield her from their looks. In time she had a great house and servants, and people were obliged to address her formally as the Marquesa. Only the habit of sitting alone, waiting for someone to want her company, survived the change in rank.

zh: 多年以后，她又给另一个小女孩戴上自己的全部希望。那个孩子叫{{e_clara|克拉拉}}，美得使她几乎不敢相信。她终于有了一个可以毫无保留去爱的人；至于怎样让这个人自由地长大，她还没有学会。
text: Years later she placed all her hopes upon another little girl. The child's name was {{e_clara|Clara}}, and her beauty seemed almost unbelievable. At last there was someone she could love without reserve. She had not yet learned how to let that person grow freely.

zh: 玛丽亚
text: María

zh: 婚礼的杂音
text: The Murmurs at the Wedding

zh: 我听得见。{{e_lima|利马}}的教堂那么大，低声说话的人又那么多，每一句都像离我很远，又像紧贴着耳朵。只要不抬头，就不用弄明白是哪一张脸在笑。我已经穿好了他们要我穿的衣服，嫁给了他们愿意接纳的人，为什么还没有做对？
text: I can hear them. The church in {{e_lima|Lima}} is so large, and so many people are speaking softly. Every word seems far away and right against my ear. If I do not look up, I need not discover whose face is laughing. I have put on the clothes they wanted me to wear and married the man they were willing to accept. Why have I still not done it right?

zh: 母亲嫌我不会说话。急的时候，一个字要在嘴里撞好几次才肯出来；别人已经开始替我着急，或者替我难堪。我独处时却有那么多话。没有人打断，我能把一件事从头想到底，甚至想出一句足以让人笑的话。可等到坐在人前，那句话就不见了。
text: Mother dislikes the way I speak. When I am nervous, a word has to strike against my mouth several times before it comes out. People have already begun to feel impatient, or embarrassed for me. Yet alone I have so much to say. Without interruptions I can think a thing through, even invent a remark that might make someone laugh. When I sit before them, the remark is gone.

zh: 我曾想一辈子不嫁。门关起来的时候，好像还可以这样想；门重新打开，账目、亲戚、提亲的人仍在外面等着。我不知道他们究竟等的是谁。
text: Once I thought I would never marry. With the door shut, it still seemed possible. When the door opened again, the accounts, the relations and the suitors were all waiting outside. I did not know quite whom they were waiting for.

zh: 这副{{e_jewels|珠宝}}还在。它比我的话更容易获得注视。我多么想有一天，谁走到我身边，只是因为愿意和我坐一会儿。到那时候，我一定不会让那个人再觉得孤单。他们称我夫人，我仍不知道怎样抬头。
text: These {{e_jewels|Jewels}} are still here. They attract attention more easily than my words. How I wish that one day someone would come to my side simply because they wanted to sit with me for a while. I would never let that person feel lonely again. They call me señora. I still do not know how to lift my head.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 八岁的纠正
text: A Correction at Eight

zh: [[NPC2]]八岁的时候，已经会平静地纠正母亲说错的词。她像父亲，聪明，冷静，看着别人的激动，也能把自己留在那激动之外。[[NPC1]]则越来越害怕女儿脸上的惊讶。她努力温顺，努力讨好，时时留意孩子需要什么，却总在孩子尚未需要的时候就抢着递到面前。
text: By the time [[NPC2]] was eight, she could calmly correct her mother's choice of words. She resembled her father: clever, composed, able to watch another person's agitation without sharing it. [[NPC1]], meanwhile, grew increasingly afraid of her daughter's startled looks. She tried to be gentle, tried to please, watched for every need—and invariably offered the thing before the child had wanted it.

zh: 这样的照顾很难推开。拒绝一件小事，仿佛就否认了全部的爱；勉强接受，下一次问候又跟着来了。女儿疲惫，母亲惊惶。争执之后，两扇门分别关上，同一所房子忽然变得很大。母亲独坐时，把刚才的对话在心里重新说了一遍又一遍，每回都想找出一句可以把女儿叫回来的话。
text: Such attentions were difficult to refuse. Reject one small favour and it seemed that you had rejected all the love behind it; accept reluctantly, and the next enquiry followed. The daughter grew weary, the mother alarmed. After an argument two doors closed, and the same house suddenly became enormous. Sitting alone, the mother rehearsed their conversation over and over, searching each time for a sentence that might bring her daughter back.

zh: 别人以后常说，这个女儿没有心肠。可是她成年后会慷慨地帮助朋友、仆人和有才华的陌生人，照顾他们，像照顾自己的孩子。她的冷淡并不平均分给所有的人。偏偏面对那个最希望得到她柔情的人，她总觉得必须先守住一点距离。
text: People would later call this daughter heartless. Yet as an adult she generously helped friends, servants and gifted strangers, tending to them as if they were her children. Her coldness was not bestowed equally upon everyone. Before the one person who most longed for her tenderness, she felt she must first defend a little distance.

zh: 提亲的机会多了起来。母亲想象的是有人加入她们的生活；女儿考虑的，却是怎样离开。她最终选择的婚事，要求她去{{e_spain|西班牙}}定居。那并非邻近的一条街，而是一封信送出去之后，要等上半年才可能得到答复的地方。
text: More proposals arrived. The mother imagined someone joining their life; the daughter considered how to leave it. The marriage she finally chose required her to settle in {{e_spain|Spain}}. It was not the next street. A letter sent there might wait half a year for an answer.

zh: 行李逐渐装好。那些曾经因争吵而关闭的房门，这回会在女儿走后一直敞着。母亲能替她添一件东西，能再问一句旅途中要不要用，却不能靠这些细小的忙碌，取消那片已经挡在她们之间的海。
text: Little by little the luggage was packed. The doors that had once closed after quarrels would stand open after the daughter left. Her mother could add another possession to a trunk, ask whether something might be needed on the journey. None of these small errands could abolish the sea already lying between them.

zh: 玛丽亚
text: María

zh: 门后没有回答
text: No Answer Behind the Door

zh: {{e_clara|克拉拉}}又把门关上了。我知道不该马上过去。隔着门问她是不是生气，会使她更生气；如果一直不问，她又怎么知道我在等呢？
text: {{e_clara|Clara}} has shut the door again. I know I should not go to it at once. Asking through the wood whether she is angry will only make her angrier. But if I never ask, how will she know I am waiting?

zh: 她纠正我的时候，我并不恼她。她那么聪明，我本该高兴。我只是有一点怕：一句话说错以后，接下来无论说什么，好像都得先经过她的允许。于是我说得更多，把一件小事解释得很长，直到她露出我最不愿看见的疲倦。
text: I am not angry when she corrects me. She is so clever; I ought to be pleased. I am only a little afraid. Once I have said something wrong, whatever follows seems to require her permission. So I talk still more, explaining a small matter at great length, until the weariness I most dread appears on her face.

zh: 我小时候也怕一扇突然打开的门，怕母亲进来问我为什么又这样站着、为什么不能像别人家的姑娘。我怎么会让自己的孩子，也想从房间里逃出去？我给她的和我曾经得到的，明明应当不一样。
text: As a child I feared a door suddenly opening too: Mother coming in to ask why I was standing like that again, why I could not be like other girls. How have I made my own child want to escape her room? Surely what I give her ought to be different from what I received.

zh: 只要她出来，说一句没有怪我，我就可以安静下来。或者不用说，坐到我旁边也好。{{e_loneliness|孤独}}本来是我一个人的事，可我总要她给一个答复，才肯相信今天可以过去。我听着门里的声音，连自己也觉得，这样等下去会使她难受。屋里安静下来，我反倒更怕那一刻。
text: If she would come out and say she did not blame me, I could be quiet. She need not even say it. She could sit beside me. {{e_loneliness|Loneliness}} was mine alone, yet I keep requiring an answer from her before I can believe that today may pass. I listen to the sounds behind her door. Even I can see that this waiting must distress her. When the room grows quiet, I am more frightened still.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 海上的赞歌
text: A Hymn Across the Water

zh: 船启程前，人们举行了祝福的仪式。去那么遥远的地方，告别不能只是拥抱和挥手：岸上和船上的两群人一起跪下，唱起赞歌。宽阔的海面接住了声音，却没有把声音送得更有力量。歌声显得薄，显得迟疑，船身和岸之间的水已经开始加宽。
text: Before the ship sailed, a blessing was given. For so distant a journey, embraces and waving could not be enough: people aboard and people ashore knelt together and sang a hymn. The wide sea received their voices without making them stronger. The singing sounded thin, hesitant. Already the water between the hull and the shore was widening.

zh: [[NPC1]]十分镇静。她选择了必须前往{{e_spain|西班牙}}的婚事，现在正走向自己选中的生活。身后的母亲站在岸边，手一会儿按住心口，一会儿捂住嘴，仿佛只要不让什么东西从胸中冲出来，这场告别还能保持它应有的体面。
text: [[NPC1]] was perfectly composed. She had chosen a marriage that would take her to {{e_spain|Spain}}, and was moving towards the life she had chosen. Behind her, her mother stood on the shore, pressing a hand now to her heart, now to her mouth, as though the farewell might retain its dignity if only she could keep something from bursting out of her chest.

zh: [[NPC2]]眼前的帆船越来越亮，轮廓却越来越模糊。泪水把宁静的太平洋划成一道道水痕。海上那些巨大的珍珠色云朵似乎永远停在那里；人却会沿着它们下面的一条航线离开，去到不能随时敲门、也不能立刻听见回话的地方。
text: The sailing ship grew brighter before [[NPC2]]'s eyes, while its outline grew less distinct. Tears streaked the tranquil Pacific. The huge pearl-coloured clouds seemed as if they would remain there forever. People could sail away beneath them, however, to a place where one could not knock on a door at any moment or hear an immediate reply.

zh: 船上的女儿没有显出母亲所盼望的慌乱。镇静可以是远行的勇气，也可以是终于得到距离的轻松；岸上的人无法凭一个遥远的身影判断。母亲只是看着，直到那只船再也不能替她区分出甲板上的人。
text: The daughter aboard showed none of the distress her mother hoped to see. Composure might mean courage before a voyage, or relief at having at last obtained distance. From the shore, one could not judge by so remote a figure. The mother watched until the ship no longer allowed her to distinguish anyone on its deck.

zh: 以后，{{e_letters|书信}}会往返于两片大陆。装船的日期将成为她生活的刻度，女儿愿意写下的几句话会被反复展开。眼前这片水，终究不会因为她一次又一次读信，就缩短一点。船身也受过祝福，却没有人替岸上的母亲解释，怎样让这场告别结束。
text: In time, {{e_letters|Letters}} would travel between the two continents. Sailing dates would become the measure of her life, and the few sentences her daughter chose to write would be unfolded again and again. No amount of rereading would shorten this water. The ship too had received its blessing. No one had explained to the mother on the shore how to bring this farewell to an end.

zh: 玛丽亚
text: María

zh: 吻过的门
text: The Door She Kissed

zh: 离上一次分别，已经四年了。来的时候，我在船上对自己说，不要扑过去，不要流泪，不要把这些年的话一下子全压到{{e_clara|克拉拉}}身上。能和她住在同一座房子里，已经够好了。
text: Four years have passed since we last parted. On the voyage here I told myself: do not rush towards her, do not weep, do not lay all those years of words upon {{e_clara|Clara}} at once. To live in the same house as her is already enough.

zh: 她也曾努力。我们都明白，先前有些话不应该说。这一回，我只要不问得太多，她只要再耐心一点，我们大概就能坐下来，好好吃一顿饭。可饭还没有吃完，我已经听见自己的声音变了；她放下手里的东西，我们又回到了最熟悉的那一刻。
text: She tried too. We both knew that some things should never have been said. This time, if I asked a little less and she was a little more patient, perhaps we could sit down to a peaceful meal. Before it was over I heard my voice change. She put down what she was holding. We had returned to the moment we knew best.

zh: {{e_spain|西班牙}}的天还没有亮。她睡在门里，我站在门外。叫醒她，必定又要告别，又要解释，又要为本来想说得很轻的话哭起来。还是让她睡吧。我把嘴唇贴了一下门板，只一下。门没有开，这次我也不敲。
text: Dawn has not yet come in {{e_spain|Spain}}. She sleeps behind the door; I stand outside it. If I wake her, there will be another farewell, more explanations, more tears over words I had meant to say lightly. Let her sleep. I press my lips to the door, just once. It does not open. This time I do not knock.

zh: 回去以后，纸会比我安静。写错的句子可以删掉，急切的话可以重新写。她不必看着我费力地说，我也不必立刻看见，她读到哪里已经疲倦。明天仍要过，船也不会等到我终于学会告别。
text: When I am home again, paper will be quieter than I am. A mistaken sentence can be crossed out; an urgent one rewritten. She need not watch me struggle to speak, and I need not see at once where she has grown tired of reading. Tomorrow must still be lived. The ship will not wait until I have finally learned to say goodbye.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 装船以前
text: Before the Mail Sails

zh: 临近寄信的日子，[[NPC1]]又出门了。她忍受宴席和街上的目光，听别人谈{{e_court|总督府}}里的怪事，读{{e_scripts|西班牙戏剧}}，找出一两件足以写进{{e_letters|书信}}的见闻。她并不缺钱，也不指望这些文章给自己挣来名声。她想要的是女儿读着读着，忽然笑一下。她也留意{{e_camila|卡米拉}}这样的名人，记住她在{{e_theatre|剧院}}里的声名。
text: As the mailing day approached, [[NPC1]] ventured out again. She endured dinners and looks in the street, listened to strange events at the {{e_court|Viceregal Court}}, read {{e_scripts|Spanish Plays}}, and sought a story or two for her {{e_letters|Letters}}. She did not lack money or expect these compositions to win her fame. She wanted her daughter to smile suddenly as she read. She followed celebrated people such as {{e_camila|Camila}}, remembering the actress's reputation at the {{e_theatre|Theatre}}.

zh: {{e_clara|克拉拉}}曾说，国王赞赏过她戴的{{e_goldchain|金链}}，要母亲尽快再找一条相仿的送去。母亲于是把采买写成一场奇遇：自己半夜钻进一幅画，画家伸手拉她越过颜料，她向画中人说明，是世上最美的姑娘想送礼给世上最有礼貌的国王。那是信里的玩笑；她真能跨越的，仍然只有一张纸。
text: {{e_clara|Clara}} had written that the king admired her {{e_goldchain|Gold Chain}} and asked her mother to send a similar one as soon as possible. Her mother turned the purchase into an adventure: at midnight she climbed into a painting, the painter reached through the colours to help her, and she explained to its inhabitants that the loveliest girl in the world wished to present a gift to the most courteous king. It was a joke in a letter. The only surface she could truly cross remained a sheet of paper.

zh: 她写女儿的伤风，写修女推销的树胶，郑重劝告之后，又忍不住添一句尖俏的观察。忧虑和机智挨在一起，像她想说的两种话：好好照顾自己；也请多看母亲一眼。夜越来越深，她把已经写好的句子重新排列，直到那份沉重的愿望终于显得轻巧。
text: She wrote of her daughter's cold, of the gum sold by the nuns. After solemn advice she could not resist adding a sharp observation. Anxiety and wit sat side by side, like the two things she wanted to say: take good care of yourself; and spare another glance for your mother. As the night deepened she rearranged her sentences until the heavy wish appeared light.

zh: 天亮以前，信封和礼物装成一包，等着送给经手海运的人。这封信离手后，她往往又退回酒与昏睡里，直至下一次邮期临近。后来保存这些信的，主要是欣赏文笔的女婿。女儿大多只匆匆看过。
text: Before dawn, the envelope and presents were wrapped together to await the shipping agent. Once the letter left her hands, she often retreated into drink and sleep until the next mailing day drew near. The letters were chiefly preserved by her son-in-law, who admired their style. Her daughter generally glanced through them.

zh: 许多年以后，学生会学习这些句子，学者会争论她怎样经营风格。此刻桌边的女人却没有看那么远。她只是把纸折好，希望这一次，海的另一头能有一点回音。
text: Many years later, students would study these sentences and scholars would debate the making of her style. The woman at the desk was not looking so far ahead. She merely folded the paper, hoping that this time there might be some echo from across the sea.

zh: 玛丽亚
text: María

zh: 绿色阳台
text: The Green Balcony

zh: 我想，胸口这地方是不是真的坏了。如果一个医生把它剖开，能不能看见这些年的痕迹？我把这个念头写给{{e_clara|克拉拉}}，她却责备我，说我只顾着研究自己，把悲伤奉为神明。
text: I wonder whether something here in my chest has truly gone wrong. If a physician opened it, could he see the traces of these years? I wrote the thought to {{e_clara|Clara}}. She reproached me for studying only myself and making a god of sorrow.

zh: 坐在{{e_palace|侯爵府}}的阳台上，看别人亲吻、问候，很容易怀疑他们都是做给旁人看的。我知道这种念头刻薄，却仍想：如果他们没有像我这样受苦，他们的爱凭什么是真的？
text: From the balcony of the {{e_palace|Marquesa's House}}, it is easy to watch people kissing and greeting one another and suspect that they perform it for an audience. I know the thought is cruel. Still I ask myself: if they have not suffered as I have, what makes their love real?

zh: 再想下去，我便不敢抬头了。我要她爱我，也要她承认我比别的母亲都好。我盼着她说一句原谅我，仿佛所有过错都在她那边。连我所想象的和好，最后也总要由她低头。
text: Then I am afraid to raise my eyes. I want her to love me, and to admit that I am better than other mothers. I wait for her to ask my forgiveness, as though every fault lay on her side. Even the reconciliation I imagine must end with her yielding.

zh: 她已经把几千英里的距离放在我们中间。我甚至没有机会再支配她，心里却还在和这种欲望角力。写下一页温柔的话，不等于真的能放开手；可除了再写一页，我还会做什么？
text: She has placed thousands of miles between us. I have no opportunity left to rule her, yet I am still wrestling with the desire. A page of tenderness does not mean that I can let go. But what else do I know how to do, except write another page?

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 洗衣池边
text: Beside the Washing Trough

zh: [[NPC1]]担心的不是自己会死，而是自己死后，那些病床、孤儿和无处可去的女人会怎样。她半夜算完账，常想象女人有一天能组织起来，保护远行的女人、做仆人的女人、矿井里和工场里的女人。清晨，她仍得为这一个月的费用四处奔走。
text: [[NPC1]] feared less for her own death than for the sickbeds, orphans and homeless women who would remain after it. Finishing her accounts at night, she often imagined a day when women might organise to protect women travelling alone, women in service, women in mines and workshops. In the morning she still had to go begging for this month's expenses.

zh: 她开始寻找一个接班的人。病房、院子、长廊，她走得很快，看过一张张脸，又因自己太急而失望。最后她在洗衣池边停下来：一个十二岁的女孩正指挥同伴干活，同时兴致勃勃地讲利马圣女罗莎的奇迹，把那故事讲得十分有声有色。那个女孩就是[[NPC2]]。
text: She began to look for a successor. Through wards, courtyards and corridors she hurried, inspecting face after face, disappointed by her own haste. At last she stopped beside the washing trough. A twelve-year-old girl was directing the others at their work while telling the miracles of Saint Rose of Lima with tremendous dramatic enthusiasm. That girl was [[NPC2]].

zh: 此后最不讨喜欢的差事，常常分到女孩手里。跟着外出时，她抱着鸡蛋和蔬菜；留下来时，她学会院子里各项事务怎样运转。有时工作正做到一半，黑衣的长者突然叫住她，谈怎样安排传染病房，怎样管理众人，怎样向有钱人开口。那些话不只是命令，竟像在向一个同事交代。
text: From then on the least popular duties often fell to the girl. On journeys she carried eggs and vegetables; at home she learned how each part of the institution worked. Sometimes, in the middle of a task, the older woman in black would call her aside and discuss the arrangement of contagious wards, the management of people, or how to ask the wealthy for money. These were not merely orders. It was almost as if a colleague were being briefed.

zh: {{e_maria|玛丽亚}}来借一名孤女作伴时，院长看见了机会：女孩能接触外面的世界，富有的老妇人也许能被引向有用的事业。她衡量着这件安排给女孩的压力，觉得自己知道何时应当收手。
text: When {{e_maria|María}} came to borrow an orphan as a companion, the abbess saw an opportunity. The girl would encounter the world outside; perhaps the rich old woman could be turned towards useful work. She weighed the strain the arrangement would impose upon the girl and believed she knew when to draw back.

zh: 女孩先是偶尔过去几个下午，后来终于搬去长住。两年的训练，使她学会了许多责任；至于怎样承认自己承担不了，她并没有受到同样仔细的教导。
text: At first the girl visited for occasional afternoons. Eventually she went to live there. Two years of training had taught her many responsibilities. No one had taught her with equal care how to admit that a burden was too much.

zh: 佩皮塔
text: Pepita

zh: 被当作大人
text: Treated as a Grown-Up

zh: {{e_abbess|院长}}有时会突然来找我。明明我手里还抱着鸡蛋，她已经开始说病房的事，说把哪两个人放在一起会吵架，向什么人求助才不至于白跑一趟。我以为这些话应该对别的大人说，可她一直看着我，像我也能够懂。
text: Sometimes {{e_abbess|Mother Pilar}} comes to find me without warning. I am still holding the eggs when she begins to talk about the wards, about which two people will quarrel if put together, or whom we should ask for help so the journey will not be wasted. I thought such things ought to be said to other grown-ups. But she keeps looking at me, as if I can understand them too.

zh: 我愿意记住。她交代的每件事都有人在等，病人不能因为我害怕就少吃一顿饭，屋顶也不能因为钱难借就一直漏下去。听她说话时，我觉得自己离那些事很近，好像只要再努力一点，就能成为她需要的人。
text: I want to remember. Someone is waiting for everything she asks. The sick cannot miss a meal because I am afraid; the roof cannot keep leaking because money is hard to borrow. When I listen to her, those things feel close. Perhaps if I try a little harder, I can become the person she needs.

zh: 可回到床上，我就觉得自己仍然太小。她问我能不能做好，我当然说能；她若知道我有时悄悄哭，会不会觉得自己看错了？在{{e_convent|圣罗莎修院}}，不明白的事还可以等她走近。到那位夫人家里以后，要等多久呢？
text: Back in bed, though, I feel small again. When she asks whether I can manage, of course I say yes. If she knew I sometimes cried in secret, would she think she had mistaken me? At {{e_convent|Saint Rose's Convent}}, when I do not understand, I can wait for her to come near. How long will I have to wait in that lady's house?

zh: 大家说，我该高兴，这是一种信任。我也高兴。只是我还不知道，信任这么重，原来不能像篮子那样，走累了就暂时放在地上。原来她要我记住的，不只是今天的差事。
text: Everyone says I should be glad: it is a sign of trust. I am glad. I simply did not know that trust could weigh so much, or that, unlike a basket, it could not be set on the ground when my arms grew tired. What she wants me to remember goes far beyond today's errands.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 借住的人
text: A Borrowed Place

zh: 主人卧床的日子一长，仆人便把房间借给自己的亲戚住，随手拿走宅子里的东西。这件事有时连掩饰也不需要：家里真正看得见他们在做什么的，只剩下一个穿着孤儿院制服的女孩。
text: When the mistress remained in bed for days, the servants lent rooms to their relations and took whatever they wanted from the house. Sometimes there was no need even to conceal it. The only person who truly saw what they were doing was a girl in an orphanage uniform.

zh: [[NPC1]]不肯跟着装作看不见。于是她遇上了许多说不清算不算大事的折磨，房门会把她关在里面，差事会被人故意弄得更麻烦。她既要防着东西不见，又担心主人把丢失的东西算在自己头上。那些人比她熟悉这栋宅子，也比她知道，一个没有家人撑腰的孩子能被欺负到什么地步。
text: [[NPC1]] refused to pretend she had seen nothing. So she endured torments that were difficult to name as serious offences: doors locked her in, errands were deliberately complicated. She had to watch for missing possessions while fearing that her mistress would accuse her of taking them. The servants knew the house better than she did. They also knew how far a child without a family to defend her could be pushed.

zh: {{e_maria|玛丽亚}}偶尔会从心事里回过神来，和她谈天，露出诙谐、敏锐而亲切的一面。女孩刚刚生出一点依恋，第二天那目光又越过她，像越过房间里一件用惯了的家具。夫人未必发脾气，却可以整天没有真正看见她。
text: Occasionally {{e_maria|María}} emerged from her preoccupations and talked to her, revealing wit, insight and warmth. Just as the girl began to feel attached to her, the next day's gaze would pass over her as if she were a familiar piece of furniture. The lady need not lose her temper to spend an entire day without really seeing her.

zh: 她记得{{e_abbess|院长}}交代过的责任。她是被送来作伴的，并没有被许诺在这里一定会快乐；因而遇见不快时，她先怀疑自己有没有尽好本分。脚步放轻，门关轻，听见召唤立刻过去，这些都比解释自己为什么难受容易。
text: She remembered the duties {{e_abbess|Mother Pilar}} had given her. She had been sent as a companion, with no promise that she would be happy. When unhappiness came, she first wondered whether she had done her duty properly. Soft footsteps, quietly closed doors, coming at once when called: all these were easier than explaining why she was hurt.

zh: 宅邸很宽敞，容得下仆人的亲戚、成箱的礼物、远方女儿的画像。女孩住进来以后，仍找不到一个可以放心说话的人。她把事情做完，等待主人偶尔又肯和她谈天的那一天。她连衣服都仍穿着修院的制服，主人没有想到替她换一身。
text: The great house had room for the servants' relations, chests of presents and portraits of the daughter overseas. After moving in, the girl still could find no one to whom she could safely speak. She finished her work and waited for another day when her mistress might care to talk. She still wore her convent uniform. Her mistress had not thought to provide another dress.

zh: 佩皮塔
text: Pepita

zh: 留在阳光里
text: Stay in the Sun

zh: {{e_maria|夫人}}说，留在阳光里，她不会去很久。这块石头还是热的，现在影子已经走到鞋边。我想过进教堂找她，可我若走开，她出来时看不见我怎么办？
text: {{e_maria|María}} told me to stay in the sunshine. She would not be long. This stone is still warm, but now the shadow has reached my shoes. I thought of going into the church to look for her. What if she came out and could not find me?

zh: 后来我还是进去了。里面没有她。我沿着座位看，走到另一扇门边，终于明白她大概从那里离开了。现在我可以回家吗？还是应该回到她让我等的地方？她交代的事明明很简单，是我把它弄得越来越难了。
text: At last I went in. She was not there. I searched the pews, reached another door, and understood that she had probably left by it. May I go home now? Or must I return to the place where she told me to wait? Her instruction was so simple. I have made it harder and harder.

zh: {{e_lima|利马}}的广场上总有人经过。我听见有人低声说话，便以为他们在说我的衣服。也许有些人根本没有看我，可我仍想把裙角藏起来。这身制服谁都认识，谁都知道我是从哪儿来的。
text: People are always passing through the square in {{e_lima|Lima}}. When I hear lowered voices, I think they are talking about my clothes. Perhaps some have not even looked at me, but I still want to hide the edge of my skirt. Everyone knows this uniform. Everyone knows where I came from.

zh: {{e_obedience|服从}}应当使事情变得清楚才对。照着吩咐去做，就不会让人失望。我回到原来的街角，站在越来越长的阴影里。只要她再经过一次，就会知道我没有乱走。
text: {{e_obedience|Obedience}} ought to make things clear. Do as you are told and you will disappoint no one. I return to the same corner and stand in the lengthening shadow. If she passes this way once more, she will know that I did not wander off.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 包厢里的笑声
text: Laughter Towards the Box

zh: 正剧演到中场，[[NPC2]]暂时放下端庄的角色，走到幕前唱城里流行的时事小曲。她已经看见了包厢里的老夫人，便临时编出几句，把她的相貌、酒醉、吝啬，连同女儿远走海外的事，都编进歌里。{{e_pio|皮奥}}平日帮她记台词，教她斟酌分寸；这些临时编出的歌，却由她自己把握。
text: During the interval, [[NPC2]] set aside her dignified role and came before the curtain to sing the topical songs popular in the city. She had noticed the old lady in her box. She improvised verses about her looks, her drinking, her stinginess, even her daughter's departure overseas. {{e_pio|Pio}} ordinarily helped her learn her lines and judge a performance. These improvised songs were hers to control.

zh: 观众很快听懂了。视线从舞台转向包厢，笑声层层接上来。[[NPC1]]却仍想着刚才两幕戏，又想着{{e_spain|西班牙}}。她的注意力飘得很远，几句正在成形的漂亮话占住了心思：写给女儿，她也许会喜欢。
text: The audience understood quickly. Eyes turned from the stage to the box, and laughter rose in successive waves. [[NPC1]] was still thinking of the two acts she had just seen, and of {{e_spain|Spain}}. Her attention had wandered far away. A few fine phrases were forming in her mind; perhaps her daughter would like them in a letter.

zh: 台上的人越唱越大胆。坐在夫人旁边的[[NPC3]]听得清清楚楚，伸手扯了扯她的衣袖，低声劝她离开。她没有站起来和满场的人争辩，只想把夫人从那些目光中带出去。两人一离开包厢，观众便起身欢呼，仿佛终于赢了一场仗。
text: The singer grew bolder. Beside the lady, [[NPC3]] heard everything. She tugged her sleeve and quietly urged her to leave. She did not rise to argue with the whole theatre; she only wanted to take her mistress beyond those staring eyes. When the two left the box, the audience rose cheering, as though a battle had been won.

zh: 演员跳起热烈的舞，看见剧院经理站在后面，知道这场胜利会使自己的酬金增加。她凭借观众的{{e_applause|掌声}}确信，今天的锋利十分成功。
text: The actress broke into a lively dance. Seeing the manager behind the stage, she knew that this triumph would increase her fee. The audience's {{e_applause|Applause}} assured her that today's cruelty had succeeded.

zh: 被带出门的老夫人甚至有些高兴。她在这次演出里收获了足以逗女儿一笑的句子，却不知道自己也已经成了别人取笑的材料。同一阵喧闹，台上的人听见赞许，女孩听见羞辱，夫人几乎没有听见。满场的人都看向包厢，却没有谁等那位老夫人给出回答。
text: The old lady being led outside was almost pleased. The performance had given her phrases that might amuse her daughter. She did not know that she too had become material for someone else's amusement. In the same uproar, the actress heard approval, the girl heard humiliation, and the lady heard almost nothing. Everyone had looked towards her box. No one had waited for her answer.

zh: 玛丽亚
text: María

zh: 并未听见的侮辱
text: An Insult Unheard

zh: 演员穿着黑衣来了，带着{{e_viceroy|总督}}的介绍信。[[NPC1]]用雪擦过额头，披上斗篷，费力来到客厅。[[NPC2]]原先预备敷衍几句，这时却被老夫人的神气镇住了。
text: The actress arrived in black, carrying a letter from {{e_viceroy|Viceroy Andrés}}. [[NPC1]] rubbed her forehead with snow, put on her cloak and struggled into the drawing room. [[NPC2]] had prepared a few perfunctory remarks. Now the old lady's bearing unsettled her.

zh: 您来，是有什么事？
text: You have come—was there something you wished?

zh: 我想确定，夫人没有误会那晚在剧院听到的话。我这样一个演员，有时候会说得超出自己的本意。
text: I wanted to be certain that you had not misunderstood what you heard at the theatre that evening. An actress such as myself sometimes says more than she means.

zh: 误会？我记得的只是您演得很美。您是一个大艺术家，您应该快活才对。
text: Misunderstood? I remember only how beautifully you acted. You are a great artist. You ought to be happy.

zh: 我说的是两幕之间唱的歌。我怕您以为，我有意对您不敬。
text: I mean the songs between the acts. I feared you might think I had intended to show you disrespect.

zh: 啊，我们提早走了。请原谅，偏偏是在您那么好的演出中间。我忘了为什么，大概是谁不舒服。
text: Ah, we left early. Forgive us—right in the middle of your wonderful performance. I forget why. Someone was unwell, perhaps.

zh: 演员红了脸。她不相信有人会没听懂那些歌，只能把这番话理解成宽恕。
text: The actress blushed. She could not believe that anyone had failed to understand the songs. She could only interpret these words as forgiveness.

zh: 您这样好，肯原谅我的孩子气。我此前不知道。请让我吻您的手。
text: You are so good, to forgive my childishness. I did not know before. Please let me kiss your hand.

zh: 我怎么会生您的气，我美丽的孩子？您的一个手势，让我想起{{e_clara|克拉拉}}。我们曾争过几句，后来同时回去求原谅，只隔着一扇门。她用两只手捧着我的脸，像这样。
text: How could I be angry with you, my beautiful child? One of your gestures reminded me of {{e_clara|Clara}}. Once we quarrelled, then both returned to ask forgiveness, with only a door between us. She took my face in both hands, like this.

zh: 夫人流着泪往前倾，示范那个她反复梦见的动作。那次和解没有在醒着的生活里发生过。
text: Weeping, the lady leaned forward to demonstrate the gesture she had dreamed so often. That reconciliation had never occurred in her waking life.

zh: 城里有人说她待我不好，那不是真的。她聪明，有风度，是我太难相处。我说话使人厌烦，偏偏成了那么美的姑娘的母亲。
text: People in the city say she treats me badly. It is not true. She is intelligent and gracious; I am the difficult one. I weary people when I speak, and yet I became the mother of so beautiful a girl.

zh: 她几乎从椅子上跌下来。{{e_pepita|佩皮塔}}扶住她，送她回房。演员回家后，长久地对着镜子，双手贴住自己的脸；她没有从这次道歉里带走原先预备好的轻松。
text: She almost fell from the chair. {{e_pepita|Pepita}} steadied her and took her back to her room. At home, the actress stood a long while before her mirror, both hands against her own face. She had not brought back the easy relief she had expected from the apology.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 红粉笔的台阶
text: Red Chalk on the Stairs

zh: 消息几乎藏在信尾：{{e_clara|克拉拉}}说，秋天不能按计划出游了，因为孩子将在十月初出生。她把这件事写得轻描淡写，希望少引出一点母亲的焦虑。[[NPC1]]却扶住了墙。什么孩子？女儿要做母亲了？
text: The news was almost hidden at the end of the letter. {{e_clara|Clara}} wrote that she could not travel that autumn as planned: her child would be born in early October. She made little of it, hoping to provoke less anxiety in her mother. [[NPC1]] caught hold of the wall. What child? Her daughter was to become a mother?

zh: 她立刻开始打听。城里上了年纪的女人有什么经验，哪一种偏方据说有效，她都要问，再写进信里。对面那个人觉得乏味的细节，成了她一整天最迫切的工作。距离越远，能做的越少，她便越想把每一种可能都试遍。
text: She began asking questions at once. What did the old women of the city know? Which remedies were said to work? She gathered everything and put it into letters. Details that bored the reader across the sea became her most urgent daily business. The greater the distance and the less she could do, the more she wanted to try every possibility.

zh: 家里不许有结，女仆连头发也不能束紧；楼梯的偶数级被红粉笔做了记号，有人踏错，她就又哭又叫，赶人出去。她在身上藏着求平安的小物件，仿佛一处疏忽，便会在海的另一边伤害那个即将出生的生命。
text: There must be no knots in the house; even the maids could not tie their hair tightly. She marked the even-numbered stairs with red chalk. When someone stepped wrongly she wept, shouted and drove them out. She concealed protective charms on her body, as though one oversight might harm the life about to begin across the sea.

zh: 天还黑着，她就去赶最早的弥撒。她抱住祭坛栏杆，望着圣像，求一个几乎看不出来的点头。可有时奔走了一天，她又觉得自然是聋的，神也无动于衷；她所做的一切，根本没有碰到事情的进程。
