text: Before daybreak she went to the earliest Mass. Gripping the altar rail, she gazed at the sacred images and begged for the slightest nod. Yet after a day of such exertion she sometimes felt that nature was deaf and God indifferent. Nothing she did had touched the course of events.

zh: 这种绝望不会长久。只要心底又冒出一个‘也许’，她就赶回家补上蜡烛。最终，她决定去山里的{{e_shrine|克卢克桑布夸圣所}}朝圣。轿子将越过{{e_bridge|圣路易斯雷大桥}}，向安第斯山中升去；她希望在那座古老圣所里，找到比家中这些记号更可靠的保证。她把这些事做得十分认真，对自己是否还有能力保护女儿，却越来越没有把握。
text: The despair never lasted. As soon as a new 'perhaps' arose, she hurried home to replace the candles. At last she decided to make a pilgrimage to the {{e_shrine|Shrine of Cluxambuqua}}. Her chair would cross the {{e_bridge|Bridge of San Luis Rey}} and climb into the Andes. She hoped the ancient shrine might offer a firmer assurance than the markings in her house. She performed every observance earnestly, with ever less certainty that she could still protect her daughter.

zh: 佩皮塔
text: Pepita

zh: 先安顿下来
text: Make the Room Ready

zh: {{e_maria|夫人}}没有下轿进门，就先去了圣所。她把这里交给我，回来时，至少要像一间可以住的屋子。搬东西的人还在等，我指给他们看，哪只篮子靠墙，哪一只先打开。
text: {{e_maria|María}} went straight to the shrine without getting out of her chair at the door. She has left this place to me. By the time she returns, it must at least be a room one can live in. The porters are waiting. I show them which basket goes by the wall and which must be opened first.

zh: 祭坛，挂毯，女儿的画像，都要取出来。{{e_inn|山中客栈}}的屋子不是家里那间，若摆得不习惯，她也许又坐不安稳。这里很冷，火盆得准备好，还得下楼去和厨子说，{{e_porridge|粥}}该怎么煮。那几句话不能说得含糊，夫人平常就靠它吃下些东西。
text: The altar, tapestries and portraits of her daughter all have to come out. This room at the {{e_inn|Mountain Inn}} is not the room at home. If the arrangement feels strange, she may be unable to settle. It is cold here; the brazier must be prepared. I must go downstairs and tell the cook how to make the {{e_porridge|Porridge}}. I cannot be vague about that. It is mostly what she manages to eat.

zh: 山上的空气使人头晕。我把手按在桌边，等这一阵过去，想着还有哪件事没有办完。只要一件接着一件做，就暂时没有空想，我已经离{{e_convent|修院}}这么远了。
text: The mountain air makes me dizzy. I press my hand against the table and wait for it to pass, thinking of what remains undone. As long as I do one thing after another, there is no time to think how far away the {{e_convent|Saint Rose's Convent}} has become.

zh: 屋子终于收拾好，门外却仍没有脚步声。空下来以后，熟悉的声音反倒都来了：吃晚饭时的劝诫，病床边的祈祷，院长叫我留下来说话。我把纸拿出来，又把羽毛笔放下。写一封信，应当不会耽误太多事。她回来时，至少先有一口合意的热粥。
text: At last the room is ready, but there are still no footsteps outside. With nothing to do, familiar voices return: advice at supper, prayers beside the sickbeds, the abbess asking me to stay and talk. I take out paper, then lay down the quill. A letter should not delay my work very much. At least there will be hot porridge to her liking when she comes back.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 喷泉旁的来信
text: A Letter by the Fountain

zh: 远远看见白墙的山城，[[NPC1]]的手就停止拨念珠了。安第斯山那么高，城镇像歇在山的膝头。钟声彼此应答，空气冷而清澈，她那些急促的祈祷，忽然不再一句接一句地往外涌。
text: When the white-walled mountain town came into view, [[NPC1]]'s fingers stopped moving over her rosary. The Andes rose so high that the town seemed to rest upon their knees. Bells answered one another. In the clear cold air her hurried prayers suddenly ceased to tumble out in succession.

zh: 在圣所里，有个管事要收一笔说不清的费用，又借口修地砖让她换地方。若在别处，这也许会使她不安；今天她挪了位置，继续坐着。四周卖蜡烛的老妇人终日谈钱，她也没有被打断。她隐约觉得，也许女儿的生活和神明的事务，都不必时时由自己催促。
text: At the shrine an attendant demanded an obscure fee, then asked her to move on the pretext of repairing the floor. Elsewhere this might have disturbed her. Today she changed places and remained seated. The old candle-sellers talked of money all day; even they did not interrupt her. Dimly she felt that perhaps her daughter's life and the affairs of God did not need her constant urging.

zh: 后来她坐到喷泉旁，看病人慢慢绕过花园，看三只鹰在天上盘旋。一只披着厚毛的羊驼走近，把柔软的鼻子凑过来，仿佛也想加入谈话。其他几只又跟了过来，围住这个不再急着赶路的女人。
text: Later she sat beside the fountain, watching the sick move slowly around the garden and three hawks circle above. A thick-fleeced llama approached, bringing its soft nose near as though it too wished to join a conversation. Others followed, gathering round this woman who was no longer in a hurry.

zh: 报信的男孩找到了她。她早已吩咐，任何从{{e_spain|西班牙}}寄来的消息都须立即送到。她拆开包裹，先读女婿诙谐亲切的便条，再读{{e_clara|克拉拉}}的信。女儿的句子聪明得锋利，一句句刺进来，她便一句句用理解和宽恕包好，放进心里。
text: A messenger boy found her. She had ordered that any news from {{e_spain|Spain}} be brought immediately. She opened the packet, first reading her son-in-law's witty, affectionate note, then {{e_clara|Clara}}'s letter. Her daughter's clever sentences had sharp edges. As each one wounded her, she wrapped it in understanding and forgiveness and laid it in her heart.

zh: 这回她没有立刻奔走，也没有吩咐别人去办什么。她收起{{e_letters|书信}}，慢慢起身，轻轻驱散那些好奇的羊驼，重新走回圣所。广场的钟仍在响；她的脸很严肃，却没有再向四周追问，究竟还要做什么，才能换来保证。她没有把女儿的苛刻告诉那些围过来的陌生人，只把信收回自己手里。
text: This time she did not rush away or send anyone on an errand. She put away the {{e_letters|Letters}}, rose slowly, gently dispersed the curious llamas and returned to the shrine. The square's bells were still ringing. Her face was grave, but she no longer asked the world what more she must do to obtain assurance. She did not tell the strangers nearby of her daughter's harshness. She kept the letter in her own hands.

zh: 佩皮塔
text: Pepita

zh: 能回来几天吗
text: May I Come Back for a Few Days?

zh: 我本来只想告诉{{e_abbess|院长}}，我们平安到了{{e_inn|山中客栈}}。写着写着，纸上的墨点却越来越多。她那么忙，如果看到这些，会不会又得为我担心？
text: I only meant to tell {{e_abbess|Mother Pilar}} that we had safely reached the {{e_inn|Mountain Inn}}. Yet the ink spots kept multiplying as I wrote. She is so busy. Will seeing them make her worry about me too?

zh: ……只要您喜欢我，愿意让我留在夫人身边，这些都不算什么。我不该告诉您，可那些坏女仆有时把我关在房间里，又拿走东西；也许夫人会以为是我偷的。我希望不会。我希望您身体好，医院和其他地方也没有什么麻烦。
text: …None of it matters, so long as you love me and wish me to stay with the lady. I ought not to tell you, but sometimes the wicked maids lock me in my room and take things away. Perhaps the lady will think I have stolen them. I hope not. I hope you are well, and that there is no trouble at the hospital or anywhere else.

zh: 虽然见不到您，我一直想着您，也记得您教我的话。我只想做您愿意让我做的事。但是，能不能让我回修院住几天呢？如果您不愿意，那就不必。我只是太孤单，没有人可以说话，还有别的……
text: Though I cannot see you, I think of you all the time and remember what you have taught me. I only want to do what you wish. But might I come back to the convent for a few days? If you do not wish it, there is no need. I am only so lonely, with no one to talk to, and other things…

zh: 有时我不知道，您是不是已经忘记了我。倘若能找出一点时间，给我写一封很短的信也好，我就可以把它留着。但我知道您有多忙……
text: Sometimes I do not know whether you have forgotten me. If you could find a little time to write even a very short letter, I could keep it with me. But I know how busy you are…

zh: 她搁下笔，留着那封满是墨迹的信，下楼去问新的{{e_charcoal|木炭}}，又尝了尝锅里的粥。回到这些细小事务里，她的手重新有了确定该做的事。
text: She put down the quill and left the ink-spotted letter. Downstairs she asked about fresh {{e_charcoal|Charcoal}} and tasted the porridge in the pot. Among these small tasks, her hands once more knew exactly what to do.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 第五十六封
text: Letter Fifty-Six

zh: [[NPC1]]读过女孩留在桌上的信，合起后又想重读。她羡慕{{e_abbess|院长}}能使一个孩子如此眷恋，也羞于自己总把爱弄得那么繁重。女孩端来了晚饭。
text: [[NPC1]] had read the girl's letter on the table. After closing it, she wanted to read it again. She envied the devotion that {{e_abbess|Mother Pilar}} inspired in a child, and felt ashamed of making love so burdensome herself. The girl brought in supper.

zh: 孩子，不和我一起吃吗？
text: Child, will you not eat with me?

zh: 我想夫人累了。我已经在楼下吃过。吃饭时，要我给您念书吗？
text: I thought you would be tired. I have eaten downstairs. Shall I read to you while you eat?

zh: 不用了。愿意的话，就去睡吧。等等——我明早要送一封信去利马。如果您也有信，可以一起捎去。
text: No, thank you. Go to bed if you wish. Wait—I am sending a letter to Lima tomorrow morning. If you have one, it can go with mine.

zh: 我没有。我得下去，给您拿新木炭。
text: I have none. I must go down and fetch fresh charcoal for you.

zh: 可是，给院长的那一封……她会很高兴收到的，我知道。
text: But the one to the abbess… I know she would be delighted to receive it.

zh: 我不寄了。我改了主意。那不是一封好信。
text: I am not sending it. I have changed my mind. It was not a good letter.

zh: 怎么不是？亲爱的，我觉得它非常美。相信我，我是懂的。什么使它成了一封不好的信？
text: Why not, my dear? I thought it very beautiful. Believe me, I know about such things. What made it a bad letter?

zh: 它不……不够勇敢。
text: It was not… not brave.

zh: 女孩不肯再说，带着信进了房间。桌边的人听见纸被撕开的声音，低头看自己的晚饭。{{e_courage|勇气}}，她从没有把这个词认真带进爱里。回想那些索要答复的话，她先想辩解，想怪自己的成长、自己的处境；最后却把桌子清出来，重新坐下写信。
text: The girl would say no more. She took the letter into her room. The woman at the table heard paper tearing and looked down at her supper. {{e_courage|Courage}}: she had never seriously brought that word into love. Remembering her demands for answers, she first wanted to defend herself, to blame her upbringing and circumstances. At last she cleared the table and sat down to write again.

zh: 这是后来传世的第五十六封{{e_letters|书信}}。她却把它叫作第一封，仿佛此前的恳求终于能换一种写法。那些反复追问女儿究竟有多爱自己的旧信，已经收不回来；新写的这一封，仍然可以更宽厚一些。写完时，天将要亮了。
text: This became the fifty-sixth of her celebrated {{e_letters|Letters}}. She called it her first, as though her appeals could finally take another form. She could not retrieve the old letters that repeatedly asked how much her daughter loved her. This new one could still be more generous. When she finished, dawn was near.

zh: 佩皮塔
text: Pepita

zh: 没有寄出的纸
text: The Paper Never Sent

zh: 我说了那个词，就不想再说别的。{{e_maria|夫人}}一直看着我，她竟觉得那封信很美。我不习惯有人追问，我为什么不肯寄出去。
text: Once I said that word, I wanted to say nothing more. {{e_maria|María}} kept looking at me. She really thought the letter beautiful. I am not used to anyone asking why I will not send it.

zh: 撕纸的声音很响。在{{e_inn|客栈}}这样安静的房间里，隔壁大概也听得见。我把它撕小了些，可刚才写过的那些话并没有跟着消失。我还是想回去几天，还是希望{{e_abbess|院长}}能写几句话给我，哪怕短得只够放在掌心。
text: Tearing paper makes a loud sound. In such a quiet room at the {{e_inn|Mountain Inn}}, it must be audible next door. I tore it smaller, but the things I had written did not disappear. I still want to go back for a few days. I still wish {{e_abbess|Mother Pilar}} would write me a few words, even a letter small enough to fit in my palm.

zh: 躺下以后，我想起自己说话的样子，觉得很不自在。我不该那么大声，也许不该说那封信不好。现在纸碎了，再要一张，好像又得从头解释一遍。黑暗里没有人问我，我仍在心里回答。
text: After lying down I remember how I spoke, and feel uneasy. I should not have spoken so loudly. Perhaps I should not have called it a bad letter. Now the paper is in pieces, and asking for another sheet would mean explaining everything again. No one questions me in the dark. I am still answering in my head.

zh: 女孩后来睡着了。将近黎明时，夫人举着蜡烛走进来，轻轻拨开她额前汗湿的头发。那封没有寄出的信，没有再被放回邮袋。两天后，她们才动身返城，走向来时经过的{{e_bridge|索桥}}。
text: Eventually the girl slept. Near dawn, the lady came in holding a candle and gently brushed the damp hair from her forehead. The unsent letter never returned to the mailbag. Two days later they set out for the city, towards the {{e_bridge|Bridge of San Luis Rey}} they had crossed on their way there.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 门前的篮子
text: The Basket at the Door

zh: 清早，人们在门口收容弃婴的篮子里发现了两个男孩。奶妈还没有赶到，他们已经有了名字：{{e_manuel|曼努埃尔}}，{{e_esteban|埃斯特班}}。名字分得清，孩子却分不清，城里没有谁能一直认准哪一个是哪一个。
text: One morning two boys were found in the basket for abandoned infants at the door. Before the wet-nurse arrived, they already had names: {{e_manuel|Manuel}} and {{e_esteban|Esteban}}. The names were distinct; the children were not. No one in the city could reliably tell which was which.

zh: 他们的父母是谁，无人知道。后来见两人站得笔直、又总是沉默，爱闲谈的人便替他们猜测显赫的身世，把各种贵族家的门牌安到他们头上。那些说法既没有把一个家还给他们，也没有让他们长大时少受几句打趣。
text: No one knew their parents. Later, seeing how straight they stood and how silent they were, the city's gossips invented distinguished origins for them, assigning them to one noble doorway after another. None of these stories restored a family to them or spared them any teasing as they grew.

zh: [[NPC1]]是世上最接近监护人的那个人。她常常厌恶男人给女人带来的苦，却渐渐喜欢上这两个孩子。傍晚，她叫他们到自己的房间，吩咐厨房拿些点心，讲英雄的故事，也讲丑角接连不断的灾难。
text: [[NPC1]] was the nearest thing they had to a guardian. She often hated the suffering men brought upon women, yet gradually grew fond of these two children. In the evenings she called them into her room, sent to the kitchen for cakes, and told stories of heroes and the successive misfortunes of a clown.

zh: 两双黑眼睛凝神望着她。她喜欢得越深，越会突然担忧：等他们长成男人，自己所憎恶的那些东西，会不会也从这两张脸里显出来？孩子还不懂她目光里的迟疑，只等着故事继续。
text: Two pairs of dark eyes watched her intently. The more she loved them, the more abruptly she would worry: when they became men, would the things she hated emerge from these faces too? The boys did not understand the hesitation in her gaze. They waited for the story to continue.

zh: 他们在这里长到不宜再久留的年纪，随后去城中各处教堂做事，修篱笆，擦十字架，替走进病人家的神父提香炉。城里人都认识这对兄弟，依旧常认错名字。后来他们开始做抄写员，用相似的两只手，抄戏本、歌谣、商人的告示，也抄唱诗班所需的一份又一份乐谱。名字很早就有了，能够不靠名字而认准对方的人，却始终只有兄弟彼此。
text: They remained until they were a little too old to stay, then worked in churches throughout the city: mending hedges, polishing crucifixes, carrying the censer behind priests entering sickrooms. Everyone knew the brothers, and still confused their names. Later they became copyists. With their similar hands they transcribed plays, ballads, merchants' notices and endless parts for the choirs. They had possessed names from the beginning. Only each brother could recognise the other without needing one.

zh: 曼努埃尔
text: Manuel

zh: 我们若在那里
text: Had We Been There

zh: 她讲到那个人被钉起来的时候，我忍不住打断了。要是我和{{e_esteban|埃斯特班}}也在那里，我们就会拦住他们。话说出口，我并不觉得自己说得太大；两个人总能做些什么，怎么可以只站着看？
text: When she reached the part where they nailed the man up, I interrupted. If {{e_esteban|Esteban}} and I had been there, we would have stopped them. It did not sound like a boast when I said it. Two people could surely do something. How could they simply stand and watch?

zh: {{e_abbess|院长}}看了我们一会儿。她讲的那些很远的故事，常有受苦的人，也有来不及赶到的人。我不喜欢听到来不及。我们替她跑腿时，一条路被堵住，可以换另一条；东西太重，一个人拿一边就好。
text: {{e_abbess|Mother Pilar}} looked at us for a while. Her stories of distant places often contained people suffering, or people who arrived too late. I disliked hearing 'too late'. When we ran errands for her, a blocked road meant finding another. If something was heavy, we each took one end.

zh: 城里人总把我们认错，再为自己的错误笑起来。我不想解释那么多。到了{{e_convent|修院}}这间屋子，我们可以并排坐着，安静地听，想说的时候再说。
text: People in the city confuse us, then laugh at their own mistake. I do not want to explain so much. In this room at {{e_convent|Saint Rose's Convent}}, we can sit beside one another, listen quietly, and speak when we wish.

zh: 我们若在那里，就会把事情改过来。我说这句话时，还没有遇见一件非做不可、却无论怎样用力都做不成的事。
text: Had we been there, we would have changed it. When I said that, I had never yet met a thing that had to be done and could not be done, however hard one tried.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 不肯交出的词
text: Words They Would Not Surrender

zh: {{e_archbishop|大主教}}听说双胞胎有一套只彼此听得懂的话，便削好羽毛笔，把他们叫到书房。他研究过方言，准备日后回到西班牙庄园时，把这些材料整理成一件有趣的工作。
text: The {{e_archbishop|Archbishop of Lima}} heard that the twins spoke a language only they understood. He trimmed a quill and summoned them to his study. He had studied dialects and hoped to make an interesting project of these materials when he returned to his estate in Spain.

zh: 你们怎样说面包？平常两个人在一起的时候，用哪一个词？
text: How do you say bread? When you are alone together, what word do you use?

zh: {{e_manuel|曼努埃尔}}和{{e_esteban|埃斯特班}}站在漂亮的地毯上。长长的沉默过后，其中一个低声答了。问话的人把笔移向纸面。
text: {{e_manuel|Manuel}} and {{e_esteban|Esteban}} stood upon the fine carpet. After a long silence one of them answered softly. Their questioner moved his pen towards the paper.

zh: 树呢？树也有自己的叫法吗？不要紧，只照平常说就好。
text: And a tree? Do you have a word for a tree as well? Do not be troubled. Just say what you ordinarily say.

zh: 又是一阵沉默。他们从刚学说话时就有了这套{{e_language|私语}}，词汇和句法都不大依靠西班牙语。单独相处时才说；偶尔在人前遇上紧迫的事，也只低声耳语。
text: Another silence. They had possessed this {{e_language|Private Language}} since learning to speak; its vocabulary and syntax owed little to Spanish. They used it when alone. On the rare urgent occasion before others, they whispered.

zh: 那么，‘我看见’，和‘我看见过’，会有区别吗？慢一点，我记下来。
text: Then would 'I see' differ from 'I have seen'? Slowly, please, so that I can write it down.

zh: 他们不知道该怎样解释，为什么这件看似无害的事使自己如此难堪。不是答不出来，也不只是敬畏身份。外人平常盯着他们相似的脸，觉得好玩；如今连两人之间最隐秘的距离，也被一问一答地摆到桌面上。
text: They did not know how to explain why this seemingly harmless business embarrassed them so deeply. They could answer; it was not merely awe of his rank. Strangers usually found amusement in staring at their similar faces. Now, question by question, even the most private space between them was being laid upon the desk.

zh: 主人最初以为他们被书房的华贵拘住了，后来终于察觉，那迟疑来自更深的地方。他失望地放下笔，让两人离开，没有再索要下一个词。那套话仍留在两人中间；记事本里，留下来的远比他预想的少。
text: At first their host thought the splendour of his study had restrained them. Eventually he perceived that their hesitation came from somewhere deeper. Disappointed, he put down the quill and dismissed them without asking for another word. The language remained between the brothers. The notebook held far less than he had expected.

zh: 曼努埃尔
text: Manuel

zh: 同一件差事
text: The Same Errand

zh: 有人问，为什么去办同一件事，也要走两条街。这样省得听他们再猜谁是谁。他们猜对会笑，猜错也会笑，我们无论怎么回答，最后都得站着等他们笑完。
text: People ask why we take different streets even when going on the same errand. It saves us hearing them guess who is who. They laugh when they are right and when they are wrong. Whatever we answer, we have to stand there until they have finished.

zh: {{e_esteban|埃斯特班}}不必说自己什么时候回来。有时我做着手里的活，就觉得他快到了；过一会儿，门外果然有脚步。旁人若听见，大概又要问许多问题。我们已经习惯，不觉得非得拿出来解释。
text: {{e_esteban|Esteban}} need not tell me when he will return. Sometimes, at my work, I feel he is almost here. A little later there are footsteps outside. If others heard that, they would probably ask many questions. We are used to it. We do not feel obliged to explain.

zh: 抄写做腻了，就去{{e_harbor|港口}}搬货。也赶过牲口，摘过果子，替人摆渡。换一种活，肩背会在不同的地方疼，回去以后还是有人知道今天为什么少说话。
text: When we tire of copying, we carry cargo at the {{e_harbor|Harbour}}. We have driven animals, picked fruit, ferried people across water. Different work makes different parts of the back ache. At home there is still someone who knows why I am quiet that day.

zh: 我们很少谈什么了不得的事，吃什么、穿什么、明天到哪里挣钱，几句话就够。两张桌子也好，一只沉重的木箱也好，我知道另一边有人。世界其余的地方怎样热闹，都不用马上弄懂。
text: We seldom discuss anything grand. Food, clothing, where to earn tomorrow's money: a few words suffice. Whether it is two desks or a heavy wooden crate, I know someone is on the other side. However noisy the rest of the world becomes, I need not understand it immediately.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 留下的那一个
text: The One Who Stayed

zh: 经理预料今晚座位卖不满，就送了兄弟俩两张入场券。他们回城后，又开始替剧团抄本子，平日进出后台，却没觉得那些台词有什么值得欣赏。荣誉，声名，爱情的火焰，诗人一开口，什么都可以绕着它们说很久。
text: The manager expected empty seats that evening and gave the brothers two tickets. Since returning to the city they had resumed copying for the company. They went backstage regularly, without finding much to admire in the speeches. Honour, fame, the flames of love: once a poet began, everything could be made to circle those subjects for a very long time.

zh: 两人坐得耐心，望着蜡烛和华丽的衣裳。到了幕间，{{e_camila|卡米拉}}换下剧中的身份，穿着层层裙子出来跳舞。{{e_esteban|埃斯特班}}说还有活要抄，先回去了。[[NPC1]]留在原处，红色的袜子和鞋子从此没有完全离开他的心思。
text: They sat patiently, watching the candles and splendid clothes. During the interval {{e_camila|Camila}} shed her dramatic role and came out to dance in layered skirts. {{e_esteban|Esteban}} said he had copying to finish and went home. [[NPC1]] remained. The red stockings and shoes never entirely left his thoughts.

zh: 他们早就见过这个演员。几年前，她曾把他们拉到一起，仔细查看两张脸，最后拍着其中一人的肩膀，宣布找到了较小的那个。那次被打量的窘迫，早已沉到别的记忆下面；如今，一个人发现自己做什么都容易绕到她的住处附近。
text: They had seen the actress before. Years earlier she had brought them together, inspected their faces carefully, then clapped one on the shoulder and announced that she had found the younger. The embarrassment of that inspection had long sunk beneath other memories. Now one brother found that almost every errand somehow led him towards her house.

zh: 夜里，他站在化妆室窗下的树间，指节抵着嘴，听自己的心跳。她是{{e_viceroy|总督}}的情人，富有，美丽，说话锋利，几乎没有哪一条消息意味着希望。可那些消息没有把他劝回去。
text: At night he stood among the trees beneath her dressing-room window, his knuckles against his mouth, listening to his heartbeat. She was the mistress of {{e_viceroy|Viceroy Andrés}}: rich, beautiful and sharp-tongued. Almost nothing he knew of her offered hope. None of it persuaded him to go home.

zh: 屋里等待的兄弟同样咬着指节。他并不是也爱上了这位演员，只是不明白原先已经足够的两个人，为什么忽然不再足够。同样的沉默，第一次藏着两件无法立刻互相明白的事。
text: His brother waiting in their room also bit his knuckles. He had not fallen in love with the actress. He could not understand why two people, who had always been enough, should suddenly no longer suffice. For the first time the same silence concealed two things they could not immediately understand in each other.

zh: 曼努埃尔
text: Manuel

zh: 替别人说爱
text: Writing Another Man's Love

zh: 在{{e_theatre|剧院}}里，{{e_camila|卡米拉}}说，我看上去不喜欢她。我不知怎样回答，才像她的朋友，又不暴露我来这里有多高兴。说‘是，夫人’，她嫌我笨；再说一遍，她就要换人。
text: At the {{e_theatre|Theatre}}, {{e_camila|Camila}} said I seemed not to like her. I did not know how to answer like a friend without betraying my delight at being there. I said, 'Yes, señora.' She called me stupid. When I said it again, she threatened to find someone else.

zh: 她要我起誓，连{{e_esteban|埃斯特班}}也不能知道。我把一个秘密留在我们两人之间，得到的却是替她写给别人的话。给{{e_viceroy|总督}}的一封，要斥责猜疑，退还礼物；给斗牛士的另一封，又变成亲昵的约定。
text: She made me swear that even {{e_esteban|Esteban}} must not know. I kept a secret between us, only to receive words for other men. The letter to {{e_viceroy|Viceroy Andrés}} rebuked his suspicions and returned his presents. The one to the bullfighter became an affectionate arrangement.

zh: 羽毛笔没有停。她叫我另取一张，我就另取一张。这些{{e_secretletters|秘密信件}}里没有一句是写给我的，可她站得那么近，仿佛只要把字写得足够清楚，还能多留一会儿。
text: The quill did not stop. She told me to take another sheet, and I took one. Not a sentence in these {{e_secretletters|Secret Letters}} was addressed to me. Yet she stood so near that I felt, if I wrote clearly enough, I might stay a little longer.

zh: 她问有没有抄错，付了钱，说往常由{{e_pio|皮奥}}代笔，这几封不愿让他知道。我接过钱，下楼，走到树底下。刚才必须一个字一个字听清的话，此刻全挤在心里，我倒说不出一句自己的。
text: She asked whether I had copied it correctly and paid me. {{e_pio|Pio}} usually wrote for her, she said, but she did not want him to know of these letters. I took the money, went downstairs and stood beneath the trees. The words I had been obliged to hear so precisely now crowded my heart. I could not find a single word of my own.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 半夜的代笔
text: A Copyist at Midnight

zh: 门上响起很轻的敲声。[[NPC2]]起身去开门，一名蒙着面纱的女人急急走进来，先要墨水和纸。[[NPC3]]已经躺下，从被子边缘看着。来客注意到那双眼睛，匆忙为深夜打扰道了歉，随即又俯身到桌边。
text: There was a light knock. [[NPC2]] rose to open the door, and a veiled woman hurried in, asking first for ink and paper. [[NPC3]] was already in bed, watching from beneath the covers. The visitor noticed his eyes, apologised hastily for coming so late, and leaned over the table.

zh: [[NPC1]]要写给使她久等的斗牛士。她在抄写员耳边压低声音，一边报出愤怒的句子，一边催问写完了没有。她需要的是一封立即送走的{{e_secretletters|信}}；在阴影里看着的另一个人，却把那种贴近误认为只有亲密者才能享有的关系。
text: [[NPC1]] was writing to the bullfighter who had kept her waiting. Close to the copyist's ear she dictated angry sentences in a low voice and kept asking whether he had finished. She needed a {{e_secretletters|Secret Letter}} sent at once. The other man in the shadows mistook her proximity for something permitted only between lovers.

zh: 他转过脸，朝向墙壁。女演员拿走纸，把一枚{{e_coin|钱币}}沿桌面推过去，又带着黑色花边和匆忙的低语离开。门关上，抄写员坐回来，双肘支在膝上，双手捂住耳朵，反复在心里承认自己爱她。
text: He turned his face to the wall. The actress took the paper, pushed a {{e_coin|Coin}} across the table and departed with her black lace and hurried whispers. When the door shut, the copyist sat down, elbows on his knees and hands over his ears, admitting over and over to himself that he loved her.

zh: 然后他察觉到了屋里另一种沉默。仿佛兄弟已经离自己很远，正一遍遍告别。他不懂，为什么喜欢一个人，竟会使另一个人如此痛苦；更不懂，这件事是否真能靠一次决定彻底结束。
text: Then he sensed another silence in the room. It was as though his brother had already gone far away and was repeatedly saying goodbye. He could not understand why loving one person should cause another such pain. Still less could he understand whether a single decision could truly end it.

zh: 蜡烛照着两张相同的脸，却没有照出共同的心事。桌上的钱尚未收起，床边的人已经急于证明，自己仍把兄弟放在所有事情前面。他吹灭蜡烛，躺下，用一种过分随便的口气宣布，以后再不替那个女人写信。
text: Candlelight fell upon two identical faces without revealing a common thought. The money remained on the table. Already the man beside the bed was eager to prove that he still placed his brother before everything else. He blew out the candle, lay down and announced, with excessive casualness, that he would never write for that woman again.

zh: 曼努埃尔
text: Manuel

zh: 雨夜的门
text: The Door in the Rain

zh: 宣布不再代笔后，[[NPC1]]开始念晚祷，想让事情就此过去。[[NPC2]]却起来重新点亮了蜡烛，系好腰带。
text: After announcing that he would write no more letters, [[NPC1]] began his evening prayers, hoping the matter would pass. [[NPC2]] got up, lit the candle again and fastened his belt.

zh: 怎么了？
text: What is it?

zh: 出去走走。你不必为了我说刚才那些话。写不写信，我并不在乎。
text: I am going for a walk. You need not say those things for my sake. I do not care whether you write her letters.

zh: 回床上去。谁说我是为了你？我不想再替{{e_camila|卡米拉}}写那些信，也不想那样领她的钱。
text: Go back to bed. Who said it was for you? I do not want to write those letters for {{e_camila|Camila}} or take her money that way.

zh: 你爱她。不必因为我而改变。
text: You love her. You need not change because of me.

zh: 爱她？我有什么机会？真有那种可能，她会叫我写这些信吗？会每次都把一枚钱推到桌上吗？
text: Love her? What chance have I? If there were any chance, would she ask me to write these letters? Would she push a coin across the table every time?

zh: 桌边的人没有回答，只用手指轻敲桌沿。床上的人换成两人自幼使用的{{e_language|私语}}，声音里的愤怒更加真实，虽然连他自己也不愿承认其中混着什么。
text: The man at the table did not answer. His fingers tapped its edge. From the bed, his brother switched into their childhood {{e_language|Private Language}}. The anger in his voice was more real, though even he did not wish to admit what lay within it.

zh: 我好得很。睡觉去，别做傻事。
text: I am perfectly well. Go to sleep. Do not be foolish.

zh: 我不。我出去走走。
text: No. I am going for a walk.

zh: 已经两点钟了，还在下雨。你不能那样走几个钟头。我向你保证，那件事已经过去了。我只喜欢过她一阵。
text: It is two o'clock and raining. You cannot walk about for hours like that. I promise you it is over. I only liked her for a little while.

zh: [[NPC2]]站在门口，黑暗几乎把他的脸收走。
text: [[NPC2]] stood in the doorway, his face almost taken by the dark.

zh: 是我挡着你了。
text: I am in your way.

zh: [[NPC1]]猛地从床上起来。那句话听起来不像一次普通出门，倒像永远的离开。
text: [[NPC1]] sprang from the bed. That sentence sounded less like an ordinary walk than a departure forever.

zh: 看在上帝的份上，回来。回来吧。
text: For God's sake, come back. Please come back.

zh: 兄弟回来了，重新躺下。第二天，演员的使者再来，得到了一句明确的拒绝。两人许多天没有再谈起这场争执；没有再谈，不表示彼此已经全然明白。蜡烛再一次熄灭，门关好了，屋外仍在下雨。
text: His brother returned and lay down. When the actress's messenger came the next day, he received a definite refusal. For many days the brothers did not discuss the quarrel. Their silence did not mean that they understood one another entirely. The candle went out again. The door was shut. Outside, the rain continued.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 每一个整点
text: Every Hour

zh: [[NPC1]]的膝盖被一块金属划破了。他们从没这样病过，起先只是望着腿肿起来，望着疼痛一阵阵穿过身体。半夜想起一家理发店的招牌兼写着外科医术，[[NPC2]]就跑出去敲门；人还没有回来，要等早晨。
text: [[NPC1]] cut his knee on a piece of metal. They had never known such illness. At first they merely watched the leg swell and the pain pass through his body in waves. At midnight they remembered a barber's sign advertising surgery. [[NPC2]] ran to knock at his door. The man had not returned; they must wait until morning.

zh: 他们互相保证，等那人看过就会好了。一天，两天，也许不到一天，受伤的人便能重新上街。终于等来{{e_medicine|药剂}}和膏药，又得到一项清楚的吩咐：每隔一小时，用冷湿布敷腿。
text: They assured each other that all would be well once he had been seen. A day or two—perhaps less than a day—and the injured man would be out again. At last came {{e_medicine|Medicines}} and plasters, with one clear instruction: apply cold wet cloths to the leg every hour.

zh: 照料的人照办，床上的人却越来越痛。每次{{e_cloth|湿布}}落下，恰好是最难忍的一刻。他开始求兄弟停手，说已经不疼，不必再弄。对方怕一心软就耽误康复，只好掀开被子，把布紧紧敷上。外面各座钟楼在整点敲得那么好听，屋内的人却越来越怕那声音。
text: The carer obeyed, but the patient grew worse. Each application of the {{e_cloth|Wet Cloth}} brought the most unbearable moment. He begged his brother to stop, saying the pain had gone and there was no need. Afraid that yielding would delay recovery, the other lifted the covers and pressed the cloth firmly into place. The city's clocks struck the hours so sweetly outside. Inside, the sound became more dreadful.

zh: 发热与疼痛搅乱了他的神志。他骂兄弟，诅咒兄弟，又说起{{e_camila|卡米拉}}，仿佛自己失去了原本有权得到的一切。照料者退到门外，背靠着门，震惊得呼吸不顺；过了一会儿，仍得重新进去，把下一次该做的事做完。
text: Fever and pain disordered his mind. He cursed his brother and spoke of {{e_camila|Camila}}, as though everything he had been entitled to possess had been taken from him. His carer retreated outside and leaned against the door, struggling to breathe in his shock. After a while he still had to go in and perform the next duty.

zh: 邻室的人敲墙，客店主人威胁要赶他们走。他举着蜡烛出去，任众人责骂，再回到床前。屋里没有新的办法，只有不断到来的下一个整点。那套原先许诺很快就能康复的医嘱，成了他不敢放下、又无法相信的事。两个人都还盼着，下一次敷上去，事情也许就会开始变好。
text: Neighbours knocked on the wall; the landlord threatened to turn them out. He went out with a candle, endured their reproaches, then returned to the bedside. There was no new remedy, only another approaching hour. The instructions that had promised a quick recovery became something he dared not abandon and could no longer believe. Both still hoped that perhaps the next application would begin to make things better.

zh: 曼努埃尔
text: Manuel

zh: 清醒的一刻
text: A Lucid Moment

zh: 我好些了。看来这些湿布还是有用。明天我就能起来，你也可以睡一觉，我不会再给你添麻烦。
text: I am better. The cloths must be helping after all. Tomorrow I shall be up, and you can sleep. I shall stop troubling you.

zh: 这不算麻烦。
text: You are no trouble.

zh: 天将亮时，[[NPC1]]平静下来。[[NPC2]]守在床边，有些话几次到了嘴边，才终于说出来。
text: Towards dawn [[NPC1]] grew quiet. [[NPC2]] sat beside him. Several times words reached his lips before he finally spoke.

zh: 要不要叫{{e_camila|卡米拉}}来看看你？只待一小会儿也好。你还觉得，是我挡在你们中间吗？我说过，我不会拦你。
text: Shall I ask {{e_camila|Camila}} to visit? Even for a little while? Do you still think I stand between you? I told you I would not prevent anything.

zh: 怎么又提她？她对我不算什么。我满意现在这样。
text: Why mention her again? She means nothing to me. I am content as I am.

zh: 可你刚才很生气，敷布的时候，你也为那件事生气。你诅咒我……
text: But you were so angry just now. When I put on the cloths, you were angry about that too. You cursed me…

zh: 那时我的腿疼。我不知道自己在说什么。你是我仅有的人，我怎么会那样诅咒你？是你太久没睡了。我把你也拖坏了。
text: My leg hurt. I did not know what I was saying. You are all I have. How could I curse you like that? You have gone too long without sleep. I have made you ill as well.

zh: 门外的晨光渐渐清楚，{{e_cloth|湿布}}还搁在盆沿。
text: Morning light strengthened beyond the door. The {{e_cloth|Wet Cloth}} still lay on the rim of the basin.

zh: 这一次先不敷了。少一次不会有事。让它安静一会儿也好。
text: Let us miss this time. Once cannot matter. Perhaps it would be better to leave it quiet.

zh: 不，我得好起来。把{{e_crucifix|十字架}}给我。要是我再说什么伤害你的话，我都不是那个意思；是疼痛使我胡说。好了，放回去吧，我准备好了。
text: No. I have to get well. Give me the {{e_crucifix|Crucifix}}. If I say anything to hurt you again, I do not mean it. The pain makes me talk wildly. There, put it back. I am ready.

zh: 真的，跳过这一次吧。
text: Truly, let us miss this one.

zh: 医生说必须做。我不会再说一个字。
text: The doctor said we must do it. I shall not say another word.

zh: 随后一切又重新开始。清醒时的保证，并没有使下一次剧痛变得轻一些。到了第三夜，他们请来了神父。床上的人在大幅摇晃的影子中领受圣礼，然后死去。屋里再没有下一次必须准时更换的湿布。守夜的人仍坐在原处，一时不知道天亮以后应当先做什么。
text: Then it all began again. A promise made in clarity did not lessen the next agony. On the third night they sent for a priest. Amid the great wavering shadows, the man in the bed received the sacrament and died. No wet cloth had to be changed at the next exact hour. The watcher remained where he was, unable for a while to imagine what he should do first when daylight came.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 隔着一条街
text: Across a Street

zh: {{e_manuel|曼努埃尔}}死后，[[NPC1]]不肯再走近那栋楼。他开始长久地步行，绕远路，又慢慢回到附近，在两条街以外徘徊。客店主人无法安排一切，只好去请养大兄弟俩的人。
text: After {{e_manuel|Manuel}} died, [[NPC1]] would not approach the building again. He walked for long hours, took detours, then drifted back to wander two streets away. The landlord could not arrange everything. He sent for the woman who had raised the brothers.

zh: [[NPC2]]来了，清楚稳妥地吩咐该做的事，随后走到街角。他看着她，目光里有渴望，也有戒备；等她走近，又侧过身，把脸转开。
text: [[NPC2]] came, gave clear and practical instructions, then went to the corner. He watched her with both longing and suspicion. As she drew near, he turned his body and averted his face.

zh: 帮我一点忙，好吗？进来看看你的兄弟，陪我一会儿。
text: Will you help me a little? Come in and see your brother. Stay with me a while.

zh: 不。
text: No.

zh: 她想起两人少年时坐在膝边，听受难的故事，其中一个忽然说，如果他们在场，便会把事情拦下来。眼前这个青年如今连一扇熟悉的门也跨不过去。她没有责备，只换了一个问题，问他究竟是哪一个。
text: She remembered the boys sitting at her knee while she told the story of the crucifixion. One had suddenly declared that, had they been there, they would have prevented it. Now this young man could not cross a familiar threshold. She did not reproach him. She changed the question and asked which brother he was.

zh: 曼努埃尔。
text: Manuel.

zh: 她顺着这个名字继续求他进屋，提起从前他肯替自己跑腿、在她生病时送来汤水。她没有细数自己做过的恩惠。等她终于说到自己也失去过人、说到神的安排，青年却慢慢离开，二十步以后又停下来。
text: Using the name he gave, she continued asking him to come inside. She recalled his errands for her and the soup he had brought when she was ill, without listing her own kindnesses to him. When at last she spoke of her own losses and of God's ordering of things, the young man slowly walked away. Twenty paces later he stopped again.

zh: 送葬那天，白日里也点着蜡烛，罩着黑头巾的人唱起令人畏惧的圣歌。他没有加入队伍，只在平行的街道里跟着，走到路口，望见那行人，又失去那行人的踪影。
text: On the day of the funeral, candles burned even in daylight. Figures in black hoods sang a fearful hymn. He did not join the procession. He followed along parallel streets, reaching a crossing, glimpsing the line of people, then losing sight of it again.

zh: 埃斯特班
text: Esteban

zh: 借来的回答
text: A Borrowed Answer

zh: 她问我是哪一个。我说了{{e_manuel|曼努埃尔}}。以前别人也总认错，我们不一定会纠正。只要另一个还在，同一个错误改不改，好像都没有什么要紧。
text: She asked which one I was. I said {{e_manuel|Manuel}}. People always confused us before, and we did not always correct them. So long as the other was there, whether we corrected the same mistake hardly seemed to matter.

zh: {{e_abbess|院长}}叫着那个名字，请我进去。她没有说我答错，只说需要我帮忙。我听见她提起送汤，提起从前跑过的路。那些事情我都记得，可为什么她现在要我走的这一小段，会变得那么远？
text: {{e_abbess|Mother Pilar}} called that name and asked me inside. She did not say my answer was wrong. She only said she needed my help. I heard her mention the soup, the roads we used to take on errands. I remembered everything. Why had this short distance she wanted me to walk become so far?

zh: 我不愿回{{e_room|那间屋子}}，走着走着却总到了附近。转过这一条街，再转过另一条，好像只是在办一件没有办完的差事。路上的人从我身边经过，谁也不需要把原来的路重新学一遍。
text: I do not want to return to the {{e_room|Brothers' Room}}, yet my walking always brings me near it. Around this street, then another, as though I am still on an unfinished errand. People pass me. None of them has to learn their old roads over again.

zh: 她说自己也曾失去过。我想听，又怕她接下来便要告诉我，事情应当这样过去。于是我走开，走出一段，仍停下来看。身后有人叫我，我却不知道用哪一个名字回去。
text: She said that she had lost someone too. I wanted to listen, and feared that next she would tell me how it ought to pass. So I walked away, then stopped and looked back. Someone behind me called. I did not know which name to return under.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 我的朋友
text: My Friend

zh: 几个月里，人们从各处带来青年人的消息。有人在干涸的河床看见他，有人在古老遗迹间遇上他，还有牧人见他满身露水站在山顶。他会找到赶车或牧羊的活，做上一阵，又不声不响地走掉。他走得很远，却总回到利马。
text: For months, reports of the young man came from everywhere. Someone had seen him in a dry riverbed, someone among ancient ruins; a shepherd found him standing on a mountain, wet with dew. He took work driving carts or tending sheep, stayed a while, then left without a word. He travelled far, but always returned to Lima.

zh: 一名修女跑来告诉[[NPC1]]，[[NPC2]]又在门外。她为这次重见已经想过许多办法：怎样使一个失去兄弟的人，重新愿意生活在人群里？此刻她把那些急切压下去，尽量平静地走到门口。
text: A nun ran to tell [[NPC1]] that [[NPC2]] was outside again. She had imagined many ways to meet him: how could someone who had lost his brother be brought to live among people again? Now she suppressed her urgency and went to the door as calmly as she could.

zh: 我的朋友。
text: My friend.

zh: 他站着发抖。那双眼睛里的渴望与不信任，她已经见过。她没有立刻要求他帮忙，也没有把人召进屋里，只又低声说了一次。
text: He stood trembling. She had seen the longing and distrust in those eyes before. She did not immediately ask for help or summon him inside. She merely repeated softly:

zh: 我的朋友。
text: My friend.

zh: 她向前一步，他却突然转身跑了。她跌跌撞撞地回到书桌旁，跪下来，愤怒地责问上帝：自己一直求智慧，为何一点也没有得到？她不过是一个擦地板的人。
text: She took a step forward. He suddenly turned and ran. Stumbling back to her desk, she knelt and angrily questioned God. She had prayed continually for wisdom; why had she received none? She was nothing but a scrubber of floors.

zh: 这些话使她责罚自己，可责罚并没有取消眼前的事。就在那段时间，她想到{{e_captain|阿尔瓦拉多船长}}。三周以后，两人谈了十分钟。第二天，船长便去找青年人，据说他正在库斯科替大学抄写东西。一次没有成功的挽留，终于变成了向另一个人求助。
text: She punished herself for these words, but the punishment did not remove the problem before her. During that time she thought of {{e_captain|Captain Alvarado}}. Three weeks later they spoke for ten minutes. The following day he went in search of the young man, said to be copying for the university in Cuzco. One failed attempt to hold him had finally become a request for another person's help.

zh: 埃斯特班
text: Esteban

zh: 化妆室门口
text: The Dressing-Room Door

zh: 这条后台楼梯，我走过许多回，抱着抄好的{{e_scripts|剧本}}，送上去，再下来。以前只想着交完差就走。现在走到门口，竟不知道手里没有东西，自己为什么来了。
text: I have climbed these backstage stairs so often, carrying copied {{e_scripts|Spanish Plays}} up and coming down again. I used to think only of finishing the errand and leaving. Now at the door, with nothing in my hands, I cannot explain why I have come.

zh: {{e_camila|卡米拉}}看见我。我很想开口，可该说什么？说我并不是那个替她写信的人？还是说，那个人已经不可能再来？她曾那么有把握地把我们并排拉到面前，宣布其中一个年纪更小。如今只剩一张脸，她会不会反倒认错？
text: {{e_camila|Camila}} sees me. I want badly to speak, but what should I say? That I am not the man who wrote her letters? Or that he can never come again? Once she drew us side by side and confidently declared one of us the younger. With only one face left, will she be more likely to mistake it?

zh: 房间里有镜子，有演戏用的东西。我记得那个深夜，她俯在{{e_manuel|曼努埃尔}}耳旁说话，我从床上望过去，以为那里已经没有我的位置。后来位置重新空出来，事情却没有回到从前。
text: There is a mirror and there are things for the stage. I remember that midnight when she leaned close to {{e_manuel|Manuel}}'s ear. From the bed I thought there was no place left for me. Later the place became empty again. Nothing returned to what it had been.

zh: 她等着我。我看着她，仍没有把那句话找出来。门外的楼梯就在身后，我又走回去。这一次，没有人会问我，怎么交一份东西也去了那么久。
text: She waits. I look at her and still cannot find the sentence. The stairs are behind me. I go down them again. This time no one will ask why delivering a piece of work took so long.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 一张晚饭的邀请
text: An Invitation to Supper

zh: [[NPC1]]走进昏暗的厨房，没有立刻向青年打招呼。[[NPC2]]把椅子往阴影里挪了一点。他们从前一起卸过货，三个人都不爱说废话；这位航海者出现，使他有一点高兴，也使他想赶快藏好。等饭吃完，对方才走来。
text: [[NPC1]] entered the dim kitchen without greeting the young man at once. [[NPC2]] moved his chair farther into shadow. They had unloaded ships together before; none of the three had liked idle talk. The sailor's arrival pleased him a little and made him want to hide. Only when the meal was finished did the older man approach.

zh: 你以前替我卸过船。我在找几个强壮的人，准备下一趟航行。愿意来吗？英国，还有俄国。活很重，报酬不错，离秘鲁很远。
text: You have unloaded ships for me. I need strong men for my next voyage. Will you come? England, and Russia. Hard work, good pay, a long way from Peru.

zh: 青年盯着桌面，许久不答。船长把问题又说了一遍。
text: The young man stared at the table and did not answer for a long while. The captain repeated the question.

zh: 好，我去。
text: Yes. I will go.

zh: 很好。自然，我也想让你兄弟一起去。
text: Good. Naturally I would like your brother to come too.

zh: 不。
text: No.

zh: 他不愿意吗？让我和他谈谈。他在哪里？
text: Does he not want to? Let me talk to him. Where is he?

zh: ……死了。
text: …Dead.

zh: 两人都看着地面。船长问他叫什么，他这次说出了自己的名字，没有再借用另一个。
text: Both looked at the floor. When the captain asked his name, he gave his own this time. He did not borrow the other one.

zh: {{e_manuel|曼努埃尔}}什么时候去的？
text: When did {{e_manuel|Manuel}} die?

zh: 几个星期前。他撞伤了膝盖。就几个星期。
text: A few weeks ago. He hurt his knee. Only a few weeks.

zh: 你多大了？
text: How old are you?

zh: 二十二。我要走了，城里还有一件事。
text: Twenty-two. I must go. I have something to do in town.

zh: 那么晚上回来，陪我吃饭，谈谈航程。到时候来喝一点酒，好吗？
text: Then come back this evening. Have supper with me and we will discuss the voyage. Come and have a little wine, will you?

zh: 好。
text: Yes.

zh: 没有人说出一句足以解释死亡的话。桌上只是留下了一个可以兑现的约定：今晚，再回到这里坐一会儿。
text: Neither found a sentence that could explain death. What remained at the table was simply a promise that could be kept: tonight, come back and sit here a while.

zh: 埃斯特班
text: Esteban

zh: 给我事情做
text: Give Me Work

zh: 到了船上，请一直给我事情做，{{e_captain|船长}}。什么都可以。白天不够，夜里也可以，反正我原本就睡不好。别让我坐在那里，等着下一阵钟声。
text: Keep giving me work aboard, {{e_captain|Captain Alvarado}}. Anything. If the day is not enough, the night will do; I do not sleep well anyway. Do not leave me sitting there, waiting for the next bell.

zh: 也别向那些人讲我的事。我知道他们也许只是好心，可他们一安静下来，看着我，我就不知道应该怎样站着。您可以装作从前不认识我，给我最多的活，别让我觉得自己是被特别照看的那个。
text: And do not tell the others about me. I know they may mean well. But when they fall silent and look at me, I do not know how to stand. Pretend you never knew me. Give me the most work. Do not make me feel I am the one being specially watched.

zh: 桌前的抄写做不下去了。{{e_scripts|稿本}}就在眼前，字一个个排列得很整齐，旁边却总像应该还有一支笔。有时候我宁可累得什么都不想。
text: I cannot copy at the desk anymore. The {{e_scripts|Spanish Plays}} lie before me, their words all neatly arranged, and still it seems another pen ought to be beside mine. Sometimes I would rather be too tired to think.

zh: 您问起我曾经救过一个人。我记得那件事，也记得自己为什么会说着说着，突然换了话题。我们从前养过一条狗——不，这个先不说。您认识{{e_abbess|院长}}吗？在走之前，我还有一件事想为她做。
text: You asked about a man I once rescued. I remember that, and why I suddenly changed the subject while speaking of it. We once had a dog—no, not that now. Do you know {{e_abbess|Mother Pilar}}? There is something I want to do for her before we leave.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 不是我一个人的
text: Not Mine Alone

zh: 离开以前，我想送{{e_abbess|院长}}一件{{e_gift|礼物}}。能把工钱先给我吗？我在外面用不上钱，现在就想给她买。
text: Before leaving I want to give {{e_abbess|Mother Pilar}} a {{e_gift|Gift}}. Could I have my wages in advance? I shall not need money away. I want to buy it now.

zh: 可以。早晨一起去挑。
text: Certainly. We will choose something in the morning.

zh: 也不只是我一个人送的。她从前……她曾经……
text: It would not be from me alone. Once she… she once…

zh: [[NPC1]]想说出兄弟的名字，却没有做到。他换成更低的声音，提起院长自己曾说过，她也遭受过严重的失去。他不知道那个人是谁，却一直记得这句话。
text: [[NPC1]] tried to speak his brother's name and could not. More quietly he mentioned that the abbess herself had told him of a terrible loss. He did not know whom she had lost, but had remembered her words.

zh: 我想给她一点东西。那样的事，她不容易受得住。
text: I want to give her something. A thing like that is hard for her to bear.

zh: 他又说了很久。[[NPC2]]听着，答应第二天处理。等青年喝醉伏下，船长走到客店外的广场，看山脉和一群群星星。那时，他也想起一个声音：别去太久，等回来时，我就长成大姑娘了。
text: He spoke for a long time. [[NPC2]] listened and promised to see to it the next day. When the young man fell forward in drunkenness, the captain went into the square outside the inn and looked at the mountains and clusters of stars. He too remembered a voice: do not be away too long; I shall be a big girl when you return.

zh: 他的女儿已经死了。{{e_maria|玛丽亚}}曾听他谈起她，把这个故事写进给自己女儿的信；他说，有时总觉得孩子只是在外旅行，或许在英国，过些日子还能再见。再远的航程，也没把这种错觉完全留在身后。
text: His daughter was dead. {{e_maria|María}} had once heard him speak of her and put the story into a letter to her own daughter. Sometimes, he said, he felt the child was merely travelling—perhaps in England—and that he might see her again after a little while. No voyage, however far, had entirely left that illusion behind.

zh: 船长又走回屋内，把青年抱回房间，坐着看了很久。明早要挑的东西还没有名字，答应做这件事的人却已经坐在这里。礼物属于两个兄弟，眼前的照料则只能先从一个活着的人开始。
text: The captain went indoors, carried the young man to his room and sat watching him for a long time. Tomorrow's present still had no name. The person who had promised to arrange it was already here. The gift would belong to both brothers. For now, care had to begin with one living person.

zh: 埃斯特班
text: Esteban

zh: 楼梯上的反悔
text: Hesitation on the Stairs

zh: {{e_cuzco|库斯科}}的早晨到了。昨天已经答应了。今天站到楼梯上，才发现答应并没有把事情做完。{{e_captain|船长}}在下面等，我却忽然说，不能去，还是不能离开秘鲁。
text: Morning has come in {{e_cuzco|Cuzco}}. Yesterday I agreed. Standing on the stairs today, I discover that agreeing did not finish the matter. {{e_captain|Captain Alvarado}} waits below. Suddenly I say that I cannot go, cannot leave Peru after all.

zh: 他没有提高声音，只问起给{{e_abbess|院长}}的礼物。那件事是真的，我不想收回。她说过自己也失去过人，我一直记得；昨晚想把另一个名字也加上，嘴里却怎么都说不出来。
text: He does not raise his voice. He asks about the present for {{e_abbess|Mother Pilar}}. That was real; I do not want to take it back. She said she too had lost someone. I remember. Last night I tried to add another name to the gift and could not make my mouth say it.

zh: 从前要拿主意，多半由{{e_manuel|曼努埃尔}}来。换一件差事，换一个地方，我们总能一起走。可这一次，去哪儿都只有一个人的脚步；留下来，熟悉的路同样没有改变。
text: Usually {{e_manuel|Manuel}} decided. Another job, another place: we could always go together. This time wherever I go, there will be only one person's footsteps. If I stay, the familiar roads have not changed either.

zh: 船长说，到海上会有事做，去把东西拿来就好。我转身往楼上走，把这一小段路走得很慢。门外还留着一个等我的人，我知道他在，却仍不知道怎样把自己带回他面前。
text: The captain says there will be work at sea. I need only fetch my things. I turn upstairs and walk that short distance very slowly. There is still someone outside waiting for me. I know he is there. I still do not know how to bring myself back to him.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 门被推开
text: The Door Opens

zh: [[NPC1]]在楼下等，时间过了很久。他往楼梯上走了一段，停下来听。起初没有声音，随后屋里的动静让他明白，青年正处在危险之中。
text: [[NPC1]] waited downstairs for a long time. He climbed part of the staircase and stopped to listen. At first there was no sound. Then a movement within told him that the young man was in danger.

zh: 他也曾有过最难熬的时刻，因此一瞬间竟不知道自己的介入是否有用。那犹疑只停留了片刻。他冲上去推开门，抓住了[[NPC2]]，没有让眼前的事继续发生。
text: He had known unbearable moments himself. For an instant he could not tell whether intervening would help. The hesitation lasted only a moment. He rushed upstairs, pushed open the door and caught hold of [[NPC2]], stopping what was happening.

zh: 走开。让我一个人待着。不要现在进来。
text: Go away. Leave me alone. Do not come in now.

zh: 青年伏到地上，反复说自己是孤单的。船长站在旁边，脸色灰白，旧日的痛苦也被重新唤醒。会辨认星辰、海流和海岬，不表示他就会找到安慰人的好句子。离开航海的事，他原本是个很笨拙的说话者。
text: The young man sank to the floor, repeating that he was alone. The captain stood beside him, his face grey, his old suffering awakened. Knowing stars, currents and headlands did not mean he could find words of comfort. Away from matters of navigation, he had always spoken awkwardly.

zh: 我们只能尽力，尽力往前过。时间一直在走。有一天，会吃惊它竟这样过去了。
text: We can only try. Try to go on. Time keeps passing. One day we shall be astonished that it has passed.

zh: 他不能确定这些话有没有被听进去，也没有把它们说成一个保证。青年没有立即站起来，更没有因为有人开口，便重新看见生活的全部意义。屋里只是多了一个愿意留下的人。
text: He did not know whether his words had been heard, and did not offer them as a guarantee. The young man did not rise at once. Someone speaking did not suddenly restore the whole meaning of life. There was simply another person in the room who was willing to stay.

zh: 先前约好的{{e_gift|礼物}}、要去的港口、下一次航行，都还在门外等着。此刻船长没有催他回楼下，把这个早晨交给了一件更小、更近的事：陪他把眼前这一刻过完。
text: The promised {{e_gift|Gift}}, the harbour and the next voyage were all waiting beyond the door. For now the captain did not urge him downstairs. He gave the morning to something smaller and nearer: remaining with him through this moment.

zh: 埃斯特班
text: Esteban

zh: 桥上与河边
text: On the Bridge, by the River

zh: 我们动身了。路仍是那些路，往前一段，再往前一段。我没有忽然变成另一个人，也没有把昨夜的事留在某个已经关上的房间里。只是有人走在旁边，不要求我每一步都解释为什么愿意继续。
text: We set out. The roads are still the same roads: one stretch, then another. I have not suddenly become someone else. I have not left last night in a closed room. Someone is merely walking beside me, without requiring an explanation for every step I am willing to take.

zh: 到了{{e_bridge|圣路易斯雷大桥}}，{{e_captain|船长}}要去下面看货物渡河。那些东西不从这条窄窄的人行桥上过，得有人到水边照看。我从桥上走。他去办自己的事，我们本来还要重新会合。
text: At the {{e_bridge|Bridge of San Luis Rey}}, {{e_captain|Captain Alvarado}} goes down to oversee the cargo crossing the river. It cannot go over this narrow footbridge; someone must attend to it by the water. I take the bridge. He goes about his work. We are supposed to meet again.

zh: 青年踏上了桥。河谷下面，货运仍有自己的忙碌；桥上，脚步落在薄木板之间。就在这一次过河时，桥断了，他随桥坠落。
text: The young man stepped onto the bridge. Below, the business of moving cargo continued; above, footsteps fell upon the thin boards. During this crossing the bridge broke. He fell with it.

zh: 船长留在下方，并不是因为事先知道危险。那天的分别没有告别的仪式，只有两个人各走了一条本来很寻常的路。后来再说起他们的远航计划，许多句子只能停在‘本来’两个字上。
text: The captain remained below because of his work, not because he knew of any danger. There was no ceremony of farewell that day. Two people simply took two ordinarily unremarkable routes. Afterwards, when their voyage was mentioned, many sentences could go no farther than 'we were going to'.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 总从后门来
text: Always Through the Back Door

zh: [[NPC1]]十岁时从父亲的庄园跑到马德里，家里没有认真把他找回去。他替商人发传单、看马、跑不便明说的差事，后来又训练过巡回马戏里的动物，做过饭，替人打听消息。认名字，认面孔，同陌生人说上话，他都有自己的办法。
text: At ten, [[NPC1]] ran from his father's estate to Madrid. His family made little effort to retrieve him. He handed out merchants' notices, watched horses and ran errands best left unexplained. Later he trained animals for travelling circuses, cooked and gathered information. He had his own ways of learning names, recognising faces and speaking to strangers.

zh: 一桩生意眼看可以赚大钱，他却往往先厌倦了。他不愿被财产和长久的约定拴住，更不愿被关起来。可以从剧院转到宫廷，也可以从古董转到丝绸，只要下星期不必继续扮演上星期那个人。
text: Just as a business began to promise a fortune, he would often tire of it. He did not want possessions or lasting commitments to bind him, and above all did not want to be shut away. He could move from theatre to court, from antiques to silk, provided that next week he need not continue playing last week's man.

zh: 后来他来了秘鲁，几个月里便结识了城里许多人，接着又把海岸城镇、矿区和内地的消息串起来。{{e_viceroy|总督}}发现了他的用处。他走那些不引人注目的走廊，从后面进去，陪主人喝早晨的巧克力，也办些不宜交给普通侍从的事。
text: Eventually he came to Peru. In a few months he knew many people in the city, then connected reports from coastal towns, mines and the interior. {{e_viceroy|Viceroy Andrés}} discovered his usefulness. He passed along inconspicuous corridors, entered from behind, shared his patron's morning chocolate, and performed tasks unsuitable for ordinary attendants.

zh: 他不明白，一个握有这么大权力的人，为什么没有更大的兴致去安排别人的命运；但对方能够随口引出塞万提斯，又知道哪些差事不该逼他去做，这使他愿意来往。
text: He could not understand why someone with such power took no greater pleasure in arranging other people's fates. But the man could quote Cervantes at will and knew which errands not to press upon him. That made the acquaintance worth keeping.

zh: 城里人叫他叔叔，却不是因为他同谁有确切的血缘。他替女人写信，在她们失意时借钱，生病时比情人和女仆守得更久。那些人的生活给了他一个随时可以进出的地方；他喜欢被信任，也喜欢自己比别人知道得更多。
text: The city called him Uncle, without any definite kinship. He wrote letters for women, lent them money in distress, and stayed through illnesses longer than lovers or maids. Their lives offered places where he could come and go. He liked being trusted. He also liked knowing more than other people.

zh: 皮奥
text: Pio

zh: 满屋的聪明动物
text: A House of Clever Animals

zh: 没有几个人知道我也有一所房子。狗在下面，鸟在楼上。有的狗会做算术，叫它们表演，它们就认真地看着我。屋里等着听我说话的，倒是它们。
text: Few people know I have a house. The dogs live downstairs, the birds above. Some of the dogs can do arithmetic. When I ask for a performance, they look at me earnestly. They are the ones waiting to hear me speak at home.

zh: 挣钱不是难事，难的是为了保住一件东西，不得不在同一个地方待太久。我喜欢来去自由，喜欢知道一扇门后面是谁，也喜欢别人还没开口，我就已经知道他要问什么。
text: Money is not difficult to earn. The difficulty is having to stay too long in one place in order to keep a thing. I like coming and going freely, knowing who waits behind a door, knowing what someone wishes to ask before they speak.

zh: {{e_lima|利马}}有许多自称有教养的人，读到{{e_scripts|西班牙戏剧}}最好的句子，却像经过一张空桌子。词序稍微一换，整个心境都变了，他们竟看不出来。这些书是我自己一点点找来的，借过，也偷过；我不会因为没人看见，就少爱它们一点。
text: Many people in {{e_lima|Lima}} call themselves cultivated. They pass the finest sentences in {{e_scripts|Spanish Plays}} as if passing an empty table. Change the order of a few words and the whole state of mind changes; they cannot even see it. I found these books little by little, borrowed some and stole others. I do not love them less because no one notices.

zh: 我一直想写诗，也想找到一个人，能把那些句子说到恰好。等那个人开口时，连我都不必站在门边解释，她的声音自己就能使别人明白。
text: I have always wanted to write poetry. I have also wanted to find someone who could speak those sentences exactly as they should be spoken. When she began, I would no longer need to stand at the door explaining. Her voice itself would make people understand.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 咖啡馆的歌
text: A Song in the Café

zh: [[NPC2]]十二岁时就在咖啡馆唱歌。她身材还没有长开，脸也显得饥饿、局促，却已经会模仿前面那些成熟歌者的每一种抑扬。[[NPC1]]坐在吉他手中间听着，心里生出一个决定：要亲手把这份才华培养出来。
text: At twelve, [[NPC2]] was already singing in cafés. Her figure was still unformed, her face hungry and awkward, yet she could imitate every inflection of the mature singers before her. Sitting among the guitarists, [[NPC1]] listened and formed a resolution: he would cultivate this talent himself.

zh: 他付钱把女孩带走。她不用再锁在存酒的地方睡觉，而在他家里有了一张小床；有热汤，不挨鞭子，还能学习。对她而言，这几件眼前的变化，比成为了不起的艺术家更容易感到真实。
text: He paid to take the girl away. Instead of sleeping locked in the wine-storage room, she had a small bed in his house. There was hot soup, no whipping, and an opportunity to learn. These immediate changes were more real to her than the prospect of becoming a great artist.

zh: 他写歌给她，买新衣服，教她分辨自己发声的好坏，让她练表演、练模仿，也练怎样用一个声音带出整首歌的气氛。他带她去{{e_theatre|剧院}}，要求她留意别人的每一个动作。她吃苦耐劳，沉默而认真，学得比他最大胆的设想还快。
text: He wrote songs, bought her new clothes and taught her to judge the quality of her voice. She practised acting, imitation and the creation of a whole song's atmosphere through sound. He took her to the {{e_theatre|Theatre}} and required her to notice every gesture. Hard-working, quiet and attentive, she learned faster than his boldest hopes.

zh: 她慢慢长成了一个优雅的人，也对这个老师十分忠诚。只要他靠得太近，脸上仍会掠过一点紧张；他察觉到了，便把那距离保留下来。她会向他请教，也肯信任他安排下一段行程。新衣、饭食、训练和下一个演唱的地方，都经由这个人的手进入她的生活。
text: She gradually became graceful and deeply loyal to her teacher. A trace of tension still crossed her face when he came too close. He noticed and maintained the distance. She sought his advice and trusted him to arrange their next journey. Clothing, meals, training and the next place to sing all entered her life through his hands.

zh: 女孩的名字后来传遍城里。他最初看见的，却是一个还在模仿别人的孩子；她最初得到的，也不是喝彩，而是某天晚上的一碗热汤，一张不再上锁的床，以及第二天仍能继续学的本事。那个付钱的人，同时也决定着她下一次何时唱、到哪里唱。
text: In time her name would be known throughout the city. What he first saw was a child still imitating others. What she first received was not applause, but hot soup one evening, a bed no longer locked away, and the means to keep learning the next day. The man who paid also determined when and where she would next sing.

zh: 皮奥
text: Pio

zh: 同一条披巾
text: The Same Shawl

zh: 咖啡馆喜欢新面孔。{{e_camila|卡米拉}}唱得再好，在一个地方唱久了，也得去找下一间。所以我们一路走，衣服裹在同一条{{e_shawl|披巾}}里，有床便睡床，没有就睡海滩。
text: Cafés like fresh faces. However well {{e_camila|Camila}} sang, after too long in one place we had to find another. So we travelled, our clothes wrapped together in the same {{e_shawl|Shawl}}. We slept in beds when there were beds, and on beaches when there were none.

zh: 去过墨西哥，在巴拿马挨过打，也在太平洋的小岛上遇过船难。林子里有蛇和甲虫，走路得仔细；收成忙的时候，就把自己的手脚暂时卖给农人。许多事，经历了一次便不再惊奇。
text: We went to Mexico, were beaten in Panama and shipwrecked on a small Pacific island. There were snakes and beetles in the forest; one had to walk carefully. At harvest we hired our hands and legs to farmers. Many things cease to astonish once you have lived through them.

zh: 她不是一路等人照顾的孩子。我让她听一段歌，她会把细微的转折记住；让她看一次表演，她也能指出哪里变了。想起这样的本领还可以往前长，我就觉得下一段路值得走。
text: She was no child merely waiting to be looked after. Let her hear a song and she remembered its smallest turns. Let her watch a performance and she could say what had changed. The thought of such ability still growing made the next journey worth taking.

zh: 后来{{e_lima|利马}}的人只看见她穿好的衣服，听她唱最成熟的声音。有时我很想告诉他们，我们的东西曾经少到一条披巾就装得下。可她上台时若不愿提起，我便在下面听着。那些路上，我也因她而有了愿意继续的事，只是总以为自己比她更懂得将来该往哪里走。雨停以后，还得赶路。
text: Later, people in {{e_lima|Lima}} saw only her fine clothes and heard her most accomplished voice. Sometimes I wanted to tell them that once all we owned fitted into a shawl. If she did not wish to mention it onstage, I listened below. On those roads, she too gave me a reason to continue. I simply kept believing that I knew better where the future ought to lead. When the rain stopped, we had to travel on.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 喝彩以后
text: After the Applause

zh: [[NPC1]]回到化妆室，听见角落里的口哨，就知道今晚又有哪里不对。[[NPC2]]说没什么，她已经尽力了。那种语气比直接指责更难忍：仿佛她的本领最多只能到这里。
text: Returning to her dressing room, [[NPC1]] heard the whistling in the corner and knew that something had been wrong again tonight. [[NPC2]] said it was nothing; she had done her best. That tone was harder to bear than an accusation, as though her talent could go no farther.

zh: 到底是什么？又是什么？我已经准备听了，别这样站着。
text: What was it? What now? I am ready to hear it. Do not stand there like that.

zh: 没什么，我的小珍珠。
text: Nothing, my little pearl.

zh: 我自己知道今晚有地方演得弱，用不着你告诉我。我只是想回到这里，不要再看见你这种样子。
text: I know there were weak moments tonight. You need not tell me. I only wanted to come back here without seeing you look like that.

zh: 对囚犯的那一段，为什么说得那么快？
text: Why did you speak so quickly to the prisoner?

zh: 一天叫我快，一天叫我慢。观众从没那样{{e_applause|鼓掌}}过，他们哭了。我只在乎这个。别再说了。你可以梳我的头发，只要别再说一个字。
text: One day you want it faster, another slower. The audience has never given such {{e_applause|Applause}}. They wept. That is all I care about. Stop talking. You may comb my hair, if you do not say another word.

zh: 他梳了十分钟，仿佛没看见她哭得发抖。她终于转过身，攥住他的手。
text: For ten minutes he combed her hair as if he did not see her shaking with tears. At last she turned and seized his hand.

zh: 我真那么坏吗？坏得让你离开座位？
text: Was I so bad? Bad enough to make you leave your seat?

zh: 船上的一场很好。收尾也还不错。可是，对囚犯的那段话……
text: The scene on the ship was good. The ending was quite good too. But the speech to the prisoner…

zh: 她把脸埋到桌上的手臂里。只有完美才够，完美却从没有真的到来。等哭声低下来，两人又开始谈声音、手势、快慢，重念{{e_scripts|剧本}}里的台词。观众早已满意，他们却常常直到天明，还在逼近一个谁也没法交出来的尺度。
text: She buried her face in her arms on the table. Only perfection would suffice, and perfection never truly arrived. When the sobbing subsided, they spoke again of voice, gesture and pace, repeating lines from the {{e_scripts|Spanish Plays}}. The audience had long been satisfied. They often continued until dawn, approaching a standard neither could quite deliver.

zh: 皮奥
text: Pio

zh: 诗人的孙女
text: The Poet's Granddaughter

zh: 我告诉{{e_camila|卡米拉}}，那位诗人的孙女来了。我们从他的{{e_scripts|戏剧}}里选了一出，练了一遍又一遍。她曾经厌倦那些总围着男人转的角色，可这一回，每个句子又使她认真起来。
text: I told {{e_camila|Camila}} that the poet's granddaughter had come. We chose one of his {{e_scripts|Spanish Plays}} and rehearsed it again and again. She had grown tired of roles that revolved endlessly around men. This time every sentence commanded her attention anew.

zh: 开演前，她从幕缝向外看，要我指给她：究竟是哪一位。我指着那个被家务、孩子和贫穷磨倦了的中年女人。她却像看见了世上全部的高贵，站在我旁边，安静得一句话也没有。
text: Before the performance she peered through the curtain and asked me to point out the visitor. I indicated a middle-aged woman worn down by housekeeping, children and poverty. She looked as though she had seen all the nobility in the world, standing beside me without a word.

zh: 演完以后，我把客人领进化妆室。她哭着，跪下吻那女人的手，对方又吻她的手。观众回家了，灯还亮着，她们仍在说，诗人从前怎样写作，在家又有哪些别人不知道的小习惯。
text: Afterwards I led the visitor into the dressing room. Weeping, she knelt to kiss the woman's hands; the woman kissed hers in return. The audience went home. The lamps remained lit. They were still talking about how the poet wrote, and the small habits at home that strangers never knew.

zh: 那一夜我没有再索要更多。她已经把我最珍惜的东西放到舞台上，又从一个陌生女人那里，得到并非只为美貌而来的回答。这份欢喜，掌声散了以后还在。
text: That night I demanded nothing more. She had brought what I treasured most onto the stage, and received from a stranger an answer that was not merely for her beauty. The joy remained after the applause had faded.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 天亮的夜宴
text: A Supper Reaching Dawn

zh: 演出结束后，[[NPC1]]赶来赴夜宴，常已是凌晨一点。她珠光耀眼，也累得厉害。[[NPC2]]和几位客人像迎接一位女王那样接住她的到来。起初仍由她带着众人说笑，后来她渐渐靠在主人肩上，只听话题从一张有趣而衰老的脸，移向另一张。
text: By the time [[NPC1]] arrived after a performance, it was often one in the morning. Her jewels dazzled; she was exhausted. [[NPC2]] and his guests welcomed her like a queen. At first she led the conversation and laughter. Gradually she leaned against her host's shoulder, listening as the talk passed from one interesting, ageing face to another.

zh: {{e_pio|皮奥}}也在。还有喜欢文学、穿紫衣的{{e_archbishop|大主教}}，以及走过许多海域的{{e_captain|阿尔瓦拉多船长}}。他们谈战争、国王、诗人和远方，也谈鬼魂、灵魂离开身体时能否看见、星辰会不会相撞。夜越深，每个人越容易把自己的遗憾说成一个机智的故事。
text: {{e_pio|Pio}} was there, with the literary {{e_archbishop|Archbishop of Lima}} in violet and the widely travelled {{e_captain|Captain Alvarado}}. They discussed wars, kings, poets and distant countries; ghosts, whether a departing soul could be seen, whether stars might collide. As the night deepened, each found it easier to turn a regret into a witty story.

zh: 他们都怀念{{e_spain|西班牙}}，便告诉自己，这样的谈话正合乎高贵的西班牙精神。女演员从这生活里学到新的从容：怎样随意握杯，怎样在门口告别，怎样把一个称呼说得仿佛从小就会。皮奥在台下看见这些细节，觉得她的演技又添了光彩。
text: They all missed {{e_spain|Spain}}, and assured themselves that this conversation embodied the noble Spanish spirit. The actress learned a new ease from such life: how to hold a glass casually, take leave at a door, or speak a title as though she had known it from childhood. Pio noticed these details in her performances and felt they added lustre.

zh: 金色晨光终于越过安第斯山，照到果盘、沾过酒的桌布和她沉睡的额头。话声停下来，谁也不愿第一个起身。众人的目光落在她身上，像看一只误飞进这间屋子的美丽鸟儿。
text: At last golden morning light crossed the Andes and reached the fruit, the wine-stained cloth and her sleeping forehead. The talk ceased. No one wished to rise first. Their eyes rested on her as on a beautiful bird that had accidentally flown into the room.

zh: 她以为自己将永远幸福。老师却仍在观察，等她的经验变得足够深，能够使某几段台词说得更好。夜宴给了每个人片刻安慰，他们想从这位女人身上得到的，却从来不是同一件事。窗外城市逐渐醒来，桌边的人仍用旧故事拖延这一刻。
text: She believed she would be happy forever. Her teacher continued to observe, waiting for experience to deepen enough to improve certain speeches. The supper brought each a little comfort. They had never wanted the same thing from this woman. Outside, the city woke. At the table they delayed the moment with old stories.

zh: 卡米拉
text: Camila

zh: 散场后的脸
text: The Face After the Performance

zh: 脸一停下来，镜子里就不是观众见到的那个人了。嘴显得疲倦，眼睛也总像还在寻找什么。一个角色需要的笑容可以学会，可散场以后，不知道该把它交给谁。
text: Once my face is still, the person in the mirror is not the one the audience saw. The mouth looks tired; the eyes seem always to be searching. I can learn the smile a role requires. After the performance I do not know whom to give it to.

zh: {{e_viceroy|总督}}教我法语，教我那些大人物不正式见客时的样子。我学得很快。上台以后，手指怎样碰杯子，走进一扇门之前怎样停一下，连{{e_pio|皮奥}}也看得欢喜。我的生活进了戏里，他就觉得一切都有益处。
text: {{e_viceroy|Viceroy Andrés}} teaches me French and the manners of important people when they are not receiving formal guests. I learn quickly. Onstage, the way my fingers touch a glass or I pause before a doorway delights even {{e_pio|Pio}}. When my life enters a play, he thinks everything has been useful.

zh: 可我不只是为了下一场表演活着。{{e_applause|掌声}}有时使我温暖，有时又像每天准时结算的一笔账。观众看不出我今晚分了神，老师看得出，便又觉得我辜负了什么。
text: But I do not live only for the next performance. {{e_applause|Applause}} sometimes warms me. Sometimes it resembles an account settled punctually each day. The audience does not notice when my mind wanders. My teacher does, and feels that I have failed something again.

zh: 我想恋爱，想有自己的家，也想在别人不打量我的时候安静坐着。每一种愿望都占着一个地方，偏偏这个身体每天还要换衣、背词、出场，再笑着赶去下一场夜宴。
text: I want to fall in love, to have a home, to sit quietly when no one is inspecting me. Each wish takes up space. Yet every day this same body must dress, learn lines, make its entrance and hurry smiling to another late supper.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 一个体面的称呼
text: A Respectable Form of Address

zh: 大约三十岁时，[[NPC1]]离开了舞台。要在上流社会站稳，又花了五年。她带上女伴和仆从，在时髦的时辰去教堂，出现在大学颁奖礼和慈善捐赠者的名单里。过去的演出被她称作消遣，仿佛只是一段不宜太认真追问的往事。
text: At about thirty, [[NPC1]] left the stage. It took another five years to establish herself in society. Accompanied by women friends and servants, she attended church at fashionable hours, appeared at university ceremonies and joined lists of charitable donors. She called her old performances a diversion, as though they were a past into which one ought not enquire too seriously.

zh: 她还学会了一点读写，替自己安排体面的亲属关系，为孩子争取合法身份。有人露出一点把她当作流浪艺人的意思，她便激烈反击。她要的不只是华服，也是一种不会因为出身而被随手收回的尊重。
text: She learned a little reading and writing, arranged respectable relations for herself and secured legitimacy for her children. Any hint that someone considered her a wandering entertainer brought a fierce response. She wanted more than fine clothes: she wanted respect that her origins could not casually take away.

zh: 可是{{e_respectability|体面}}很难带来想象中的安宁。她在贵妇面前努力温柔，在别处却越发烦躁。饰物和羽毛层层堆起，镜子与地板反光里，那个人看上去越来越像已经到达了目的地。她自己仍在等待，等地位所许诺的幸福真正开始。
text: But {{e_respectability|Respectability}} did not readily produce the peace she had imagined. She strove to be gentle before great ladies, and became more irritable elsewhere. Ornaments and feathers accumulated. In mirrors and polished floors she increasingly resembled a woman who had arrived. She herself still waited for the happiness her position had promised.

zh: 她逐渐暗示{{e_pio|皮奥}}，不要在公开场合与她来往。后来连私下探访也使她不耐烦。她用客套的话、避开的目光、随时可能开始的争执，把旧日伙伴隔在新的生活之外。
text: Gradually she hinted that {{e_pio|Pio}} should avoid her in public. Later even his private visits irritated her. Polite phrases, averted eyes and quarrels always ready to begin separated her old companion from her new life.

zh: 他每月仍来一次。谈不下去，就上楼去看孩子们。两个大人都记得他们曾经怎样一起生活，但一个急于证明自己能够改变，另一个始终希望那份旧日亲密还可以原样回来。
text: He still came once a month. When conversation failed, he went upstairs to see the children. Both adults remembered how they had once lived together. One was eager to prove she could change; the other kept hoping that their old intimacy might return unchanged.

zh: 卡米拉
text: Camila

zh: 晴天里的孩子
text: A Child in the Sunshine

zh: {{e_jaime|海梅}}走在后面几步。那些想拉住他说话的女士，使他很不自在，他总认真地想办法脱身，然后又跟过来。天气好的时候，我们就这样走在{{e_garden|法式花园}}的台阶之间，很少说什么。
text: {{e_jaime|Jaime}} walks a few paces behind. The ladies who try to detain him in conversation make him uneasy. He earnestly finds a way to escape them, then follows again. In fine weather we walk like this among the terraces of the {{e_garden|French Gardens}}, saying little.

zh: 他曾穿着石榴红的天鹅绒衣服，那么瘦小，又那么严肃。病发时，他最难受的仿佛不是自己受苦，而是别人看见了。他继承了我的额头和眼睛，也继承了父亲身体里的脆弱，我却不能替他承担哪怕一小会儿。
text: In his garnet velvet he was so small and so solemn. During an attack, it seemed the hardest part was not his own suffering but having others see it. He inherited my forehead and eyes, and his father's bodily frailty. I cannot bear even a moment of it for him.

zh: 我等着生活终于使我满意，他只为眼前有阳光而高兴。他看天上的云，像在计算它什么时候会遮住我们。我不向他发脾气，也不大会突然把他抱到怀里；我们就保持着那几步的距离，继续往前。
text: I wait for life to satisfy me at last. He is pleased simply because the sun is out. He watches a cloud as if calculating when it will cover us. I do not lose my temper with him, nor am I given to suddenly taking him in my arms. We keep those few paces between us and continue.

zh: 这里被修得很像欧洲，精心安排的树、栏杆和小径，人人知道怎样散步才得体。我和这个孩子站在其中，有时却像还没有学会当地语言的异乡人。一阵不适过后，他依旧努力离那些关切的女士远一点。
text: The place has been made to resemble Europe: carefully arranged trees, railings and paths. Everyone knows the proper manner of strolling. Among them this child and I sometimes seem like foreigners who have not learned the language. After a spell of illness, he still tries to keep a little farther from the solicitous ladies.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 并不存在的岛
text: An Island That Did Not Exist

zh: 黄昏时，[[NPC1]]靠在一张缺角的大理石长椅旁等她。他想重温昔日流浪时的信任和玩笑；[[NPC2]]一来，却先纠正了他习惯的称呼，随即不耐烦地让他随意。
text: At dusk [[NPC1]] waited beside a chipped marble bench. He hoped to recover the trust and jokes of their wandering years. When [[NPC2]] arrived, she first corrected his familiar form of address, then impatiently told him to call her what he liked.

zh: 要我回{{e_theatre|剧院}}，那就不必说了。想起那个地方，我只觉得害怕。每天领到那么多侮辱，够了。
text: If you want me back at the {{e_theatre|Theatre}}, say no more. The thought of that place frightens me. So many insults every day. Enough.

zh: 如果你和这些新朋友过得快活，我不会要你回去。
text: If you were happy with these new friends, I would not ask you to return.

zh: 不喜欢我的朋友？那准备拿谁来替换？我不想听劝告。把我忘掉就是了。
text: You dislike my friends? Whom do you propose to replace them with? I want no advice. Forget me.

zh: 他没有明白她为何落泪，仍说着剧场的衰落。她忽然碰了碰他的膝盖，神情像许多年以前。
text: He did not understand why she wept and continued describing the theatre's decline. Suddenly she touched his knee, looking as she had many years before.

zh: 原谅我，{{e_jaime|海梅}}下午又病了。他躺在那里，那么白，那么惊讶，谁也没有办法。只能想些别的事。可是回去演戏，真的没用。观众要看新闹剧，不值得再争。
text: Forgive me. {{e_jaime|Jaime}} was ill again this afternoon. He lay there so white, so astonished, and no one could help. One has to think of other things. But returning to act would be useless. The audience wants new farces. There is no point fighting it.

zh: 从前是我不公正，是我骄傲，舍不得给你应得的赞美。你一直是伟大的演员。我们还可以去{{e_spain|马德里}}，你会成功的。
text: I was unjust. I was proud and withheld the praise you deserved. You were always a great actress. We could still go to {{e_spain|Spain}}. You would succeed in Madrid.

zh: 世界到哪里都一样。
text: The world is the same everywhere.

zh: 或者去一个岛，那里的人会因为你就是你而爱你。
text: Or to an island, where people would love you for yourself.

zh: 五十岁了，还在梦想那样的岛。只有戏里才有。
text: Fifty years old, and still dreaming of such islands. They exist only in plays.

zh: 她终于说冷了，必须回去。临走又找不到足够真切的话，只俯身吻了吻他的手指。他独自留在渐浓的云里，为这个动作欢喜，仍试图理解这场谈话到底给了自己什么。
text: At last she said she was cold and must go. Unable to find words true enough for parting, she bent and kissed his fingers. He remained alone in the thickening cloud, pleased by the gesture and still trying to understand what the conversation had given him.

zh: 皮奥
text: Pio

zh: 楼上的孩子们
text: The Children Upstairs

zh: 这个月还是来了。{{e_camila|卡米拉}}的客套越来越周全，周全得使人没有一句话可以接。她不看我的眼睛，我便望着屋里的摆设，想着只要多坐一会儿，也许会说起一件从前的事。
text: I have come again this month. {{e_camila|Camila}}'s politeness grows more complete, so complete that no answer is possible. She does not meet my eyes. I look at the furnishings, thinking that if I stay a little longer, perhaps we will speak of something from the past.

zh: 谈不下去，就去楼上看孩子们。{{e_jaime|海梅}}也在那里。他们还不需要我在门外换一种身份，不必先证明我的衣服和名声配得上这所房子。陪他们待着，照看一个小小的需要，剩下的时间便在楼上过去。我至少还做得来这些{{e_care|照料}}。
text: When conversation fails, I go upstairs to the children. {{e_jaime|Jaime}} is there too. They do not yet require me to change my identity at the door, or prove that my clothes and reputation belong in this house. I stay with them, meet a small need, and the remaining time passes upstairs. At least I can still offer this {{e_care|Care}}.

zh: 回{{e_lima|利马}}的时候，街上有人拥抱，有人笑着告别。我总想，他们必定从这些交往里得到许多安慰。我们也曾有过，不靠客气，不靠约好的十分钟，一起走很远的路，遇见事情便说。
text: On my way back to {{e_lima|Lima}}, people embrace in the streets and take smiling leave of one another. Surely, I think, they draw great comfort from these meetings. We once had that too, without formality or an appointed ten minutes: walking long roads together, speaking whenever something happened.

zh: 我知道她如今有自己的生活，还是会盼下一次她叫我叔叔时，口气能像从前一点。这样的愿望看上去很小，却使我走完一段路以后，仍在想着下个月再来。只要孩子们还肯听，这一趟远路就仿佛没有全然白走。
text: I know she has her own life now. Still, I hope that next time she calls me Uncle, her voice might sound a little as it used to. Such a small wish keeps me thinking of next month's visit all the way home. If the children still listen, the long journey seems not entirely wasted.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 退回去的礼物
text: The Gifts Returned

zh: 天花的消息传遍利马。同一时候还有几百个人患病，可谈论和恶意都集中在[[NPC1]]身上。许多人暗暗希望，那使她能够离开原来阶层的美貌，终于要受损了。关于病房的传闻一出来，幸灾乐祸的人便觉得自己得到补偿。
text: News of the smallpox spread through Lima. Hundreds of others were ill, yet the talk and malice gathered around [[NPC1]]. Many secretly hoped that the beauty which had enabled her to leave her former class would finally be damaged. Each rumour from the sickroom seemed to compensate those who rejoiced in her misfortune.

zh: 她刚能动身，就离开城里，回到山中。她要卖掉漂亮的宅子，把{{e_jewels|首饰}}退还赠送者，卖掉华服。{{e_viceroy|总督}}、{{e_archbishop|大主教}}和从前真心喜欢过她的人，仍送来问候与礼物；消息没有回音，礼物被原样送回。
text: As soon as she could travel, she left the city for the mountains. She would sell the fine house and gowns, return the {{e_jewels|Jewels}} to their donors. {{e_viceroy|Viceroy Andrés}}, the {{e_archbishop|Archbishop of Lima}} and people who had sincerely liked her still sent enquiries and presents. The messages went unanswered. The presents came back unopened.

zh: 除了护士和女仆，她不肯让人看见自己。多年被赞美以后，她已经把别人愿意靠近，和那张脸连在一起。如今别人还来，在她看来便必定是怜悯，而怜悯里又藏着对这场逆转的满足。
text: She allowed no one but her nurse and maid to see her. After so many years of admiration, she had bound other people's desire for her company to her face. If they still came now, it must be pity; hidden within their pity, she imagined satisfaction at the reversal.

zh: 她退还的钱比自己欠的还多。等愤怒稍歇，贫穷也开始逼近。田庄渐渐衰败，孩子还在那里，日子却被一间不愿走出的房间围住。她想起城里人可能怎样欢喜，听见一个脚步声，又不知道那会带来帮助还是新的注视。
text: She returned more money than she owed. When her anger eased, poverty began to approach. The farm declined. Her children were still there, but her days narrowed to a room she would not leave. She imagined the city's delight and, hearing a footstep, could not tell whether it brought help or another examining gaze.

zh: {{e_pio|皮奥}}没有放弃。他照看孩子，帮着料理田庄，也悄悄借钱给她，终于重新获得进门的机会。女主人蒙着面纱见他，言语仍然尖刻。他相信自己懂得她的痛苦；但懂得，并不意味着屋里的每一扇门都会因此向他敞开。
text: {{e_pio|Pio}} did not give up. He watched the children, helped manage the farm and quietly lent her money, eventually gaining admission again. She received him veiled, still speaking sharply. He believed he understood her suffering. Understanding did not mean that every door in the house was therefore open to him.

zh: 卡米拉
text: Camila

zh: 不见客
text: No Visitors

zh: 别把那些东西再送进来。退回去，告诉他们不必问候。我以前接受一串珠子，觉得那是喜欢；现在同样的盒子摆到桌上，却只想知道，送它的人是不是已经听说了我的脸。
text: Do not bring those things in again. Send them back. Tell them there is no need to enquire. Once I accepted a string of beads and thought it affection. Now the same box on the table makes me wonder only whether its sender has heard about my face.

zh: {{e_villa|这所山庄}}以前像一个体面的归宿。如今，房间外面每一个等着见我的人，都使我想把门再关紧一点。也许{{e_pio|皮奥}}并不这样想，也许他真只是来帮忙；可他一望过来，我就已经替他把心里的话说完。
text: This {{e_villa|Camila's Villa}} once seemed a respectable destination. Now every person waiting outside my room makes me want to shut the door more tightly. Perhaps {{e_pio|Pio}} does not think that way. Perhaps he truly means to help. The moment he looks at me, I have already supplied his thoughts.

zh: 我退还了礼物，连不必归还的也一并送走。这样至少不用再欠着谁的目光。后来才看见，能用的钱越来越少，田庄也不是靠关上门就会自己好起来。
text: I returned the presents, even those I did not have to return. At least I would no longer owe anyone the right to look at me. Only later did I notice how little money remained. A farm does not recover by itself because a door is closed.

zh: 孩子们还在楼上。{{e_jaime|海梅}}的身体一直那么弱，我该为他想办法，却连走出这间屋子的力气都在一天天减少。我不愿被怜悯，也不知道还能用什么方式，把需要说出口。
text: The children are upstairs. {{e_jaime|Jaime}} has always been so frail. I ought to find some help for him, yet every day I have less strength even to leave this room. I refuse pity. I do not know another way to speak my need.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 镜子里的来客
text: A Visitor in the Mirror

zh: [[NPC1]]以为自己把门锁好了。只有短短一会儿，她重新生出一个秘密的希望：从前在舞台上学过那么多办法，是否还有一种，能让这张脸稍稍恢复些熟悉的样子？
text: [[NPC1]] believed she had locked the door. For a brief moment a secret hope returned: after all the methods she had learned onstage, might there be one that could restore something familiar to her face?

zh: 她把粉和乳脂调在一起，匆忙涂上去。过去，她也嘲笑过宫廷里把脸涂得雪白的老女人；现在轮到自己，对着{{e_mirror|镜子}}，一面着急，一面不愿承认希望正在落空。粉色并没有替她找回从前，只使她更清楚自己做了什么。
text: She mixed powder with cream and applied it hurriedly. Once she had laughed at old women at court with faces painted white. Now she faced the {{e_mirror|Dressing Mirror}}, anxious and unwilling to admit that her hope was failing. The colour did not restore the past. It only made her more aware of what she had done.

zh: 然后她在镜面里看见[[NPC2]]站在门口。他推门进来了，脸上带着惊讶。她猛地站起，双手捂住脸，发出一声尖叫。此刻最难忍的，并不仅是他看见病后的痕迹，而是他看见了她偷偷试图遮掩的愿望。
text: Then she saw [[NPC2]] reflected at the door. He had pushed it open and stood there in surprise. She sprang up, covered her face with both hands and screamed. What was unbearable was not simply that he had seen the marks of illness. He had seen her secret wish to conceal them.

zh: 出去。永远不要再进我的房子。我不想再见到你。
text: Get out. Never enter my house again. I do not want to see you.

zh: 她追到走廊上，把东西向楼梯下面扔，随即吩咐管事，不许他再进院子。那道禁令十分明确。此后的一周，他仍不断试图再见一面，终于暂时回到{{e_lima|利马}}。
text: She followed him into the corridor, hurled things down the stairs and ordered the steward never to admit him to the grounds. The prohibition was clear. For another week he repeatedly tried to see her, then temporarily returned to {{e_lima|Lima}}.

zh: 他能帮她管账、借钱，能使孩子们得到照顾，却没能在推门之前停下来问一句。屋里的女人又独自面对镜子。这次她失去的，除了一点秘密的希望，还有门已经锁好的确信。
text: He could manage accounts, lend money and secure care for the children. He had failed to pause and ask before opening a door. The woman faced the mirror alone again. This time, besides a little secret hope, she had lost the certainty that her door was locked.

zh: 皮奥
text: Pio

zh: 又一趟山路
text: Another Mountain Journey

zh: 回到{{e_lima|利马}}以后，我找了些事填时间，没有一件能做得长。思念使人笨拙。我这样年纪的人，还是像一个十八岁的少年，想着只要再见一面，也许就能解释清楚。
text: Back in {{e_lima|Lima}}, I found tasks to fill the time. None held me long. Longing makes a fool of a man. At my age I was still like an eighteen-year-old, thinking that one more meeting might allow everything to be explained.

zh: {{e_camila|卡米拉}}已经吩咐不许我进院子。我知道自己若照常去敲门，连话也传不到她耳边。于是开始想别的办法，想一种能使她亲自出来的声音。以前我靠变通进过许多扇门，这回却偏偏不肯把她那一句拒绝算作最后的话。
text: {{e_camila|Camila}} had forbidden me to enter the grounds. If I knocked as usual, I knew my words would never reach her. I began to devise another way, a voice that would make her come outside herself. I had used ingenuity to enter many doors before. This time I refused to accept her refusal as final.

zh: 我也想到{{e_jaime|海梅}}。孩子聪明，想学东西，不该整天只在仆人和马厩之间消磨。我可以教他读书，把家收拾好，再请{{e_abbess|院长}}帮忙找个管家。
text: I thought of {{e_jaime|Jaime}} too. The child was intelligent and wanted to learn. He should not spend all day among servants and stables. I could teach him, put my house in order and ask {{e_abbess|Mother Pilar}} to find a housekeeper.

zh: 这些打算听起来都很有用。想到它们，我便觉得自己还有理由再走一趟山路。天还没亮，门窗都关着；我站在外面，把那个原本不属于自己的声音，在心里先练了一遍。
text: These plans all sounded useful. Thinking of them, I felt I had a reason to climb the mountain road once more. Before dawn, every shutter and door was closed. I stood outside, rehearsing inwardly the voice that did not belong to me.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 埃斯特雷娅
text: Estrella

zh: [[NPC1]]躺在窗下，模仿少女的低泣。他不让声音太响，时断时续，坚持了足足一刻钟。山后泛出最淡的蓝色，草地在微风里轻轻响。楼上终于亮起一盏灯，窗板打开，裹着面纱的[[NPC2]]探出头。
text: [[NPC1]] lay beneath the window, imitating a girl's low sobs. He kept the sound quiet and intermittent for a full quarter of an hour. The faintest blue appeared behind the mountains; grass stirred in the breeze. At last a lamp lit upstairs, the shutter opened, and the veiled [[NPC2]] looked out.

zh: 谁在那里？谁在哭？
text: Who is there? Who is crying?

zh: 夫人，求您下来。我是一个可怜的女孩，叫埃斯特雷娅。不要叫女仆，请您自己下来帮助我。
text: Señora, please come down. I am a poor girl called Estrella. Do not send the maid. Come yourself and help me.

zh: 她沉默片刻，说了声好。过了一会儿，厚斗篷拖过沾露的草地，她绕到屋角，仍站得很远。
text: After a pause she agreed. A little later her heavy cloak trailed through the dewy grass. She came round the corner of the house, still keeping her distance.

zh: 过来，到我这里。究竟是谁？
text: Come here to me. Who are you?

zh: 来人站起，承认了自己的身份。原本准备帮助一个陌生女孩的女人，立刻明白自己被诱了出来。
text: The visitor stood and admitted who he was. The woman who had come to help an unknown girl understood at once that she had been lured outside.

zh: 什么时候才能摆脱你？我谁也不想见，不想和任何人说话。
text: When will I be rid of you? I want to see no one, speak to no one.

zh: 看在我们那么多年相处的份上，答应我一件事。我就走，以后不再打扰。
text: For the sake of all our years together, grant me one thing. I shall leave and trouble you no more.

zh: 我什么也不答应。离我远一点。
text: I shall grant nothing. Stay away.

zh: 她绕向另一侧的门，他不得不小跑着跟上，确保自己的话仍能被听见。终于她停下，疲倦而生气。
text: She went towards a door on the other side. He had to hurry after her to keep within hearing. At last she stopped, tired and angry.

zh: 到底是什么？快说，很冷，我的身体还没有好。
text: What is it? Quickly. It is cold, and I am not well yet.

zh: 他提出要把{{e_jaime|海梅}}带去城里一年，由自己教养。晨星仍在头顶，所谓求救的女孩并不存在，真正被带到这场谈话中来的，是一个还在屋里睡着的孩子。
text: He asked to take {{e_jaime|Jaime}} to the city for a year and educate him himself. The morning star still shone above. The girl supposedly calling for help did not exist. The person truly drawn into this conversation was a child still asleep inside.

zh: 卡米拉
text: Camila

zh: 先问孩子
text: Ask the Child First

zh: 不行。{{e_jaime|海梅}}身体弱，你那屋子又乱，只有乡下适合他。
