text: No. {{e_jaime|Jaime}} is frail, and your house is disorderly. Only the country suits him.

zh: 近几个月他已经好些了。我会收拾屋子，请{{e_abbess|院长}}找个管家，教他西班牙语、拉丁文、音乐，教他该懂的事。只要一年。
text: He has been better these past months. I shall put the house in order, ask {{e_abbess|Mother Pilar}} for a housekeeper and teach him Spanish, Latin, music, everything he ought to know. Only a year.

zh: 母亲不能这样和孩子分开。我和孩子们会尽力过下去，别再想我的事。
text: A mother cannot part with her child like that. The children and I will manage as best we can. Think no more about me.

zh: [[NPC2]]见请求无效，突然换了一句话。
text: When his request failed, [[NPC2]] abruptly changed his appeal.

zh: 那就把欠我的钱还给我。
text: Then repay the money you owe me.

zh: [[NPC1]]站住。贫穷一直是她竭力藏好的事，此刻被当面打开。她沉默了一会儿，声音变得沙哑。
text: [[NPC1]] stopped. The poverty she had laboured to conceal was laid bare before her. After a silence her voice became hoarse.

zh: 我钱很少。有多少，就还多少。我还有几件{{e_jewels|首饰}}，现在就给你。以后我们不必再见面。原来你是这么硬心肠的人。不过，欠了钱，我应该还。
text: I have very little money. I shall give you what I have. There are a few {{e_jewels|Jewels}} left; you may have them now. Then we need never see one another again. So you are that hard-hearted. Still, I owe the money and ought to repay it.

zh: 我不要钱。那样说，只是想让你答应请求。让我教养他一年，我会疼他、照顾他。从前，我是一个坏老师吗？
text: I do not want the money. I only said it to make you grant my request. Let me educate him for a year. I shall love and care for him. Was I a bad teacher before?

zh: 总说感恩，感恩，感恩，你太残忍了。我曾经感激，好，可我现在已经不是从前那个女人。
text: Gratitude, gratitude, always gratitude. You are cruel. I was grateful once—very well. But I am no longer that woman.

zh: 她望了一会儿天上的星，没有立刻答应。等她再次开口，谈话里终于出现了另一个人的意愿。
text: She looked at the stars for a while without agreeing. When she spoke again, another person's wishes finally entered the conversation.

zh: 如果孩子愿意和你去，那就去。早晨我会问他。若他愿意，中午你会在客店见到他。晚安，愿上帝保佑。
text: If the boy wishes to go with you, he may. I shall ask him in the morning. If he wishes it, you will find him at the inn at noon. Good night. God keep you.

zh: 她转身回屋。索债的话收了回去，却不能当作从未说过；教养的承诺说出口了，也还要等那个孩子醒来，亲自作答。她没有给出一个永远放弃母亲决定权的答复。
text: She turned indoors. The demand for repayment had been withdrawn; it could not be treated as though it had never been made. The promise of education still awaited the child's waking answer. She had not surrendered a mother's right to decide forever.

zh: 名场面
text: Scenes

zh: 过了桥就休息
text: We Shall Rest Across the Bridge

zh: 第二天中午，严肃的小男孩来到客店。他从前考究的衣服，如今已经破旧、沾了污迹，手里只带一个小小的换洗包裹。母亲给了一枚{{e_coin|金币}}作零用，还给了一块{{e_stone|在暗处发亮的小石头}}，让他失眠时可以看一看。
text: At noon the next day, the solemn little boy arrived at the inn. His once fine clothes were worn and stained. He carried only a small bundle of changes. His mother had given him a gold {{e_coin|Coin}} for spending money and a {{e_stone|Luminous Stone}} to look at in the dark when he could not sleep.

zh: [[NPC1]]带[[NPC2]]上了车。没走多久，他便发现颠簸使孩子不舒服，于是把他扛到肩上，继续往前。那些准备教的语言、音乐和礼仪，都还在城里等着；这一程先要照顾的，是孩子承受不了车轮跳动的身体。
text: [[NPC1]] took [[NPC2]] into the cart. Before long he saw that the jolting made the child unwell. He lifted him onto his shoulders and continued. Languages, music and manners—the things he planned to teach—were still waiting in the city. First he must care for a body that could not endure the bouncing wheels.

zh: 快到河谷时，男孩感觉一阵熟悉的发作将要到来。他想藏住羞耻，尤其不愿在陌生人面前显出来。偏偏这时，他们追上了长者认识的{{e_captain|海船船长}}。大人之间的寒暄十分平常，孩子却只顾着小心安放自己的脸和手。
text: Near the valley the boy felt a familiar attack approaching. He wanted to conceal his shame, especially before strangers. Just then they met {{e_captain|Captain Alvarado}}, an acquaintance of the older man. The adults' greetings were ordinary. The child attended only to keeping his face and hands carefully composed.

zh: 再往前，长者又同一位带着少女同行的老妇人说了几句话。那是{{e_maria|玛丽亚}}和{{e_pepita|佩皮塔}}。每个人都带着属于自己的来路，却在这里短暂地成了一队过河的人。
text: Farther on, the older man exchanged words with an elderly woman travelling with a girl: {{e_maria|María}} and {{e_pepita|Pepita}}. Each had arrived by a separate history. For a moment they became a company crossing a river.

zh: 他说，过了桥就坐下歇一歇。孩子不必把全部路程都走完，只要先到对岸。那是一个寻常而具体的照料打算：找地方坐下，让这一阵不适过去，再继续往城里走。
text: He said they would sit down and rest across the bridge. The child did not have to finish the whole journey, only reach the other side. It was a plain, practical plan of care: find somewhere to sit, let this spell pass, then continue towards the city.

zh: 他们没有到达那处休息的地方。桥在这一天坠入河谷，原先还各不相干的五段人生，从此被人用同一个日期说起。{{e_juniper|胡尼佩尔}}站在桥前见证了这一刻。后来，他要问这究竟是偶然，还是{{e_providence|天意}}；{{e_letters|书信}}、回忆与互相矛盾的话语，将把那些名字重新带到他面前。
text: They did not reach that resting place. The bridge fell into the valley that day. Five lives, previously separate, would thereafter be spoken of under the same date. {{e_juniper|Brother Juniper}} witnessed the moment from before the bridge. Later he would ask whether it was chance or {{e_providence|Providence}}. {{e_letters|Letters}}, memories and contradictory accounts would bring those names before him again.

zh: 卡米拉
text: Camila

zh: 放进行李的小石头
text: The Stone in the Luggage

zh: {{e_jaime|海梅}}愿意去。于是有些东西便必须准备，不能只停在昨夜那句‘如果’里面。衣服已经不像从前那样体面，{{e_pio|皮奥}}会看见，也许城里别的人都会看见；但我不能为了藏住这一点，就把孩子也一直留在屋里。
text: {{e_jaime|Jaime}} wishes to go. Now things must be prepared; they cannot remain inside last night's 'if'. The clothes are no longer as fine as before. {{e_pio|Pio}} will see, perhaps others in the city too. I cannot keep the child in this house merely to conceal that.

zh: 一枚{{e_coin|金币}}，可以由他自己花。还有这块{{e_stone|小石头}}，晚上睡不着时，在暗处看着它，至少不必始终望着黑。我给不了一个不会痛、不会害怕的夜晚，只能把手边这件小东西交给他。
text: A gold {{e_coin|Coin}}, for him to spend himself. And this {{e_stone|Luminous Stone}}: when he cannot sleep, he can look at it in the dark instead of staring only into blackness. I cannot give him a night without pain or fear. I can give him this small thing at hand.

zh: 说好是一年。我也记得今早他说过的狠话，记得自己为什么不愿再被要求感激。把孩子交出去，并没有把这些事一同抹平。
text: We agreed on a year. I also remember the cruel words spoken this morning, and why I refuse another demand for gratitude. Entrusting my child to him has not erased those things.

zh: 行李并不多，整理好以后，桌上很快又空了。我仍在这所{{e_villa|山庄}}里，门口不必有人一直等着。可一想到他今夜会睡在另一间屋子，我还是想再摸一摸那只已经交出去的包裹。
text: There is little luggage. Once it is packed, the table is empty again. I remain in this {{e_villa|Camila's Villa}}; no one need keep waiting at the door. Yet when I think of him sleeping in another room tonight, I still want to touch the bundle I have already given away.

zh: 玛丽亚从布商家的女儿，成为蒙特马约尔侯爵夫人。她曾抵抗婚姻，最终仍在客人的讥笑里走进礼堂。女儿出生，使她把未曾得到的爱全放到一个孩子身上；克拉拉却在这份急切的关心中长大，越来越需要距离。母亲越怕被拒绝，越努力讨好，话也越说越多。女儿关门以后，她又在门外等待一个能够使自己安心的答复。她记得自己童年时的害怕，却仍无法只凭这段记忆，避免让另一个孩子感到负担。
text: María rose from a cloth merchant’s daughter to become the Marquesa de Montemayor. She resisted marriage, yet eventually entered the chapel amid the guests’ derision. Her daughter’s birth gave her one child on whom to lavish all the love she had never received. Clara grew up under that anxious attention, needing ever more distance. The more her mother feared rejection, the harder she tried to please and the more she talked. When Clara shut the door, María waited outside for an answer that would reassure her. She remembered the fears of her own childhood; that memory alone could not keep her from becoming a burden to another child.

zh: 海不能被一封信缩短
text: A letter cannot shorten the sea

zh: 克拉拉选择了远赴西班牙的婚事，镇静地登船，留下母亲在岸上看。四年后，母亲终于获准前去探望。她们都曾决心改变，却又在相处中伤害彼此。玛丽亚天未亮便吻过女儿的房门，返回秘鲁，此后把难以当面承受的感情交给书信。她搜集笑话、读书、反复锤炼句子，希望女儿愿意多看一眼。文字后来传世，主要由女婿保存；写信时的母亲想要的，却仍是一点亲近。独坐阳台，她也察觉，自己所渴求的回答包含支配，却总不能放下。
text: Clara chose a marriage that would take her to Spain. She boarded calmly, leaving her mother on the shore. Four years later, María was at last allowed to visit. Both resolved to change, and both wounded the other again. Before dawn María kissed her daughter’s door and returned to Peru. She entrusted to letters the feelings they could scarcely bear face to face. She collected jokes, read books and polished her sentences, hoping Clara would linger over them. Those letters survived, chiefly because her son-in-law preserved them. Their writer still wanted only a little closeness. Alone on her balcony, she also recognized the wish to control within her longing for an answer, but could not let it go.

zh: 被寄予厚望的孩子
text: The child entrusted with a future

zh: 院长担心自己的事业无人接续，在洗衣池边看中了佩皮塔。她让女孩承担困难的差事，学习病房与账目的管理，又把她送到侯爵府接触外面的生活。佩皮塔因被信任而自豪，也因能力不足而害怕。在新住处，仆人的欺负、夫人忽近忽远的关心，使她没有一个放心说话的人。有一次夫人让她在教堂外等待，自己却从另一扇门走了。女孩即使确认人已离开，仍回到街角等候。她很会守住责任，却还不懂怎样替自己的困境求助。
text: Fearing that no one would continue her work, the abbess chose Pepita beside the laundry trough. She gave the girl difficult errands, taught her about wards and accounts, then sent her to the Marquesa’s house to learn about life beyond the convent. Pepita was proud to be trusted and afraid she was unequal to it. In her new home, bullying servants and the lady’s wavering affection left her no one she could safely confide in. Once the Marquesa told her to wait outside a church, then left by another door. Even after learning that she had gone, Pepita returned to the street corner to wait. She knew how to hold fast to a duty; she did not yet know how to ask for help with her own troubles.

zh: 谁听见了那些话
text: Who heard those words?

zh: 剧院里，卡米拉即兴嘲讽侯爵夫人，引来观众喝彩。佩皮塔听懂了，带夫人离开；夫人却沉浸在对女儿的思念里，几乎没有听见。奉总督命令前来道歉时，演员把她的茫然误认为宽恕，反而真正惭愧。夫人讲起与女儿和好的动作，那只是反复做过的梦。后来女儿怀孕，母亲又求助于禁忌、符咒和祈祷，最终带佩皮塔进山朝圣。主人赶去圣所，女孩则留在客栈安顿箱笼、火盆和食物，让一间陌生屋子先成为能住下的地方。
text: At the theatre, Camila improvised a song mocking the Marquesa and won the audience’s applause. Pepita understood and led her mistress out. The Marquesa, absorbed in thoughts of her distant daughter, had scarcely heard. Sent by the Viceroy to apologize, the actress mistook her bewilderment for forgiveness and felt real shame. María described a tender reconciliation with Clara. It was only a dream she had had many times. When news of Clara’s pregnancy arrived, her mother sought help in prohibitions, charms and prayers, then took Pepita on a mountain pilgrimage. While her mistress hurried to the shrine, the girl stayed at the inn to arrange trunks, charcoal and food, making an unfamiliar room a place they could inhabit.

zh: 留下与撕去
text: What survived, what was torn up

zh: 山城的清明空气使玛丽亚暂时安静。女儿的新信仍带来刺痛，她却没有再急于寻找一个保证。佩皮塔独自写信，想回修院几天，也盼院长给自己几句话；母亲在她下楼时读到了这份求助。晚餐前，女孩拒绝寄信，说它不够勇敢，随后撕掉。母亲由此回看自己的索求，重新写下后来传世的第五十六封信，称它为第一封。天将亮时，她去看熟睡的女孩。两天后，两人才返城。求助信没有留下；母亲的新信，却抵达了后来仍活着的人。
text: The clear mountain air briefly quieted María. Clara’s new letter still hurt, but she no longer rushed to seek a guarantee. Alone, Pepita wrote to ask for a few days back at the convent and a few words from the abbess. While the girl was downstairs, the Marquesa read her appeal. Before supper Pepita refused to send it, calling it insufficiently brave; later she tore it up. Her words made María reconsider her own demands. She wrote anew the letter later known as Letter LVI, calling it her first. As dawn approached she looked in on the sleeping girl. They set out for Lima two days later. The appeal for help did not survive; the mother’s new letter reached people who would live on.

zh: 不必解释的两个人
text: Two people who need no explanation

zh: 曼努埃尔与埃斯特班被发现于修院门前的弃婴篮里，由院长照看长大。他们听过许多故事，少年曼努埃尔曾坚信，若两兄弟在受难现场，就会把事情拦下来。成年后，他们抄写、搬货，也做过各种短工。外人总因相貌相同而打趣，他们便避免一起出现在街上。两人还有自幼创造的私语，大主教希望记录词形时，那份亲密却使他们羞于开口。旁人看来不爱交谈的兄弟，在生活里不必说很多，已经知道另一边有人。
text: Manuel and Esteban were found in a basket outside the convent and grew up under the abbess’s care. They heard many stories. As a boy, Manuel insisted that if the brothers had been present at the Crucifixion, they would have stopped it. Grown up, they copied texts, loaded cargo and took temporary jobs. Strangers’ jokes about their identical faces made them avoid appearing together in the street. They also had a private language invented in childhood. When the Archbishop wanted to record its words, that intimacy made them too embarrassed to speak. To others they seemed uncommunicative. Together they needed few words to know that someone was there.

zh: 两种没有说清的心事
text: Two feelings left unexplained

zh: 免费入场的一晚，埃斯特班先离开，曼努埃尔留下看卡米拉跳舞，此后越来越受她吸引。他答应替她代写秘密情书，连兄弟也不许知道；信里的爱与愤怒，实际写给别的人。一次深夜，演员亲自来出租房催写，床上的埃斯特班把近距离的耳语误认为自己无法进入的亲密。察觉兄弟痛苦，曼努埃尔宣布不再代笔。埃斯特班却说不必为他改变，甚至想冒雨离开。两人最终留下，没有再提争执；沉默恢复了，隔阂并没有因此获得完整解释。
text: One evening of free admission, Esteban left the theatre first; Manuel stayed to watch Camila dance. His attraction deepened. He agreed to write her secret love letters, telling even his brother nothing. Their declarations and anger were addressed to other men. One late night she came to their rented room to dictate. From his bed, Esteban mistook their close whispering for an intimacy he could not share. Seeing his brother’s pain, Manuel announced that he would stop writing for her. Esteban said there was no need to change on his account and even tried to leave in the rain. Both stayed. They did not return to the quarrel. Silence was restored, but the distance between them had not been fully explained.

zh: 冷湿布与一个名字
text: A wet cloth and one name

zh: 曼努埃尔伤到膝盖，情况越来越重。医师要求每小时冷敷，埃斯特班便守着更换湿布，却发现这恰是兄弟最痛的时候。病中诅咒不断涌出，清醒后又被收回；两种话语都真实地伤到了照料者，也不能被简单拼成一份最终供词。第三夜，曼努埃尔去世。院长前来处理后事，生还者不肯进楼，问及身份时甚至报出亡兄的名字。送葬队伍走过城里，他只沿平行的街道跟随，远远看见，又远远失去。
text: Manuel injured his knee and grew steadily worse. The doctor ordered cold applications every hour. Esteban stayed to replace the wet cloths, only to find that these were his brother’s moments of greatest pain. Curses poured out in his illness and were retracted when he was lucid. Both kinds of words truly wounded the caregiver; they cannot simply be assembled into a final confession. Manuel died on the third night. The abbess came to arrange the burial. The survivor would not enter the building and even gave his dead brother’s name when asked who he was. As the funeral moved through the city, he followed along parallel streets, seeing it from a distance and losing it from a distance.

zh: 留一个可以回来的地方
text: Leave somewhere to return to

zh: 埃斯特班漂泊了很久，时而工作，时而突然离开。他到过卡米拉的化妆室，却没能说出话；回到修院门外，院长两次叫他朋友，他仍转身跑开。院长终于想到船长，托他去库斯科找人。船长先给出一份工作与晚饭的邀请，青年在这里重新说出自己的名字。晚饭时，他要求船上始终有活可做，不愿旁人知道自己的经历。谈话未能解除悲伤，却留下了下一次见面与共同出发的约定。
text: Esteban wandered for a long time, sometimes working, sometimes suddenly leaving. He went to Camila’s dressing room but could not speak. Outside the convent, the abbess twice called him her friend; he turned and ran. At last she thought of the Captain and asked him to find the young man in Cuzco. The Captain offered work and an invitation to supper. Here Esteban spoke his own name again. Over the meal he asked for constant work aboard ship and for no one to be told his history. The conversation did not lift his grief, but it left another meeting and a journey together still to come.

zh: 本来还要会合
text: They were meant to meet again

zh: 埃斯特班想预支工钱，替自己和亡兄送院长一件礼物，具体买什么尚未决定。船长答应了，也从他身上重新遇见失去女儿后的旧痛。次日青年反悔，回楼上后陷入危机。船长推门进去，把他留在了人世，没有凭几句话许诺悲伤会立即消失。后来两人动身，到桥边分开：船长下到河谷监督货运，埃斯特班走人行桥。他们本来还要会合，桥却在这时断裂。出发是一次继续生活的尝试，没有因此换来命运的保证。
text: Esteban wanted an advance on his wages to give the abbess a present from himself and his dead brother. What to buy had not yet been decided. The Captain agreed, recognizing in the young man his own grief for his daughter. The next day Esteban withdrew his promise and returned upstairs in crisis. The Captain entered and kept him among the living, without promising that a few words could make grief disappear. Later they set out together and separated at the bridge: the Captain went down into the gorge to supervise the cargo, while Esteban took the footbridge. They were meant to meet again. The bridge broke. Setting out had been an attempt to continue living; it brought no guarantee from fate.

zh: 相遇以前与以后
text: Before and after they met

zh: 皮奥自幼离家，靠记忆、人情和机智谋生，喜欢自由、漂亮女人和西班牙文学。他熟悉许多人的秘密，自己的房子却常只有训练过的狗和鸟作伴。十二岁的卡米拉在咖啡馆唱歌时，被他看中并付钱带走。她先得到的是热汤、小床和不再挨打的日子，随后才是严格的训练。两人共同巡游，衣物装在一条披巾里，经历贫困与险境。老师看见才华迅速成长，女孩也找到愿意投入的工作；他们的亲密从来伴随着不对等的支配能力。
text: Pio left home in childhood and made a living by his memory, connections and ingenuity. He loved freedom, beautiful women and Spanish literature. He knew many people’s secrets, yet often had only trained dogs and birds for company at home. He noticed twelve-year-old Camila singing in a café and paid to take her away. First came hot soup, a small bed and an end to beatings; strict training followed. They toured together with their clothes in one shawl, enduring poverty and danger. He watched her talent grow rapidly, while she found work she wanted to give herself to. Their closeness always coexisted with unequal power.

zh: 他们想使谁满意
text: Whose approval did they seek?

zh: 观众满意以后，卡米拉仍要面对皮奥的口哨与挑剔。化妆室里有泪水，也有直到天亮的排练；他能帮助她理解细节，却常用吝于赞美的方法逼迫她。为诗人的孙女演出那一夜，他们又真正共享了艺术的欢喜。后来，总督的夜宴带来礼仪、见闻与地位，皮奥见这些经验使她演得更好，便感到满足。卡米拉却还要承受爱情、日常和身体的疲倦，她想过的生活，并不只为下一段台词服务。
text: Even after the audience was satisfied, Camila had to face Pio’s whistling and criticism. The dressing room held tears and rehearsals that lasted until dawn. He could help her understand a detail, yet often drove her by withholding praise. On the night they performed for the poet’s granddaughter, they also shared a true artistic joy. Later, the Viceroy’s suppers brought manners, experience and status. Pio was pleased to see these improve her acting. Camila still had to bear the weariness of love, daily life and her body. The life she wanted was not solely in the service of the next speech.

zh: 不同的归处
text: Different places to belong

zh: 卡米拉离开舞台，花多年争取体面身份，为自己和孩子建立新的位置。她在山中花园散步时仍等待幸福开始，体弱的海梅却只为阳光高兴。皮奥每月来访，遭冷遇后便上楼陪孩子，仍盼着旧日的亲密恢复。黄昏的花园谈话中，他迟来地承认自己亏欠赞美，提出去马德里或梦想中的岛；卡米拉拒绝重返剧院，又为孩子下午的发病道歉。她最终吻了他的手指。一个动作带来温暖，并没有使两人的未来重新一致。
text: Camila left the stage and spent years seeking respectability, making a new position for herself and her children. Walking through her mountain garden, she still waited for happiness to begin. Her frail son Jaime was glad simply to be in the sunshine. Pio visited monthly; after a cold reception he went upstairs to the children, still hoping their former closeness might return. In their dusk conversation in the garden, he belatedly admitted how little praise he had given her. He proposed Madrid or an island of his dreams. Camila refused to return to the theatre, then apologized after mentioning the child’s attack that afternoon. Finally she kissed his fingers. The gesture brought warmth without making their futures one again.

zh: 门里面的愿望
text: A wish behind the door

zh: 天花之后，卡米拉退还礼物，迁居山庄，不肯让人见自己。她把探访理解成带着优越感的怜悯，逐渐把帮助也挡在门外。皮奥照看孩子、料理田庄，终于获准进入，却意外推开了她以为锁好的门。镜子映出她偷偷涂粉的尝试，也映出来人的惊讶。她愤怒地将他逐出，禁止再进院子。皮奥回城仍不能安心，带着教养海梅的设想再次上山。他的善意与越界并存，不能用其中一项替另一项作答。
text: After smallpox, Camila returned gifts, moved to her villa and refused visitors. She understood their concern as pity tinged with superiority, gradually shutting out help as well. Pio cared for the children and managed the estate. At last allowed inside, he unexpectedly opened a door she believed locked. The mirror showed her secret attempt to powder her face, and the visitor’s surprise. Furious, she drove him out and forbade him even the courtyard. Back in Lima he could not rest. He climbed the road again, imagining that he might educate Jaime. His good intentions and his intrusions coexist; neither cancels the other.

zh: 承诺尚未兑现
text: Promises still unfulfilled

zh: 皮奥假扮哭泣的少女，把卡米拉引出屋子，请求带海梅进城教养一年。被拒绝后，他又用索债施压，随后收回要钱的话。卡米拉最终提出条件：先问孩子是否愿意。海梅次日出现，带着母亲给的金币与夜里可看的小石头。颠簸使他不适，皮奥改用肩膀扛着他走。桥前，他们遇见船长，又同玛丽亚和佩皮塔说话；过桥后休息的打算没有实现。教养、归途、远航都尚未完成，幸存者此后还须继续面对爱、过错与照料。
text: Pio imitated a weeping girl to draw Camila outside, then asked to take Jaime to the city for a year’s education. Refused, he pressed her by demanding repayment of a debt, then withdrew the demand for money. Camila finally set a condition: first ask whether the child wished to go. Jaime appeared next day with a gold coin from his mother and a little stone to look at when sleepless. The jolting journey made him ill, so Pio carried him on his shoulder. Before the bridge they met the Captain and spoke to María and Pepita. Their plan to rest on the other side was never fulfilled. Education, homecoming and voyage all remained unfinished. Those who survived still had to live with love, wrongs and care.
